data.jd_text:
**About Zamanat** 




 Zamanat is a Sharia\-aligned real\-world asset tokenisation platform. We structure and tokenise assets across funds, private credit, real estate and receivables, then distribute them through institutional, private wealth and on\-chain channels.
 



  





 We have applied for a DIFC tokenised credit fund and run a live structuring pipeline across receivables, fund and real\-estate mandates in MENA, GCC and selected emerging markets. The structuring lead is a foundational role.
 



  





 AI\-driven playbooks are a core part of Zamanat's growth strategy. We are building a structuring function where AI tools compress time\-to\-launch, accelerate documentation, and turn one\-off deals into repeatable products. The right hire is hungry to learn, prototype and embed AI tooling into the structuring workflow.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




 We are hiring a
 **Director, Structuring \& Originatio** 
 n to lead deal structuring across Zamanat's live and forward pipeline, originate new mandates, and build the structuring playbook that compresses our time\-to\-launch on every subsequent deal. The role is hands\-on today. It is also on a clear path to Senior Director or MD as deal pipeline, AUM and team scale. The right person executes deals personally now and grows into running a structuring desk over the next 18 to 36 months. This is not a pure origination seat and not a back\-office structuring seat. We need someone who can hold a term sheet, a Sharia structure, a regulator conversation, a sponsor relationship and a documentation pack in the same week.
 



  





  





**What You Will Do** 



* Lead end\-to\-end structuring on live mandates across receivables financing, private credit, fund tokenisation and asset\-backed structures
* Originate new mandates alongside the CEO and BD lead, primarily across MENA, GCC, South Asia and Sub\-Saharan Africa
* Codify Zamanat's structuring playbooks. The 12\-month KPI is three named playbooks in production use
* Build AI\-assisted structuring tooling and templates: use AI to fast\-track documentation, term\-sheet drafting, scenario modelling, Sharia structure checks, and deal pattern recognition across the playbook library
* Own commercial term\-sheet design, fee structures and economic alignment with sponsors and partners
* Run Sharia structuring decisions in close coordination with appointed Sharia advisors. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk, Ijara, Musharaka and hybrid structures as relevant
* Oversee post\-issuance servicing on SME and receivables programmes including servicing, reporting, performance monitoring and remediation triggers
* Work with regulatory counsel and partner licence\-holders on jurisdictional execution (ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA, and selected emerging\-market regulators)
* Manage the deal\-team relationship with fund administrators, custodians, tokenisation tech partners and Sharia advisors
* Build and lead the structuring team as pipeline conversion supports it.



  





**Candidate Profile** 




 You ha
 **ve 10 to 14 ye** 
 ars of experience in structured finance, capital markets, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging. You have personally led deals through structuring, documentation and closing, not just sat on the desk while others closed them. You can run the playbook today and build the team that runs it tomorrow.
 



 You understand both the commercial logic of a deal and the structural mechanics that make it executable. You are comfortable with ambiguity, lean teams and shaping a function from scratch. You are hungry to learn and apply AI tooling to your work. You see AI as core leverage on structuring throughput, not a side experiment.
 



  





**Required Experience** 



* 10 to 14 years in structured finance, capital markets, sukuk, Islamic finance, private credit, securitisation, receivables financing or specialist arranging
* Demonstrable Sharia\-structured execution on live deals. Murabaha, Wakala, Sukuk or Ijara applied in production, not theoretical.
* Capital markets experience including debt capital markets, sukuk issuance, structured notes or asset\-backed transactions
* Receivables financing, factoring, supply\-chain finance or working\-capital programme experience.
* Strong commercial judgement on term sheets, fee structures and sponsor economics.
* Experience working across ADGM, DIFC, DFSA, FSRA or comparable GCC and MENA regulatory environments.
* Ability to manage external counsel, fund administrators, custodians and partner licence\-holders.
* Willingness to learn and embed AI tools in day\-to\-day structuring work. Comfortable using AI for documentation, scenario testing, term\-sheet drafting, structure comparison and pattern recognition across deal libraries.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Private markets experience including private credit funds, real\-estate funds, infrastructure or alternatives
* Tokenisation, digital assets or blockchain\-based issuance exposure
* Direct relationships with mid\-market issuers, sponsors, asset managers and private credit originators across MENA, GCC, South Asia or Sub\-Saharan Africa.
* Prior experience codifying structuring playbooks, templates or repeat\-issuance frameworks.
* Existing exposure to AI tools applied to financial work (deal review, documentation drafting, model build, research synthesis).
* Team build and leadership experience.
* Comfort operating without a large platform underneath, in an early\-stage operating company



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 In the first 90 days, you will have taken ownership of the live structuring book, mapped the forward pipeline, locked priority deal sequencing, started the first playbook codification, and identified the first two or three AI tooling levers for the structuring workflow. In the first 12 months, success means closed mandates with locked fee economics, the first three named structuring playbooks in production, AI tooling embedded in at least two playbooks (with measurable time\-to\-launch compression), a working post\-issuance servicing model on receivables programmes, and a hiring case for the next structuring team member.
 



  





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation.
* Performance\-linked bonus tied to closed mandates, structuring fee revenue and playbook delivery.
* Equity or carry participation aligned to long\-term value creation
* Clear trajectory to Senior Director or MD as pipeline, AUM and team scale.
* Direct exposure to the CEO, partners, sponsors and Sharia governance.
* A foundational role in building a Sharia\-aligned tokenisation platform from the structuring layer up, with AI tooling embedded into the workflow from inception.

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 Keeta, the international subsidiary of global delivery leader Meituan, is driven by a clear mission: We help people eat better, live better. Building on our parent company's 16 years of technological and operational expertise mastered in China, we are leading a global transformation in food and consumer product delivery. Since our start in 2023, Keeta has focused on creating value for every part of the communities we serve. We provide a reliable experience for consumers, enhance technology and operations for restaurants, and create more earning opportunities and greater safety for courier partners. This commitment to shared progress drives our journey from Hong Kong, China, across the Middle East and into Brazil, with the world ahead.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



1. Build and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to support logistics operations — providing real\-time visibility across delivery performance, courier efficiency, and supply\-demand balance
2. .Lead deep\-dive analytics on key delivery metrics including ATA (Arrival Time Accuracy), order fulfilment rates, and last\-mile efficiency — translating insights into actionable recommendations for operations teams
3. .Develop quantitative models for capacity planning, workforce scheduling, and demand forecasting to support sustainable growth in the UAE market
4. .Own data storytelling for weekly and monthly business reviews — ensuring KPI visibility and driving alignment across cross\-functional stakeholders
5. .Partner with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to define metrics frameworks, evaluate new initiatives, and embed a data\-driven decision\-making culture
6. .Lead and develop a team of 4–5 data analysts — setting direction, building capability, and fostering a high\-performance analytics culture



  





**What We Need From You** 



* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics, with 2\+ years of team management experience.
* Proficiency in SQL and at least one of Python or R — with hands\-on experience building pipelines, dashboards, and analytical models.
* Strong background in internet, technology, or on\-demand platform companies — experience in food delivery, logistics, or last\-mile operations is a strong plus.
* Proven ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Fluency in both English and Chinese (Mandarin) — this role operates across a bilingual team environment.
* Bachelor's degree or above in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.



  





**What Makes This Role Exciting** 




 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of data science and last\-mile delivery operations — with direct impact on how Keeta serves millions of users across the UAE. You'll be reporting into the Head of Logistics and building the data foundation that powers one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East. With a newly formed team and a high\-growth market, this is a genuine opportunity to shape how data\-driven decisions are made at scale — from the ground up.
 



  





**Why Join Keeta** 



* **Global scale, local impact** 
 — Keeta is Meituan's international arm, backed by 16 years of technology and operational expertise, and one of the fastest\-growing food delivery platforms in the Middle East.
* **Real ownership from day one** 
 — You'll lead a team, shape data infrastructure, and directly influence how the business makes decisions at scale.
* **Work with top talent globally** 
 — Collaborate with teammates from over 40 countries in a fast\-moving, high\-performance environment.
* **Accelerate your career** 
 — We move fast, operate across multiple markets, and give ambitious people the space to grow beyond what a traditional role could offer.

 Dubai, United Arab Emirates

 Managing Director / Executive Director

 The Technical Director is the highest technical authority within the organization, responsible for leading multidisciplinary design and construction supervision functions across a diverse portfolio of projects.  Combining strategic leadership, client engagement, and financial oversight, the Technical Director drives performance, innovation, and quality across architectural and engineering teams while supporting business growth and operational efficiency.

 Lead multidisciplinary coordination to deliver integrated, efficient, and buildable solutions.

 Identify and mitigate technical risks and implement corrective actions.

**Financial \& Operational Oversight**

 Ensure efficient utilization of technical resources across projects.
 



**Compliance and Quality** 




 Ensure adherence to UAE regulations, authority requirements, and international standards.

 Drive innovation through adoption of new technologies, digital tools, and sustainable design practices.
 



 Stay updated on industry trends, codes, and emerging technologies.
 



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.
 



 Minimum 18–20 years of experience in architectural/engineering consultancy (pre and post tender stages).
 



 Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams.
 



 Strong knowledge of UAE codes, standards, and authority requirements (e.g., Dubai Municipality, DDA, etc.).
 



 Demonstrated experience in design management and construction supervision.

At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.

* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.

* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy

* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management

**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. data.jd_text:
**A Role That Brings Colour, Culture \& Culinary Storytelling Together – The Scarlet Macaw Identity**
 At Kimpton Sevn Dubai, Scarlet Macaw is more than a restaurant—it is an experience inspired by nature, rhythm, and vibrant Latin American energy.
   

  

 Named after the Scarlet Macaw, a striking Neotropical parrot native to the forests of Central and South America, the concept reflects bold colours, expressive flavours, and immersive hospitality. It is a celebration of reds, greens, golds, and the dynamic spirit of Latin culture brought to life through food, design, and atmosphere.
   

  

 We are looking for a Chef de Cuisine who can translate this energy into every dish—someone who leads with creativity, discipline, and cultural respect while delivering a bold, memorable dining experience.
   

  

 You are not only leading a kitchen—you are bringing a story to life on every plate.
   

  

**One Kitchen. One Culture. One Immersive Experience.**
 At Scarlet Macaw, dining is vibrant, expressive, and alive.
   

  

 As Chef de Cuisine, you ensure:
   

  

* Authentic and inspired execution of Latin American cuisine concepts
* Consistent delivery of bold, flavour\-driven dishes with visual impact
* Strong leadership of a high\-energy, multicultural kitchen brigade
* Seamless alignment between food, storytelling, and guest experience


 You create a kitchen that moves with rhythm, energy, and precision.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Scarlet Macaw is a sensory journey—colour, sound, flavour, and emotion combined.
   

  

 In this role, you support the Cluster Director of Culinary by:
   

  

* Bringing the Scarlet Macaw culinary vision to life through execution
* Leading a kitchen that reflects energy, creativity, and cultural authenticity
* Ensuring operational excellence while preserving culinary identity
* Driving consistency across all service periods and guest touchpoints
* Developing a team capable of delivering high\-impact dining experiences


 You are the guardian of both flavour and experience.
   

  

**Be The Leader Behind The Experience**
 You are expressive, structured, and creatively disciplined.
   

  

 Through your leadership, you will:
   

  

* Lead daily kitchen operations for Scarlet Macaw
* Oversee all food preparation, presentation, and service execution
* Ensure consistency in Latin\-inspired dishes and menu standards
* Manage kitchen brigade performance, training, and development
* Maintain energy, pace, and precision during high\-volume service


 Your leadership defines the rhythm of the restaurant.
   

  

**What We’ll Support You To Do**
* Bring Culinary Storytelling to Life
* Translate Latin American inspiration into bold, memorable dishes.
* Lead a High\-Energy Kitchen Brigade
* Develop talent capable of delivering vibrant, consistent execution.
* Maintain Operational Excellence
* Balance creativity with structure, discipline, and efficiency.
* Elevate the Guest Dining Experience
* Ensure food, presentation, and timing enhance the immersive journey.


**The Gig**
 Reporting to the Cluster Director of Culinary, the Chef de Cuisine leads the Scarlet Macaw kitchen at Kimpton Sevn Dubai, ensuring the delivery of a bold, immersive, and culturally inspired dining experience.
   

  

* The Opportunity: Lead a concept\-driven kitchen rooted in Latin energy and creativity
* The Focus: Culinary storytelling, execution, and team leadership
* The Impact: Create a dining experience that is visually striking, emotionally engaging, and unforgettable


 You will shape the heartbeat of Scarlet Macaw.
   

  

**Stay Human**
 At Kimpton, even the boldest concepts remain deeply human.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Lead with passion, respect, and cultural appreciation
* Encourage expression, creativity, and individuality within the kitchen
* Build a team culture rooted in energy, pride, and collaboration
* Bring emotion and storytelling into culinary execution


 Every plate reflects the spirit of the Macaw—bold, expressive, and alive.
   

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day**
 No two days are the same; your responsibilities will span creative, operational, and leadership activities, including but not limited to:
   

  

**Kitchen Operations**
* Oversee daily culinary operations across all service periods
* Ensure smooth and energetic service flow aligned with restaurant pace
* Maintain consistency in flavour, presentation, and quality standards


**Culinary Leadership**
* Lead, train, and inspire a high\-energy kitchen brigade
* Conduct daily briefings and service preparation sessions
* Drive performance, discipline, and team engagement


**Menu Execution \& Quality Control**
* Execute Latin\-inspired menus in line with culinary direction
* Ensure authenticity, balance, and bold flavour profiles
* Maintain strict quality control across all dishes


**Cost Control \& Kitchen Management**
* Monitor food cost, wastage, and inventory efficiency
* Support procurement and stock management processes
* Optimise kitchen productivity without compromising quality


**Hygiene \& Compliance**
* Maintain HACCP, safety, and hygiene standards
* Ensure full compliance with operational guidelines
* Conduct regular audits and corrective actions


**Pre\-Opening Support**
* Support kitchen set\-up and operational readiness for launch
* Assist in menu testing and recipe finalisation
* Participate in training, mock service, and concept calibration
* Contribute to SOP development for a concept\-driven kitchen


**What Success Looks Like**
* A fully realised Scarlet Macaw culinary experience
* Consistent delivery of bold, flavourful, and visually striking dishes
* A motivated, skilled, and high\-energy kitchen team
* Strong operational discipline supporting creative execution
* Seamless service aligned with immersive guest experience
* Successful pre\-opening delivery and concept launch


**Who This Role Is Perfect For**
* Passionate culinary leader with strong creative identity
* Experience in Latin American or vibrant global cuisine concepts
* Strong background in luxury, lifestyle, or destination dining
* Energetic, disciplined, and hands\-on kitchen operator
* Strong team builder and cultural motivator
* Detail\-driven with a passion for storytelling through food


**What We Need From You**
 Ideally, you bring some (or all) of the following qualifications and experience
   

  

**Education**
* Culinary qualification or equivalent professional certification preferred


**Experience**
* 5–8 years culinary experience in upscale or lifestyle dining
* Minimum 2–3 years in a senior kitchen leadership role
* Experience in concept\-driven or themed restaurant environments preferred
* Pre\-opening experience is an advantage
* GCC/Dubai experience beneficial


**Personal Attributes**
* High\-energy and creatively expressive leadership style
* Strong passion for culturally inspired cuisine
* Calm, focused, and disciplined under pressure
* Detail\-oriented with strong execution standards
* Collaborative and team\-focused approach
* Deep respect for culinary storytelling and guest experience


**What You Can Expect From Us**
 At Kimpton Sevn Dubai, part of IHG Hotels \& Resorts, we believe our success begins with our people.
   

  

 We invest in you through competitive compensation, global travel privileges, and meaningful career growth opportunities within one of the world’s most respected hospitality groups.
   

  

 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing fair and inclusive employment opportunities to all colleagues and applicants, regardless of race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.
   

  

 Through our myWellbeing framework, we actively support the physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing of our teams—because when our people are supported and thriving, they create exceptional experiences for our guests and each other
   

  

**Kimpton Sevn Dubai: A Culture of Connection, Craft \& Care**
 At Kimpton Sevn Dubai, you are not simply joining a team—you are becoming part of a culture that is personal, thoughtful, and distinctly human.
   

  

 We are a close\-knit, collaborative community where trust is earned, individuality is valued, and excellence is shaped through genuine care for people and experience.
   

  

 We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our culture and inspire creativity. We seek individuals who are naturally intuitive, detail\-oriented, and passionate about creating memorable moments that feel both effortless and meaningful.
   

  

 At Kimpton, hospitality is bold yet refined, expressive yet intentional. More than a place to stay, we create spaces where guests feel connected, inspired, and truly welcomed—and where our teams feel empowered to bring their personality, creativity, and craftsmanship to everything they do.
   

  

**Ready to Shape Something Distinctive?**
 If you do not meet every requirement but believe you bring the right energy, creativity, and passion for people, we would still love to hear from you.
   

  

 Join Kimpton Sevn Dubai and be part of shaping a luxury lifestyle experience where individuality is celebrated, ideas are valued, and every detail contributes to something memorable.
   

  

 Kimpton Hotels \& Restaurants crafts unique destinations that kindle heartfelt human connections. Our bespoke spaces blend spirit, style and delight to create an addictive culture of refined irreverence where locals, visitors \& colleagues seamlessly connect.
   

  

 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us:**
 talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. Were part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50\+ countries
 **.**
**About This Role**
 Were looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. Youll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real\-time tracking and payments.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role. You wont be writing code daily, but youll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. Youll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
   

  

 We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you havent worked in an XP environment before, thats fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and youre excited to lead in this
   

  

**What Youll Do**
* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer\-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross\-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat


**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days** 
 : You understand the mobile codebase, the teams delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. Youve completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
   

  

**By 6 months** 
 : Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. Youve measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether thats cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
   

  

**By 12 months** 
 : Youve shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**You must have**
* 6\+ years of hands\-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform)
* 2\+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade\-offs between native vs cross\-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K\+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data


**Bonus If You Have**
* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk\-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain\-Driven Design (DDD) or event\-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e\-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams


**This role is for you if...**
* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* Youre comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought


**This role is NOT for you if...**
* You want a pure people\-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow\-moving environments with long planning cycles
* Youre not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices


 Additional information
   

  

**Your Career Growth Path**
 Talabat operates a structured career framework with clearly defined levels for engineering leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, youll enter an established progression that rewards growing impact, strategic ownership, and people leadership:
   

  

**Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Manager** 
 — You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain\-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
   

  

**Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
   

  

**Senior Engineering Director** 
 — You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company\-wide technical strategy, build director\-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Mid\-Level Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: http://www.talabat.com Job Function: Software Development Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: Technology Information and Internet
   

  

 What We Offer

 Searching, interviewing and hiring are all part of the professional life. **TGP International**

 TGP International are a hospitality consultancy based in London and Dubai. We team up with passionate brands, clients and entrepreneurs to make their long\-term vision a reality through concept development, creative interior design, graphic design \& branding, franchising, advisory \& operational services and project management.
   

  

 Some of our clients include: Dubai Expo 2020, Marriott, Hilton, Waldorf Astoria, Harrods, Sushi Samba, Adrift Burger Bar, Nakheel Malls, Selfridges, Time Out Market, FIFA World Cup 2022, The National, and Tashas.
   

  

**Do you have a real passion for food and hospitality? Are you a foodie? Does the idea of creating world\-class restaurants, food halls and F\&B excite you?**
 As the world's leading hospitality agency, offering an outstanding 360 degree service to our clients, we are constantly striving to be the best and lead the sector in F\&B and hospitality consultancy. We need a driven and creative person to join our fun and dynamic team and have a direct contribution and client exposure on some of the world's leading projects.
   

  

**Requirements**
**The Role:** 
 Strategy \& Masterplanning Director
   

  

**The job location can be from any of our offices: London, Cairo, Dubai, Riyadh**
 The Strategy \& Masterplanning Director is responsible for leading and growing TGP's Strategy \& Masterplanning practice, ensuring the successful delivery of all strategic advisory projects while driving innovation, client satisfaction, commercial performance, and team development.
   

  

 As a senior client advisor, the Director will build trusted relationships with clients, taking the time to deeply understand their challenges, ambitions, operational realities, and commercial objectives. They will be responsible for translating complex business problems into clear strategic questions, designing analytical approaches that uncover actionable insights, and developing tailored solutions that create measurable value for clients.
   

  

 The Director will lead multidisciplinary teams through large\-scale research, data analysis, market evaluation, and strategic planning processes, transforming complex findings into compelling narratives, creative strategies, and inspirational recommendations that distinguish TGP from traditional consultancies.

 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.

**1\. JOB PURPOSE** 




 The role of the Resident Architect will be expected to cover the full Project Management, and FIDIC Resident Architect / DSA Contract Administration duties for post\-contract services, as detailed in the DSA PM scope of services documents and Responsibility Matrices.
 



  





**2\. JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES LINKED TO OBJECTIVES** 




 The Resident Architect may be required to fulfil duties as detailed below on single or multiple projects or working on strategic / special tasks and projects.
 



 The Resident Architect must work closely with their immediate supervisor and line manager to establish and agree work scope and responsibilities of this role on the specific project.
 



**The Role** 




 The role is to work within and lead a project, site team to the ultimate success of the project.
 



 This is DSA’s most senior Project Position on any project and role extends to looking after and maintain the best interests for DSA in terms of legal, contractual and or commercial positions on each project being responsible for.
 



 The role has 3 facets to it:
 


* Project Management
* Contract Administrator
* Architectural oversight



**Project Management Role** 



* To monitor and control progress and scheduling.
* To monitor the control of costs on all contracts as performed by the Quantity Surveyor / Commercial Manager.
* To Monitor and Manage the Change Management process.
* To coordinate the efforts of all Consultants, Contractor, Suppliers and associated parties with the project.
* To monitor the Contractor’s Logistics, and compliance with Health and Safety, and Environmental Management Plans.
* Report, on a regular basis, on the status of the project at all stages, highlighting performance issues, delivery deficiencies, corrective actions, and recommendations.
* To establish communication protocols, systems and procedures.
* Manage, monitor and maintain the performance of the DSA team and report and recommend any required allocations and or staff revisions to the Project Director.



 The RE will adopt an impartial and multi\-disciplinary approach in handling the project. The RE will display a global interest in the total project, encompassing the Design team, Construction Personnel and Client.
 



 During the Construction phase, the RE will give opinions and make recommendations to the Client that will influence and guide the works to assist the meeting of the Project objectives.
 



 The RE will also monitor the construction works; all health, safety and environmental matters; and the actions of the consultants to protect the Client’s interests.
 



**Contract Administration Role** 




 The RE is responsible for the complete administration of the DSA contract between the Client and DSA.
 



 This will involve providing all formal written instructions, Final adjudication on and recommendation to Extension of Time Claims, Cost Variation orders, dispute resolution, and acting on all duties and obligations under the contract within the limits of authority as defined therein.
 



**Architectural Oversight** 



* Ensure that the site teams are aware of and have a common understanding of their respective roles and responsibilities.
* Ensure that the Site team is suitably experienced and qualified to fulfil their respective roles and duties.
* Ensure the code of conduct of DSA site personnel is appropriate and professional.
* Act as ‘facilitator’ for the resolution of internal conflicts and associated challenges.
* Monitor the status of open items in the ‘Action Lists / logs’ to ensure speedy resolution of issues.
* Assist in monitoring TIE/RFI and other pre\-engineering responses to minimize cost implications and maximise project benefit.
* Assist in risk monitoring, control and responses/ contingencies.
* Assist the Site Architect in monitoring the drawing deliverables schedule and progress.
* Ensure training and mentoring is provided for all DSA site personnel where necessary.
* Ensure that the DSA site personnel have received a formal site safety induction and registration.
* Ensure that all DSA protocols for information transfer and site work are strictly adhered to.
* Undertake site inspections and quality audits at regular intervals and advise on quality issues.
* Monitor the quality control protocols and regime within the DSA site teams.
* Assist with Testing \& Approving when required design solutions proposed by the design team.



**3\. QUALIFICATION / EXPERIENCE / REQUIREMENTS** 



* Qualified Architect with minimum 15 years’ experience; 7\-10 years full time Middle East site experience is a must
* Multi\-discipline design experience and knowledge
* Hands\-on overseeing all construction works
* Excellent in English language \- written and spoken
* Experience with F\&B works
* Full project coordination
* Proficient with FIDIC Contract Implementation
* Must have tendering
* Experience in leading a multidisciplinary team is a must
* PMP/MCIOB certification is considered as an advantage
* Working knowledge of UAE Building Regulations and International Building Codes of Practice
* Must possess a tangible, technical problem\-solving ability



**4\. COMPETENCIES** 



* Plan \& Organise
* Active listening \& critical thinking
* Execution Excellence
* Excellent Communication (English)
* Good timekeeping
* Ability to work under pressure
* Team Player
* Management and Leadership
* Problem solving
* Collaborative



  





 Interested candidates can also send their CV to recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com, mentioning ‘Resident Architect’ in the subject line.

data.jd_text:
STRUCTURAL integrates technology\-driven solutions with specialty contracting services to improve, protect, and enhance the existing infrastructure of owners directly, and in partnership with designers and contractors. STRUCTURAL offers a wide range of specialty repair and maintenance services and is the largest concrete repair contractor in the United States, with roughly 2,500 employees working from locations nationwide and in select international markets. STRUCTURAL is the open\-shop contracting business line of Structural Group.
   

  

**Skills**
 Strong knowledge of company job management (Procore) and forecasting tools. Strong scheduling software knowledge.
   

  

 Possesses solid leadership skills and demonstrated ability to train and mentor. Displays adherence to company operating principles. Supports sales efforts by building and maintaining relationships with customers.
   

  

**Experience \- Field \- Required/Preferred**
 5\+ yrs \- Construction Management / Civil Engineering \- Required
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Ability to manage generally 3\-6 projects at a time
* Successfully manages projects of moderate complexity that have an aggregate value generally in the range of $1\-$5million.
* Effectively manages changed conditions on projects of moderate complexity including knowing our contractual rights, providing proper notice to third parties and other measures to minimize risk. Estimates and prepares change orders. Coordinates change order review with estimating
* Negotiates and resolves minor disputes relative to authority limits
* Knows the importance of financial management on projects. Has developed strong skills of production tracking and analysis, billing, forecasting, and percent complete accounting. Understands the importance of the month\-end process and is fully prepared with all information including in\-depth explanations for margin variations and over/under billings. Can draw relationships between CPM schedule and forecasting and utilize effectively to monitor project. Monitors cash flow and routinely follows up on open accounts receivable
* Understands Critical Path Method sequencing, work task relationships and resource loading; Maximizes schedules for the benefit of the project
* Dedicated to 24/7 safety culture. Communicates expectations regarding our safety culture and holds others accountable to it on project level
* Dedicated to quality as a core value and communicates expectations regarding our quality culture and holds others accountable to it on a project level
* Interprets, plans, and executes specification requirements of moderate complexity. Negotiates basic contract / subcontract T\&C. Ability to evaluate risk and loss exposure on projects managed.
* Assists in planning, directing, and supervising daily activities of the resources of projects assigned. Maintains open communication with the Branch leadership.
* Effectively communicates expectations and holds team members accountable.
* Works with Jobsite Superintendents/Foremen to coordinate the efforts of any technicians or subcontractors
* Determines labor requirements and dispatches workers to construction sites.
* Develops budgets, evaluates historical man\-hour production rates, tracks actual job production rates and material costs, analyzes this data to report current job costs, accurately forecasts job progress by creating look\-ahead schedules, and uncovers any items that might negatively impact the schedule or budget.
* Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work and the work of others.
* Develops, implements, and maintains quality control plans on the job to minimize punch\-lists at the completion of the project.
* Interprets and explains plans and contract terms to administrative staff, workers, and clients, represents the owner or developer.
* Schedules and facilitates detailed pre\-planning of projects and pre\-task planning for activities.
* Hands\-on mentor and coach, team\-oriented and solution\-oriented.
* Identifies, assigns, and maintains company equipment as necessary to perform the assigned task. Assures that equipment maintenance plans are developed and implemented on projects.
* Maintains Profit \& Loss responsibility over multiple projects and makes key decisions \& recommendations on projects from pre\-task planning phase through closeout.
* Maintains quality control on the job to minimize punch\-list at the completion of the project.
* Manages all project change orders. Identifies changes and provides timely notice to branch leadership. Negotiates and prepares change order agreements. Assesses each project from a long\-term perspective. Anticipates changes/impacts, which may result in delays/claims, etc. and communicates these changes to the client.
* Manages superintendents/foreman, subcontractors, technicians at the level required to meet the division or branch goals. Ability to work under pressure and coordinates numerous activities and groups in order to establish cooperation and achieve maximum efficiency.
* Negotiates with and manages subcontractors and materials suppliers and stays informed on subcontractor scope of work and technical specifications. Prepares and executes subcontractor agreements.
* Monitors/Assesses performance of self, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.
* Orders materials in a timely fashion to allow work to progress productively. Negotiates and executes material purchase orders.
* Prepares contracts and negotiates revisions, changes, and additions to contractual agreements with architects, consultants, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. Obtains all necessary permits and licenses. Works with and serves as the primary point of contact to the customer.
* Prepares, updates and analyzes project schedules using CPM techniques.
* Prepares formal letters \& other written communication to customers/owners. Responsible for project documentation (including but limited to: phone conversations, site visits, meetings, etc.). Performs close\-out reports for all assigned projects.
* Prepares and maintains project submittals, RFI, communications, change orders and other appropriate tracking logs.
* Ability to recognize changes to the as bid project scope of work.
* Confers with supervisory personnel, owners, contractors, and design professionals to discuss and resolve matters such as work procedures, complaints, and construction problems. .
* Reviews and negotiates contracts, change orders, subcontractor contracts. Oversees and evaluates billings, as\-builts, budgets, purchases, production tracking, operational planning, development of project schedule, assignment of manpower, communication with engineers and clients, claims management, quality control as related to project schedules, plans and or specifications.
* Meets with Superintendents/Foremen at least weekly to review job progress.
* Schedules, prepares and facilitates project team, project owner, and jobsite meetings.
* Studies job specifications to determine appropriate construction methods.
* Takes appropriate action to deal with the results of delays, bad weather, or emergencies at construction sites
* Tracks and controls construction schedule to achieve completion of all projects within time and financial goals.


**Essential Safety Duties**
* Essential Safety Duties
* Assures all PPE required by safety specs and company policies is worn by employees, subcontractors and site visitors
* Assure subcontractors are adhering to Company safety policies and culture
* Communicates expectations regarding our safety culture and holds employees accountable
* Performs work in strict compliance with jobsite/shop requirements and the Field Guide to Better Safety
* Accountable for the continuous improvement of branch and division safety programs
* Understands the principles of Safety 24/7 and empowers his/her team toward reaching its safety goals
* Examines/inspects work progress, equipment, and jobsites to verify safety standards are met
* Ensures jobsite/shop is maintained in a safe manner
* Performs root cause analyses and utilizes findings as a training tool for branch employees
* Performs Safety Assessments specified by jobsite
* Promotes 24/7 Safety Culture and exhibits a Safety 24/7 attitude in all situations
* Provides leadership/guidance in developing/continuously improving safety protocol in the field/shop
* Reports immediately, accurately and in full detail all incidents
* Reviews findings at end of the inspection with jobsite employees
* Reviews subcontractor safety reports and assists in sharing progress with client and operations team
* Reviews/audits all safety documentation and investigations and develops safety program changes
* Sets an example for others by demonstrating that safety is a core value
* Sets individual as well as division/branch annual safety goals
* Trains project team members on how to properly conduct JSA's, SOR's and recognize near hits.
* Frequently visit projects to ensure that safety policies are being abided by
* Wears all Personal Protection Equipment required by safety specifications


**Physical Requirements**
* Able to pass a respirator fit test and wear a respirator when required on specific jobsites
* Performs physical activity that requires considerable use of arms, legs, and moving whole body
* Dexterity of hand and fingers to operate a computer, small hand\-held power tools, office equipment
* Required to lift, push, pull, or carry objects up to 25lbs without assistance
* Physical capability to operate motor vehicles and/or heavy equipment
* Able to speak and hear detailed information through oral communication
* Has visual acuity to see items clearly and sharply and to recognize small detail


**Special Requirements**
* Ability to Travel \- Up To 50%
* Willing to work 50\-55 hour per week and have flexible work hours
* Willing to work at heights up to 650 feet off the ground
* Possess valid driver's license in order to operate rental cars when traveling for company business


 STRUCTURAL is committed to a Safety 24/7 culture and offers competitive compensation and benefits including medical, dental insurance, 401(k), paid holidays \& vacation, tuition reimbursement, career development and growth opportunities, and a caring work environment. EOE/M/F/D/V

**Project Overview** 




 This is a greenfield CCGT project to be constructed with a net power capacity of 2400 MW, together with its ancillary equipment, associated infrastructure and facilities. The Project comprises the Plant and associated Electrical Special Facilities (ESF). The Plant will be located inland at a site situated approximately 50 km north\-east of the City of Abu Dhabi.  
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity to engage in the full lifecycle of the project, from design and engineering to construction and operation, all within a dynamic and innovative environment. This project promises stability and long\-term impact. 
   





**Location** 




 Taweelah, Abu Dhabi, UAE (Site is approx. 30 kms to 40 kms from Abu Dhabi city).
   





**Duration** 




 Approx 2\.5 years
   





**Job Overview** 




 Control the quality and procedures during the CCGT project execution.
   





**Duties \& Responsibilities** 



* Developing QA/QC procedure for the CCGT project execution as per the PPA and EPC Contract and ISO standards.
* Review of the quality document, MSRA, ITP, inspection checklist and procedures submitted by the EPC Contractor.
* Lead the QA/QC engineers to monitor \& inspect the EPC Contractor quality works for all the Civil works, Mechanical and Electrical as per the approved drawings and specifications.
* Highlighting quality related issues to the construction team and providing technical advice.
* Other tasks assigned by Project Manager/Director for the project schedule controls.



**Qualification \& Skill Sets** 



* Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent.
* 10\+ years of experience with at least 5 years with CCGT Power Plants.
* GCC experience will be an advantage.
* Good software knowledge and skills in MS Office.
* Good understanding in International Codes and Standards such as ASME, API, IEEE, rules and regulations.
* Strong leadership presence, interpersonal and communication skills to coordinate with EPC contractors, and internal departments.

Can you lead commercial strategy for complex field developments — and maximize asset value?
   

  

 Are you able to drive integration across technical and commercial teams to deliver full‑cycle project success?
   

  

**Be part of a successful team!**
 Baker Hughes Integrated Services exist to
 **plan, manage, and execute multi‑disciplinary well and field development projects** 
 through a single accountable team. Their mandate is to deliver predictable outcomes, optimize asset value, and reduce operational risk for operators.
   

  

**Fuel your passion**
 The
 **Integrated Commercial Director – Field Development** 
 is responsible for leading complex commercial and proposal activities for integrated upstream field development opportunities. The role develops commercial frameworks, supports customer negotiations, and ensures proposals and agreements deliver shareholder value while addressing technical, operational, financial, and contractual risks.
   

  

 This position requires strong E\&P business development experience, knowledge of upstream field development practices, and the ability to translate end\-to\-end technical development plans into fit\-for\-purpose commercial structures.
   

  

**As an Integrated Commercial Director \- Field Development, you will be responsible for:**
* Develop proposals; may negotiate with customers; ensure deals deliver shareholder value; drive competitive pricing. May include compiling and submitting required tender documentation.
* Handle complex products, services, and systems requiring technical knowledge and understanding of the environment where the products or systems will be used. Products and systems are client\-specific and require technical analysis and system design to fit client conditions.
* Lead the commercial structuring of integrated field development opportunities, including pricing, scope definition, contracting strategy, risk allocation, and customer value proposition.
* Apply knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines to support technically informed commercial solutions.
* Understand the technical context of end\-to\-end field development plans and develop accompanying commercial frameworks that support customer and business objectives.
* Manage complex long\-term sales processes. Contracts involve pricing and conditions of sales, rental, operation, maintenance, services, integrated solutions, and other field development\-related commercial arrangements.
* Support drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial agreements related to E\&P business development, including asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, commercial partnerships, and associated liabilities.
* Handle important business unit clients and senior customer interfaces.
* Coordinate sales teams involving engineering, legal, risk, finance, operations, product lines, and leadership.
* Participate in major sales and business development activities involving large, complex, or strategically important opportunities.
* Handle big or highly complex markets with large potential for growth.
* Ensure proposals and negotiated agreements comply with internal governance, risk management, approval processes, and shareholder value expectations.


**To be successful in this role you will:**
* Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college.
* Have 10\+ years of experience working as a commercial advisor in an E\&P business development function.
* Have 10\+ years of experience drafting commercial agreements and negotiating terms related to asset acquisition, joint operating agreements, and associated liabilities.
* Have strong knowledge of upstream development practices across geoscience and engineering disciplines.
* Have the ability to understand the technical context of an end\-to\-end field development plan and structure an accompanying commercial framework.


**Desired Characteristics**
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer requirements, technical feasibility, contractual risk, and profitability.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve complex problems.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs, projects, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong negotiation skills with experience managing complex customer discussions and commercial agreements.


**Work in a way that works for you**
 We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
   

  

  

* Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive


**Working with us**
 Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well\-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Working for you**
 Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
   

  

  

* Contemporary work\-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
* Comprehensive private medical care options
* Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
* Tailored financial programs
* Additional elected or voluntary benefits


 The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Sales Director \- Proposals
   

  

**About Us:**
 We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
   

  

**Join Us:**
 Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you! Let’s come together and take energy forward.
   

  

 Baker Hughes Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

data.jd_text:
The Construction Manager – Electrical is responsible for the comprehensive planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large\-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects, particularly in the power and infrastructure sectors. The role requires a highly experienced professional with a Degree Electrical Engineering and 8 to 15 years of proven experience in executing electrical projects across Gulf countries and/or India. The candidate must possess strong technical knowledge and leadership skills to handle complex project environments, including substations, power plants, and overhead transmission line projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in the construction of medium and large substations, including associated civil and electrical works. Demonstrated expertise in handling power projects such as high\-voltage substations, transmission networks, and overhead lines is essential. The Construction Manager will be accountable for overseeing all construction activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, design drawings, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 A key responsibility of this role is to ensure the smooth execution of the entire project lifecycle, from mobilization to commissioning and final handover. The candidate must possess strong project management skills to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors. The role demands excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to manage stakeholder expectations and resolve project\-related challenges efficiently.
   

  

 The Construction Manager must take full ownership of project timelines, ensuring that all activities are completed within the stipulated timeframe and budget. This includes planning resources, scheduling work, monitoring progress, and implementing corrective measures when required. Strong supervisory and leadership capabilities are critical, as the individual will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and fostering a productive work environment.
   

  

 In addition to construction oversight, the candidate must ensure strict compliance with quality standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations. The role involves implementing and monitoring quality assurance and quality control processes to ensure that all works meet industry standards and client expectations. The Construction Manager must proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with construction activities, ensuring minimal disruption to project progress.
   

  

 Experience in subcontractor management is a crucial requirement for this position. The candidate should have a proven track record of selecting, managing, and coordinating subcontractors to ensure that all work is executed efficiently and in compliance with project specifications. This includes reviewing subcontractor performance, resolving disputes, and ensuring alignment with project objectives.
   

  

 Risk management is another key aspect of the role. The Construction Manager must identify potential project risks at an early stage and develop mitigation strategies to avoid delays or cost overruns. The ability to make informed decisions under pressure and adapt to changing project conditions is essential.
   

  

 The candidate must be self\-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while maintaining a collaborative approach within the project team. Strong problem\-solving skills are required to address technical and operational challenges effectively. Attention to detail, combined with the ability to see the bigger picture, will enable the successful delivery of projects that meet or exceed client expectations.
   

  

 Overall, the Construction Manager – Electrical will have full responsibility for managing and supervising all construction\-related activities, ensuring the successful execution and timely completion of projects in line with contractual commitments. This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging and high\-profile projects, contributing significantly to the development of power and infrastructure sectors in the region.

**Job Description**
**Job Purpose**
 Drive CEO directed projects governance by coordinating committees, programs, and audits; executing project/budget tracking; and planning Director General (DG) visits. Provide data\-driven reports, risk updates, and follow through across Licensing Agency units.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
**Strategy**
* Advise on CEO headed committee charters, annual plans, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs); recommend risk registers and reporting cadence.
* Advise on development/executive plans for Licensing projects; analyze current state, opportunities, challenges, and risks; submit consolidated outputs to leadership.
* Advise on Proof of Concept (PoC) use cases tied to Licensing projects; ensure adherence to institutional documents.


**Operations**
* Advise on outgoing/incoming correspondence related to projects and budget for the CEO; maintain official records and follow up on recommendation closures.
* Oversee follow\-up on contractual plans for projects, contract status, and budget disbursement plans; prepare periodic reports for the CEO.
* Ensure accuracy of programs/projects data accuracy across stages; review transfer requests and change orders; analyze causes/justifications and issue recommendations.
* Execute application of value management principles during project phases; measure benefits, consolidate assets lists from projects, and disseminate lessons learned.
* Execute monitoring of programs and projects; evaluate risks/challenges; track performance; submit periodic completion/progress reports to leadership.
* Coordinate CEO headed committees (e.g., Communication Mechanism with Dubai Police; Supervising Requests of Testing Centers \& Driving Institutes; Contract Appeals): plan meetings, address directions, follow implementation, approve/track KPIs and risks, and manage preparation.
* Manage the leadership meeting for the Licensing Agency and follow up implementation of issued directions.
* Follow up closure of Internal Audit findings at Agency level and report status to leadership.
* Plan and coordinate Director General visits, logistics, and agendas, and consolidate visit actions for follow\-up.
* Follow up and track matters related to partnerships, service providers, operators, international memberships, external meetings, agreements, and MoUs, monitor operational performance level agreements, measure compliance rates, and follow up on the implementation of resulting recommendations and outputs.
* Coordinate and monitor the formation of resilience groups and teams, and review the implementation of the comprehensive organizational resilience implementation map with the concerned units.


**Product/Process Improvement**
* Recommend improvements to committee governance templates, project/budget tracking, and change control documentation to enhance decision lead times and traceability.

**Job Description**
**Enjoy a career, packaged with care, whilst helping protect food, people and the planet**
 We are a key global provider of sustainable packaging solutions. We’re on a mission to make all packaging recyclable, reusable, or compostable. Every day, we ensure the hygiene and safety of food and drink for people around the world. We are Huhtamaki.
   

  

 You could be part of our vision. Because it’s our talented people that make it happen. Our people on the shop floor producing innovative, sustainable products. Our people in our offices delivering excellence for our customers every day. It’s every one of us working together.
   

  

 We offer a place where you can feel safe, be supported, and make an impact so we can all focus on the future together.
   

  

**Your opportunity**
 We are looking for a Head of Finance, MEA, to plan, organize, lead and control the Finance activities for the Region in order to support the delivery of the required growth, revenue, profit, working capital, cash flow and EBIT objectives. You will be the finance business partner for regional leadership and play an essential role in providing financial information, analysis and recommendations to make strategically consistent and financially sound decisions.
   

  

 This role reports to VP MEA and to our Flexible Packaging Segment VP Finance.
   

  

**Where you’ll be**
 This role is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Develop and execute the financial strategy for the MEA region, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives.
* Take full responsibility for financial reporting and controlling across the MEA region, delivering timely, accurate, and insightful analysis in line with Segment and Group reporting requirements.
* Lead and coordinate strategic and budget planning processes, ensuring clear targets, KPIs, and objectives are established and aligned with business goals.
* Ensure accurate forecasting to support effective decision\-making and long\-term planning.
* Oversee capital expenditure planning and monitoring, including project costs, approvals, financing, cash flow, and return on investment. Regularly review existing investments to assess their continued viability.
* Drive working capital optimization by collaborating closely with country teams to improve inventory, receivables, payables, debt management, and capital project efficiency, ultimately maximizing cash flow and returns.
* Identify and manage foreign currency exposures to minimize risk and protect financial performance.
* Review and enhance financial processes and procedures, ensuring strong governance, data accuracy, compliance, and operational discipline.
* Provide financial analysis and support for divestments, restructuring, and expansion initiatives, including the development of robust financial models for strategic decision\-making.
* Ensure effective implementation of business and productivity improvement initiatives by establishing follow\-up and control mechanisms to track progress, savings, efficiency gains, and value creation.
* Support continuous process improvements and ERP transformation initiatives within Flexible Packaging MEA.
* Lead the Finance organization in MEA, delivering high\-quality operational finance services and business controlling. Build a capable, well\-structured team while fostering strong engagement and collaboration, and supporting regional business priorities.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field and / or a professional qualification (e.g., CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
* Strong experience in finance leadership on regional or multi country level or global context preferably in manufacturing or FMCG environment.
* Proven experience in managing and leading finance teams and functions with a strong business partnering ability.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
* Resilience and willingness to win.
* Ability to assess, analyze and synthesize a great deal of information and simplify the complexities.
* Fluent in English, excellent communication skills with ability to establish credibility, respect and build strong working relationships.
* A leadership style aligned with Huhtamaki’s values: Care, Dare and Deliver.

* Development opportunities: We care for each other – and want to see our talent thrive and develop.
* Responsible employer: Sustainability is embedded in everything we do. We believe diverse teams fuel innovation. **Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

Customer Support captures issues; this role owns supplier communication and commercial resolution.

 PXGEO is an innovative marine geophysical service provider combining the strengths of ocean bottom and towed streamer seismic data acquisition techniques to deliver seamless subsurface imaging for a sustainable future.
   

  

****What's the role?****
 The official job title is Head of Sources and Mechanical Handling based in Dubai, UAE.
   

  

 The role is responsible for leading the seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck activities of the Company to support the delivery of best\-in\-class fleet performance. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Mechanical handling, source and NHV technical support
* Manage a department of support staff (mechanical/Instrument and field\-based engineers) to provide first line technical and operational support to vessels and onshore departments as directed
* Maintain source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck specifications and standards for marine acquisition projects
* Develop, maintain, and improve the Company's seismic source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and technique with a focus on environmental, safety, and operational efficiency and excellence
* Keep abreast of changes in source, mechanical handling and NHV back deck technology and proactively make recommendations to Management for enhanced service offerings
* Manage key suppliers of related technical services
* Monitor mechanical and back deck department spending, procurement and prepare budgetary forecasts for new technology
* Monitor mechanical and back deck related downtime across fleet and implement programs to reduce this as far as practical
* Develop and maintain Competency catalogue for the technical department personnel (onshore and offshore)
* Support Human Resources in the selection and development of mechanical and Instrument personnel
* Ensure that the Company management system is implemented, adhered to, measured, and improved by all in the related tech department organization
* Assist in responding to technical queries for tenders
* Assist in marketing in the related technical services to Clients.
* Frequent international travel, sometimes at short notice
* Occasional visits to, and onboard vessels
* Fulfill their assigned responsibilities as part of the Emergency Response team in line with the Emergency Response Plan and duty list as required


****Who are we looking for?****
* Has detailed knowledge of, and extensive experience with, marine seismic survey methods and technologies relating to towing and handling and sources
* At least degree level in an engineering or related discipline or equivalent experience
* As frequent travelers conduct vessel visits: BOSIET or FOET certification is required
