data.jd_text:
**General Description**
 The position is responsible for supporting Chief Risk Officer / HEAD GRCI for all aspects of the risk delivery. The DGM is also responsible for supporting the CRO/HEAD GRCI in overseeing the daily operations and overall management of the Division. The DGM ensures that GRCI agendas are met efficiently, while maintaining high standards of performance, operational effectiveness and divisional growth in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI. The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Collaborate with the CRO/HEAD GRCI, to adapt and implement Group risk policies, frameworks, and operating models tailored to organizational needs.
* Assist the CRO/HEAD GRCI in preparing and managing matters reported to Risk, Sustainability and Governance (RSGC) Committee reporting. Responsibilities include drafting Agenda, tracking and addressing Matters Arising, preparing and reviewing reports such as Risk Management Report, Group Technology Reports, Sustainability Report and Other Agenda Papers (Hospital License, Anti\- Bribery Management System (ABMS), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Report from Medical Advisory Committee (GMACCG), Key Sentinel/Major Incidents quarterly reporting and other papers required by RSGC.
* Identify key risks and their indicators in risk reporting and monitoring, oversee the development and execution of mitigation plans.
* Lead the end to end risk management process for KPJ in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI which includes an analysis of the financial and non\-financial impact when risks occur.
* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).
* To partner with the Head of Group Services and Head of Business Units to ensure that all Risks (Tier 1 \& 2\) risks including investment, project risks, top risk and top emerging risks are being considered in their strategic or operational initiatives. This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.
* Coordinating with Internal Audit to synchronize audit plans and analyze findings for actionable insights.
* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.
* Align ERM practices more closely with KPJ’s long\-term strategic objectives, Academic Health System, Center of Excellence, digital transformation and market expansion.
* Review and challenge the Annual Strategic Planning initiatives and monitor the execution of strategies closely.
* Collaborate closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to address the increasing threat of data breaches and cyberattacks.
* Direct engagement and review on insurance related queries on medical malpractise, general, directors \& liabilities and other lines of insurance coverage.
* Assess and review the adequacy of insurance coverage on an annual basis and present to relevant Committees for renewal.
* To systematically strategize to ensure effectiveness in handling incidents, ensuring a proactive and efficient approach to incident resolution at the Hospital and/or HQ to avoid escalation of incident into crisis.
* To continuously conduct coaching/guidance through on the job training and regular one to one session.
* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the design and implementation of compliance programs that align with local and international regulations.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI in ensure effective monitoring of compliance risks, including anti\-money laundering (AML), anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC) and data privacy.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to develop and promote a robust integrity framework, ensuring the organization adheres to ethical standards and best practices.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational values in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting/Finance
* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage
* ▪Minimum 15 years relevant working experience with minimum 5 years at Management Level
* Professional Paper, Career stint in a Big 4 accounting firm, Healthcare industry experience
* Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Investment \& Finance

**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a senior technology leader to scale and expand our financial technology platform as the company expands across markets, products, partners, and regions.
 



  





 This role is suited for someone who can operate both strategically and hands\-on when needed, but whose main strength is building systems, teams, ownership models, and engineering discipline that do not depend on a single individual.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own technology strategy, architecture, engineering delivery, and platform operations.
* Ensure high availability, resilience, observability, and incident readiness across critical systems.
* Support the company’s cybersecurity posture across ISIEM, SOC, DLP, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management, penetration testing, threat modelling, monitoring, incident response, and security awareness.
* Lead the practical adoption of Agentic AI across engineering and technology operations.
* Strengthen security, compliance, audit readiness, access controls, data protection, and secure SDLC practices.
* Build and mature NOC/SOC capabilities, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, escalation, and post\-incident reviews.
* Scale the platform and the technical team for geographical expansion, including multi\-market readiness, localisation needs, regulatory expectations, and infrastructure scalability.
* Manage technical relationships with third\-party providers of core services, including issuing processors, payment providers, banking partners, cloud vendors, security vendors, and integration platforms.
* Improve ownership models, documentation, Runbooks, SLAs, and operational accountability.
* Partner with Product, Finance, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and executive leadership.
* Reduce key\-person dependency and help build a reliable leadership structure across engineering and operations.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* 10\+ years Senior technology leadership experience in a roles VP Engineering/ Technology, Head of Engineering/Technology, or similar.
* Experience in fintech, specifically issuing, acquiring or banking is essential.
* Proven track record scaling reliable, secure, compliant production systems.
* Proven track record of the Agentic AI adaptation and productivity gain.
* Experience building engineering teams, technical operations, NOC/SOC processes, and delivery discipline.
* Experience with either ISO27001, SAMA, SOC2 and PCI DSS regulatory implementation and support.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, backend platforms, APIs, data systems, observability, disaster recovery and incident management.
* Experience working with third\-party providers of mission\-critical services.
* Ability to operate across strategy, architecture, execution, people leadership, and executive communication.

data.jd_text:
**Manatal** 
 is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital.
 



 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Head of Engineering Operations** 




 As Manatal expands into the enterprise segment, the operational demands on engineering are growing beyond what product squads can absorb alongside feature development. Internal requests, data migrations, bug triage, and customer\-facing technical work require dedicated engineering ownership to maintain quality and velocity across the organization.
 



 The Head of Engineering Operations will own this function. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, this role is responsible for all engineering work that falls outside of product feature development and platform engineering but is critical to customer satisfaction, platform reliability, and business growth. This includes building and leading a team, establishing processes and SLAs, and systematically automating operational workflows.
 



 This is a deeply technical, hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will write production code across our backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases, contribute to both internal tooling and customer\-facing repositories, and be capable of investigating and troubleshooting infrastructure\-level issues. This person is expected to operate at the same technical level as our Director of Engineering and Head of Platform Engineering.
 



 The role also serves as the primary engineering counterpart to the L3 support team (which reports into Customer Support), ensuring that technical escalations are resolved efficiently and that product squads remain focused on product delivery.
 



 We are looking for a candidate who is energized by high\-tempo environments, comfortable engaging directly with customers, and capable of managing multiple priorities under pressure. Strong judgment in prioritization and effective delegation are essential.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Requests \& Customer\-Facing Support** 



* Own the intake, prioritization, and resolution of all internal engineering requests (data exports, credit adjustments, technical investigations, one\-off scripts).
* Define and enforce SLAs to provide customer\-facing teams with clear expectations and predictable response times.
* Serve as the primary engineering point of contact for the L3 support team, meeting regularly to unblock escalations and ensure timely resolution.



**Data Migrations** 



* Own the data migration process end\-to\-end: intake, scoping, execution, and validation.
* Design, build, and improve migration pipelines to significantly reduce turnaround times.
* Troubleshoot and debug migration failures across the full stack (application, database, infrastructure).
* Data migrations are among Manatal's highest\-stakes operational challenges and a key driver of customer retention.



**Software Development \& Tooling** 



* Write production code across Manatal's backend (Python/Django, FastAPI) and frontend (Vue.js, React) codebases to fix bugs, implement operational improvements, and connect systems.

We're hiring a Principal Consultant \- ICT to help lead and grow ESSURA's ICT practice across the UK and MENA.
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on role with real scope to shape how we work. You'll lead ICT design from concept through to commissioning, and play a key part on the commercial side too \- scoping and pricing engagements, helping keep projects on budget, supporting client relationships, and turning client RfPs into strong, winning proposals.
 



  





 It's a fit if you bring:
 



  





 ➔ 8\+ years in client\-facing ICT consultancy, with major GCC building projects behind you
 



 ➔ Expert\-level knowledge across structured cabling, wired/wireless networks, AV and BMS/IoT
 



 ➔ A solid commercial head \- comfortable scoping, pricing and managing work to budget
 



 ➔ Experience contributing to business development activities, building client relationships, and helping shape and win bids
 



 ➔ The confidence to converse on cyber and OT security and lead specialist resource \- including sub\-contractors \- in delivery (a growing area for us; deep technical specialism not required)
 



 ➔ A collaborative approach and the credibility to act as a trusted adviser to clients and project teams
 



  





 BICSI RCDD certification is highly regarded, and experience delivering major GCC projects is essential. Candidates who bring both will be particularly well aligned to the role.
 



  





 It's probably not the right fit if you're early\-career or purely technical and prefer to stay away from the client and commercial side.
 



  





 We're deliberately not using Easy Apply. If this sounds like you, please email
 **hr@essura.com** 
 with a short note on one ICT project you helped scope, win and deliver \- and what your part in it was. We'll then share the full job description and next steps.

data.jd_text:
**About j. awan \& partners** 




  





 At j. awan \& partners, we believe in “challenging the status quo every day”, delivering seamless excellence to our customers across the world. We challenge the status quo by making tailor\-made solutions to meet the specific requirements of our clients’ business interests and delivering our solutions to their needs with effective simplicity. We understand that time is precious and as
 



 such our tailor\-made solutions are simple to understand, simple to embed and simple to use.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing international Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultancy with our headquarters in the Dubai International Finance Centre (DIFC). We also have our own Technology company creating bespoke cutting\-edge RegTech solutions. Our business presence covers multiple jurisdictions with offices in the UAE, KSA, UK \& Ireland, Singapore, Porto, Pakistan, Qatar and South Africa. We provide Regulatory Governance, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Recruitment and Technology services to many clients including global, regional and local financial services institutions, governments and other industry partners.
 



  





**Mission / Purpose of the Role** 




  





 The Senior Manager – Compliance role will lead and oversee regulatory compliance and AML/CTF obligations across a portfolio of client mandates within the Region. The role ensures clients are fully aligned with regulatory expectations by implementing best\-in\-class compliance frameworks, conducting ongoing monitoring, and serving as the principal regulatory liaison. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the role drives business growth by converting existing relationships into new opportunities and supporting the expansion of the compliance practice across our operating jurisdictions. This position plays a critical role in safeguarding regulatory integrity, strengthening client trust, and elevating JAP’s compliance standards across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





**12 – 18 Month Mission Outcomes** 




**Mission / Outcome** 




  





**Act as a trusted outsourced Compliance Officer and MLRO.** 



* Timely execution of compliance deliverables; clients’ regulatory obligations consistently met.
* Effective communication with Regulators.



  





**Deliver high\-quality Regulatory Compliance and AML services to clients.** 



* Applications submitted on schedule; licences obtained with minimal Regulator queries or rejections. Positive client feedback. No material regulatory breaches or audit findings.



  





**Develop and implement robust Compliance and AML frameworks and training programs.** 



* Policies aligned with regulatory requirements; regular AML and Compliance training conducted, resulting in improved compliance awareness among clients.



  





**Audit, monitor, and improve compliance processes.** 



* Regular compliance reviews completed; identified gaps addressed with corrective action; internal controls strengthened.



  





**Manage and expand the compliance client portfolio while supporting business growth across the Region.** 



* New business opportunities identified and supported. Strengthened client retention and satisfaction. Growth in brand visibility and market presence.



  





**Continuously improve compliance and AML/CTF systems.** 



* Implementation of new processes, tools, or automation; measurable reduction in compliance risks; adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Strengthen business development and client engagement.** 



* New client acquisitions; increased market share and revenue from compliance services; successful representation at industry events.



  





**Contribute to firm culture, brand, and people development.** 



* Positive internal and external stakeholder feedback. Support in recruitment and retention initiatives. Active mentorship and knowledge sharing within the team.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Regulatory Compliance Delivery** 



* Provide ongoing compliance and AML support to clients.
* Draft, implement, and manage compliance and AML frameworks.
* Ensure adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Compliance deliverables completed on time.
* Policies and procedures aligned with latest laws.
* No material compliance issues.



  





**Audit \& Monitoring** 



* Coordinate internal/external audits.
* Conduct compliance reviews and spot checks.
* Identify and remediate control weaknesses.
* Compliance reviews completed on schedule.
* Gaps addressed with corrective action.
* Strengthened internal controls.



  





**Training \& Awareness** 



* Deliver training on compliance, AML, and governance topics.
* Build client awareness of emerging regulations and risks.
* Client confirmation of effective and timely training delivery.
* Full client participation with positive feedback.
* Relevant regulatory updates delivered to clients.



  





**Business Development \& Brand Representation** 



* Support senior team in executing client mandates.
* Help with origination of new business.
* Represent the Firm at industry and promotional events.
* Positive feedback from senior team.
* New business opportunities identified and supported.
* Active participation in events.



  





**Leadership \& Communication** 



* Communicate compliance risks and obligations to senior management.
* Foster relationships with stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and clients.
* Represent consultancy professionally.
* Effective risk communication.
* Strong stakeholder relationships.
* Professional representation at all levels.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on regulatory developments.
* Refine compliance/AML systems, processes, and training.
* Implement best practices.
* Implementation of improved processes/tools.
* Measurable reduction in compliance risk.
* Adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Team \& Culture** 



* Promote j. awan \& partners’ culture and brand.
* Support talent attraction and retention.
* Coach and mentor junior team members.
* Positive internal engagement scores.
* Contribution to team development initiatives.
* Evidence of mentorship and knowledge sharing.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Regulatory Expertise \& Strategic Mindset: Demonstrable experience engaging with regulatory authorities across the region, with the ability to design and implement compliance programs that mitigate risk and drive organisational effectiveness.
* Operational Excellence: Experienced in executing compliance and AML programs efficiently, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and adherence to deadlines across multiple client mandates.
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills: Exceptional capability to analyse complex regulatory issues, interpret requirements, and translate them into actionable, fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Integrity \& Accountability: Upholds the highest professional and ethical standards, maintains confidentiality, and demonstrates reliability and accountability in all activities.
* Stakeholder Management \& Cultural Agility: Skilled at building partnerships and influencing clients, regulators, and internal teams, with the adaptability to work effectively across diverse organisations and cultural contexts.



  





**Role\-Specific Competencies** 



* Compliance \& AML Expertise: Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and overseeing regulatory compliance and AML frameworks within financial services, with proven ability to manage obligations across applicable regulatory regimes including but not limited to DFSA, ADGM, QFCRA, FCA, and CMA.
* KYC \& Regulatory Delivery: Proven KYC and due diligence capability including risk classification and SLA\-driven delivery, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, fit\-for\-purpose policies and procedures.
* Organisation \& Execution: Strong ability to manage multiple compliance projects and competing deadlines simultaneously, working independently under pressure while maintaining accuracy and quality of delivery.
* Stakeholder \& Communication Skills: Exceptional oral and written communication skills for effective interaction with clients, regulators, and senior leadership, with strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain productive working relationships.



  





**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or Accountancy.



  





**Experience** 



* Significant demonstrable experience in dealing with regulatory authorities within the Region.
* Minimum 8 years overall industry experience, with at least 4 years in Compliance roles within Financial Services.
* Direct experience in developing and implementing compliance programs is essential.
* Direct experience in creating and implementing regulatory compliance programs within a successful financial services organisation.



  





**Additional Requirements** 



* CAMS, CISI, or ICA qualifications preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

data.jd_text:
Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes. The investments we make are strategically chosen and thoughtfully nurtured, mirroring Dubai’s ambition, spirit and energy. As a global investor, asset owner and developer we utilise our resources, know\-how and connections, to deliver long\-term value, wherever we operate. Our portfolio spans Lifestyle \& Entertainment, Destinations, Real Estate, Hospitality, and F\&B, including Skydive Dubai, Deep Dive Dubai, XDubai, Dubai Harbour, Kite Beach and more.
   

  

 As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Manager \- Communications** 
 . In this role you will support the Director of PR \& Communications in shaping and protecting the corporate reputation of the Group, driving strategic communications across the holding entity and its portfolio, and strengthening executive visibility through structured media engagement and thought leadership positioning.
   

  

 The role will lead media relations and external communications strategy across both corporate (B2B/investment) and B2C portfolio narratives, while overseeing execution through Manager/Assistant Managers responsible for internal and external communications.
   

  

**Corporate Communications Strategy**
* Support the Director in developing and implementing an integrated corporate communications strategy aligned with the Group’s investment mandate and long\-term vision.
* Articulate the Group’s investment philosophy, portfolio growth narrative, and economic contribution in a clear, consistent manner.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across business verticals and portfolio entities.
* Contribute to positioning the Group as a credible, forward\-looking investment platform regionally and internationally.


**Executive \& Thought Leadership Positioning**
* Develop and execute a structured CEO and executive spokesperson positioning plan.
* Identify high\-impact speaking opportunities, editorial placements, and industry forums.
* Draft speeches, op\-eds, interviews, and key messaging for senior leadership.
* Build a sustained thought leadership platform aligned with strategic priorities and national development narratives.


**Media Relations \& Reputation Management**
* Own relationships with key regional and international media outlets.
* Develop proactive media engagement strategies to strengthen brand equity and share of voice.
* Manage media briefings, interviews, and press interactions.
* Lead crisis communications planning and response in coordination with the Director.
* Monitor media coverage and sentiment, providing strategic insights and risk mitigation recommendations.


**Investment \& Portfolio Communications**
* Translate complex investment activity into compelling narratives suitable for media, stakeholders, and public audiences.
* Support announcement strategies for acquisitions, partnerships, launches, and major milestones.
* Oversee development of press materials, corporate statements, and media kits.
* Ensure portfolio brands’ communications align with Group reputation standards.


**B2C PR \& Brand Communications**
* Drive public\-facing PR strategies across lifestyle, real estate, hospitality, and experiential assets within the portfolio.
* Collaborate with Marketing teams to amplify major launches and initiatives.
* Ensure consistent brand storytelling across earned media channels.


**Internal Communications Oversight**
* Provide direction to Assistant Manager \- Internal Communications to ensure consistent messaging across the organization.
* Support leadership communications, town halls, and employee engagement initiatives.
* Ensure internal narratives align with external positioning.


**Governance \& Compliance**
* Establish and maintain communications governance frameworks.
* Ensure message discipline and approval processes are adhered to across the Group.
* Maintain crisis communications protocols and escalation pathways.


**Agency \& Partner Management**
* Oversee PR agency performance, scope alignment, and strategic direction.
* Manage budgets allocated to communications initiatives.
* Ensure agencies deliver measurable media impact aligned with corporate objectives.
* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related field.
* 10\-14 years of experience in corporate communications, public relations, or reputation management.
* Experience within an investment firm, sovereign wealth fund, holding company, or large diversified conglomerate preferred.
* Demonstrated experience supporting executive leadership positioning.
* Proven track record managing high\-level media engagement and complex announcements.


**Personal Attributes**
* High credibility and executive presence.
* Discreet, politically astute, and trusted with sensitive information.
* Calm and decisive under pressure.
* Strategic thinker with strong operational discipline.
* Commercially aware with understanding of investment environments.
* Collaborative leader capable of guiding junior communications professionals.


**For more information about Shamal, please visit our LinkedIn page** 
 https//www.linkedin.com/company/shamalholding/
   

  

**Note**
 Due to a high influx of profiles, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

data.jd_text:
The Loyalty \& Personalization Director is responsible for defining and delivering a best\-in\-class customer loyalty strategy across a multi\-asset leisure and entertainment portfolio.
 



 This role leads the development of a comprehensive loyalty ecosystem designed to drive customer acquisition, retention, engagement, and lifetime value, while enhancing the overall customer experience.
 



 The position will work cross\-functionally with marketing, commercial, digital, operations, and insights teams to design and execute a data\-led loyalty and membership strategy, ensuring alignment with broader business objectives.
 



 The Loyalty \& Personalization Director will own the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle strategy, including product development, engagement frameworks, partner integrations, and performance optimization.
 



  





 Loyalty Strategy \& Membership Program
 



  





 • Develop and deliver a customer loyalty and membership strategy aligned with long\-term business growth objectives (revenue, frequency, and customer lifetime value).
 



 • Own the performance of the membership program, including acquisition, retention, engagement, and yield optimization.
 



 • Design and optimize the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle, from onboarding through to repeat engagement and advocacy.
 



 • Lead the development of exclusive experiences, benefits, and value propositions to strengthen customer loyalty and increase incremental spend.
 



 • Collaborate with insights and analytics teams to forecast trends, monitor performance, and identify growth opportunities.
 



 • Establish frameworks to measure customer satisfaction and program effectiveness, driving continuous improvement.
 



 • Lead cross\-functional governance forums to ensure alignment and ownership of loyalty initiatives across the business.
 



 • Identify and develop strategic partnerships to enhance the overall loyalty proposition and expand customer reach.
 



 • Segment customer audiences based on behaviors, preferences, and value, and define targeted strategies to drive growth across segments.
 



  





 Stakeholder Management
 



  





 • Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment on strategic priorities.
 



 • Act as the central point of contact for all loyalty\-related initiatives, ensuring clear communication and delivery against objectives.
 



  





 Team Leadership
 



  





 • Lead and develop a high\-performing loyalty team.
 



 • Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
 



 • Ensure the team delivers measurable ROI across all loyalty and engagement initiatives.
 



 • Monitor competitive activity and industry trends to identify innovation opportunities.
 



  





 Project Management
 



  





 • Lead the development and delivery of key loyalty and customer experience projects.
 



 • Manage cross\-functional teams to deliver initiatives on time and within budget.
 



 • Oversee planning, prioritization, risk management, and stakeholder alignment.
 



 • Present progress, risks, and outcomes to senior leadership.
 



  





 Digital Customer Experience
 



  





 • Oversee the optimization of the digital customer journey across all platforms (web, app, CRM systems).
 



 • Ensure seamless integration between digital touchpoints and the broader loyalty ecosystem.
 



 • Drive continuous improvement in conversion, engagement, and revenue performance through digital channels.
 



  





 Commercial \& Reporting
 



  





 • Define and track key performance metrics, translating insights into actionable strategies.
 



 • Lead the development of strategic reports, forecasts, and executive presentations.
 



 • Support budget planning and ensure efficient allocation of resources across initiatives.
 



 • Evaluate campaign and program performance, identifying opportunities for optimization and growth.
 



  





 Required:
 



 Educated to degree level or equivalent in Marketing
 



 Minimum 10 years of Marketing experience
 



 Worked in Loyalty Function
 



 Creative thinker and customer focused
 



 Commercially astute, data\-driven and results oriented
 



 Resourceful, pro\-active and innovative thinker
 



 Strong project management skills and deadline driven
 



 Ability to navigate a busy and challenging environment
 



 Strong presentation skills in both public speaking and PowerPoint format
 



 Solid attention to detail
 



 Agency management
 



 Analytical in thinking and able to manipulate data in Excel
 



 Strong copywriting skills
 



  





 Preferred:
 



 Worked in entertainment venues
 



 Worked in the UAE or GCC countries in a marketing environment
 



 Fluent Arabic speaker and writer
 



 Event management

data.jd_text:
****Job Description:****
**VIE 2026 \- DUBAI\- Airline Marketing Analyst**
****Description du poste****
**Le Volontariat International en Entreprise est un programme unique au monde sponsorisé par les Ministères français de l’Europe et des Affaires Etrangères, du Ministère de l’Economie et des Finances et du Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires et qui permet à Airbus d'offrir à de jeunes professionnels la possibilité d'acquérir une expérience rémunérée et valorisante à l'étranger, dans un métier technique ou commercial.**
**Le programme VIE est un contrat spécifique, en vertu des critères d'éligibilité de Business France. Principaux critères d'exigibilité du VIE :**
* Être citoyen(ne) de l'Union Européenne (plus Norvège, Islande et Liechtenstein), et candidat(e) diplômé(e) âgé(e) de 28 ans maximum (une mission V.I.E peut débuter au plus tard le jour du vingt\-neuvième anniversaire )
* Avoir accompli les obligations militaires de son pays.
* Être impérativement inscrit sur le site Mon Volontariat International avant les 28 ans


**Pour plus d'informations : https://mon\-vie\-via.businessfrance.fr/ (en anglais, en allemand, en italien et en espagnol).**
**La durée d’un VIE est de 6 à 24 mois en fonction du lieu d’affectation.**
**Un poste sous contrat VIE Airline Marketing Analyst est à pourvoir au sein d’
 **Airbus Commercial Aircraft** 
 à
 **Dubai** 
 . Vous rejoindrez
 **AME Marketing Team****
**Missions et responsabilités :**
**Poste d'analyste marketing**
**L'organisation Airline Marketing recherche des analystes dynamiques et talentueux pour renforcer et assurer l'avenir d'Airbus Marketing dans le monde.**
**Le poste sera basé dans la région avec une période initiale à Toulouse pour la formation. Le bureau régional est responsable des clients dans sa région.**
**Vous participerez au programme d'initiation au marketing, qui comprend une formation de 3 à 4 mois suivie d'une formation en cours d'emploi et d'un mentorat, pour vous doter de tous les outils, du réseau et des compétences nécessaires pour réussir dans le domaine.**
**Le rôle consistera à soutenir l'analyse des campagnes de vente sur un certain nombre de comptes avec le soutien des membres de l'équipe senior.**
**Vous serez rattaché(e) au Head of Airline Marketing pour la région.**
**Le rôle pourrait se concentrer sur la commercialisation d'avions ou le portefeuille de services d'Airbus.**
**Tâches et responsabilités**
**Assurer la perception optimale du produit Airbus par le client par rapport au concurrent comme une étape clé pour le succès de la campagne de vente et maximiser la reconnaissance de la valeur de la solution Airbus.**
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le directeur marketing sur les comptes assignés pour fournir une analyse marketing convaincante, une argumentation et des présentations influençant l'évaluation de l'avion d'un client et sa décision d'achat.
* Développer une compréhension de tous les aspects des exigences d'une compagnie aérienne, des moteurs d'activité des compagnies aériennes, de l'évolution des exigences de la flotte et du réseau, des modèles de génération de revenus et de bénéfices.
* Fournir des performances d'avion et une analyse économique sur Airbus et les avions concurrents pour les comptes assignés.
* Développer des documents appropriés qui démontrent la supériorité d'Airbus dans la réalisation des besoins des clients.
* Présenter et interagir avec le client ainsi qu'avec les membres de l'équipe senior
* Fournir des commentaires internes et soutenir les améliorations des méthodes et des outils de marketing.
* Interagir avec d'autres domaines du marketing / Airbus pour améliorer l'analyse et l'argumentation marketing.
* Être proactif, créatif, axé sur le client, axé sur le travail d'équipe, innovateur et avoir un esprit combatif.


**Compétences requises**
* Diplôme en ingéniérie aérospatial et en commerce de préférence
* Expérience en marketing ou en vente B2B (une expérience en analyse de données serait un plus)
* Solides compétences analytiques
* Les performances et l'économie des aéronefs sont un atout majeur
* Solides compétences en communication et en présentation
* Orientation client
* Esprit Créatif et Innovation
* Capacité à gérer des tâches complexes
* Esprit d'équipe
* Persistance
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome
* Capacité à travailler dans un environnement à haute pression et avec des délais changeants


**Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience de tous les risques potentiels de conformité et un engagement à agir avec intégrité, comme fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.**
**VIE 2026 \- DUBAI\- Airline Marketing Analyst**
****Description Of The Job****
**The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) is a unique international program sponsored by the French Ministries of Europe and Foreign Affairs, the Ministry of Economy and Finance and the Ministry of Ecological Transition and Territorial Cohesion, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function.**

data.jd_text:
Our client is a leading FMCG manufacturer with a portfolio of well\-established brands operating across multiple channels and markets. As part of their continued growth strategy, they are seeking an experienced Commercial Director to lead the overall commercial agenda, drive sustainable revenue growth, and strengthen market leadership
 **.** 




  





  





 The Commercial Director will be responsible for developing and executing the commercial strategy across sales, key accounts, distributors, and strategic customer relationships. This is a pivotal role requiring a blend of strategic vision, commercial acumen, and operational excellence.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute the company's commercial strategy in line with overall business objectives.
* Drive sustainable growth in revenue, market share, and profitability.
* Lead and develop high\-performing sales and commercial teams.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key customers, distributors, retailers, and strategic partners.
* Negotiate major commercial agreements and long\-term customer partnerships.
* Identify new business opportunities, routes to market, and growth channels.
* Ensure effective pricing, trade investment, promotional planning, and margin management.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, and Product teams to deliver business objectives.
* Analyse market trends, customer insights, and competitive activity to inform commercial decisions.
* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and annual business planning processes.
* Establish clear performance metrics and drive a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Represent the business externally with customers, industry bodies, and key stakeholders.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Proven experience in a senior commercial leadership role such as Commercial Director, Sales Director, Business Director, or General Manager within FMCG, consumer goods, manufacturing, food \& beverage, building materials, or a related sector.
* Demonstrated success delivering significant revenue growth and commercial transformation.
* Strong experience managing key accounts, distributors, and multi\-channel sales environments.
* Excellent understanding of commercial strategy, pricing, profitability, and P\&L management.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate plans into measurable business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related discipline. MBA advantageous.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 We are seeking a commercially driven leader who combines strategic vision with strong execution capability. The successful candidate will be an inspiring people leader, a trusted business partner, and a highly credible commercial professional capable of delivering growth in a dynamic and competitive environment.
 



  





 This represents an excellent opportunity to join a successful organisation and play a key role in shaping its future growth and market position.

Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes. The investments we make are strategically chosen and thoughtfully nurtured, mirroring Dubai’s ambition, spirit and energy. As a global investor, asset owner and developer we utilise our resources, know\-how and connections, to deliver long\-term value, wherever we operate.
   

  

 As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Director \- Contracts** 
 . In this role you will provide contractual and commercial support to the Development department within Shamal. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both pre and post\-contract management across multiple project sectors within the UAE. The role requires strong negotiation skills, a broad knowledge of local regulations and the ability to manage contracts throughout the entire project lifecycle from inception to completion.
   

  

* Responsible for the management of all contractual activities within the Development team.
* Assist with tender/request for proposal process from pre\-qualification through to tender analysis and recommendation to Shamal Tender Committee.
* Lead contract negotiations to ensure terms and conditions align with Shamal’s objectives and company policies, and coordinate internally with Shamal Legal, Governance \& Compliance/Finance/Insurance teams to mitigate identified commercial risks.
* Drafting of contractual documentation including various forms of construction contract (lump sum, measured price, two\-stage), consultancy, settlement, novation, assignment agreements).
* Prepare high\-level commercial risk reports for non\-negotiable contracts and clear commercial instructions for bespoke contracts.
* Post\-contract assessment of contractor/consultant invoices/payment applications/recommendations, and entitlement to variations / extension of time and cost claims.
* Responsible for the management of post\-contract administration of contracts and monitor contractor/consultant compliance with contractual terms \& conditions and scope of services in collaboration with the relevant project teams.
* Review and provide feedback on sale \& purchase agreement governance documentation/master community declarations/building management statements.
* Preparation of project correspondence and contractual notices, including for breach, suspension and termination.
* Review and provide internal feedback on bank guarantees, taking\-over certificates and defects liability certificates.
* Ensure strict compliance with Development team delegation of authority, policies, procedures and templates, and identify potential improvements to maximise efficiency.
* Manage consultant/contractor dispute resolution and settlement matters in close coordination with the Legal team.
* Relevant Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, engineering or similar.
* RICS/MRICS accreditation is a plus.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience with at least 5 years in a managerial role within the UAE real estate Developer or construction sector.
* Strong understanding of local laws, regulations and industry practice in the UAE.
* Extensive experience in the FIDIC suite of contracts.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills with the ability to liaise effectively with internal teams, contractors, consultants and local authorities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess risk, manage changes and proactively implement solutions.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational skills and the ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a visionary and commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative strategy and brand direction across our portfolio of luxury perfume and food \& beverage brands. The Creative Director will be responsible for shaping and elevating brand identity, customer experience, product storytelling, marketing campaigns, retail design, and visual communication to ensure a consistent and compelling brand presence across all customer touchpoints.
 



 This role requires a blend of creativity, strategic thinking, leadership, and commercial awareness to drive brand growth, customer engagement, and market differentiation.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Creative Leadership \& Brand Strategy
 


* Define and lead the creative vision for all brands within the luxury perfume and F\&B portfolio.
* Develop and maintain strong brand identities, ensuring consistency across all channels and customer touchpoints.
* Drive innovative creative concepts that strengthen brand positioning and support business objectives.
* Ensure all creative outputs reflect the premium and luxury standards of the Group.



 Marketing \& Campaign Development
 


* Lead the conceptualization and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, seasonal activations, and promotional initiatives.
* Oversee creative direction for digital, social media, print, outdoor advertising, packaging, and in\-store communications.
* Collaborate closely with marketing teams to create impactful customer engagement strategies.
* Review and approve all creative assets before release.



 Product \& Packaging Innovation
 


* Direct the creative development of perfume packaging, gifting solutions, product presentation, and visual merchandising.
* Collaborate with product development teams to ensure product concepts align with brand positioning and market trends.
* Drive innovation in packaging design, customer experience, and brand storytelling.



 Retail Experience \& Visual Merchandising
 


* Lead creative direction for retail stores, kiosks, pop\-ups, and experiential activations.
* Ensure visual merchandising standards are consistently implemented across all locations.
* Partner with design and operations teams to enhance customer journeys and elevate brand experiences.
* Oversee store branding, signage, and retail design concepts.



 Content \& Storytelling
 


* Develop compelling brand narratives that resonate with target audiences across luxury fragrance and hospitality sectors.
* Direct creative content production including photography, videography, digital content, and social media campaigns.
* Ensure all content aligns with the brand's tone of voice and aesthetic standards.



 Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing creative team, including designers, content creators, visual merchandisers, and external agencies.
* Foster a culture of creativity, innovation, and collaboration.
* Work closely with senior leadership, brand managers, operations, and marketing teams to align creative initiatives with business goals.
* Manage relationships with creative agencies, production houses, photographers, and other external partners.



 Trend Analysis \& Innovation
 


* Stay abreast of global luxury retail, fragrance, hospitality, design, and consumer trends.
* Identify emerging opportunities and translate market insights into creative strategies.
* Continuously challenge existing approaches to keep brands relevant, distinctive, and competitive.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's Degree in Design, Creative Arts, Marketing, Branding, Communications, or a related field.
* Minimum 10–15 years of creative leadership experience within luxury retail, fragrances, beauty, fashion, hospitality, or premium consumer brands.
* Proven track record of building and growing luxury brands through innovative creative direction.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in branding, campaigns, retail experiences, packaging, and content creation.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary creative teams and external agencies.



 Key Skills \& Competencies
 


* Creative vision and strategic thinking
* Luxury brand development and management
* Marketing campaign leadership
* Retail and customer experience design
* Visual storytelling and content creation
* Packaging and product design oversight
* Leadership and team development
* Commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management and presentation skills
* Strong understanding of digital and social media platforms



 Success Measures
 


* Strengthened brand equity and market positioning.
* Increased customer engagement and brand loyalty.
* Successful execution of product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Consistent luxury brand experience across all channels.
* Growth in brand awareness, footfall, and commercial performance.

Lead the City Technology Project Management Office (PMO) responsible for portfolio governance, delivery assurance, demand intake, stage\-gate control, and operational readiness across all IT and OT technology towers within QIC City Technology.
   

  

 This role ensures that City Technology programs and vendors deliver technology solutions in a controlled, auditable manner, and that all deliverables meet defined governance requirements for readiness, documentation, cybersecurity gating, and transition into
 **technology L2/L3 support** 
 .
   

  

 The PMO acts as the control tower for all City Technology projects transitioning into run\-state operations.
   

  

**Reporting Line**
 Reports to:
 **Director — Technology Governance, Architecture, Budget, ITSM Standards \& PMO**
**Direct Reports:** 
 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts
   

  

**Role Scope (City Technology Only)**
**In scope delivery and handover domains, including, but not limited to:**
* City Business Applications
* City Platforms (integration/IoT/data)
* City OT \& Smart Systems technology
* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& Handover Governance Framework (City Technology)
* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Ensure all delivery teams and vendors comply with governance controls
* Integrated Program Controls
* Maintain an integrated view of City Technology delivery progress across towers and suppliers
* Track delivery milestones, critical path items, and cross\-tower dependencies
* Identify schedule slippage, scope creep, and delivery risk early and escalate through governance forums
* Stage Gates \& Assurance (Delivery\-to\-Run)
* Govern and enforce delivery stage gates, including:
* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support
* Ensure no system progresses through gates without evidence and sign\-offs


**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)
* Own RAID governance standards across all City Technology delivery programs
* Ensure RAID logs are complete, current, and actionable
* Run dependency reviews and cross\-tower issue resolution sessions
* Escalate unresolved risks/issues to the appropriate governance level
* Delivery Reporting \& Executive Packs
* Produce standardized delivery reporting packs including:
* Schedule health (RAG)
* Delivery risk exposure
* Dependency hotspots
* Milestone achievement
* Vendor delivery performance indicators
* Readiness risks for transition to technology support
* Ensure reporting is auditable and consistent across towers
* Vendor Delivery \& Handover Governance Support (non\-commercial)
* Ensure vendors comply with City Technology Delivery \& Handover Governance requirements:
+ Reporting cadence
+ Evidence packs
+ Stage\-gate readiness
+ Documentation standards

* Provide delivery performance evidence to:
+ Commercials/Vendor Management function (for contract governance)
+ City Technology leadership (for escalation)

* Alignment to Governance, Architecture, and Cybersecurity
* Ensure delivery programs comply with:
+ corporate technology governance processes (where applicable)
+ City Technology governance and architecture standards
+ design authority requirements (IT/OT/physical security/platforms/data)
+ cybersecurity gating requirements
+ Track and report exceptions and required waivers through the correct forums


**Key Interfaces**
**Internal:**
* Director — City Technology Governance \& Architecture
* Tower Directors (Apps / OT / Physical Security / Platforms / Infrastructure / Cybersecurity)
* City ITSM governance and assurance function
* Director — City Technology Operations (City) (for transition readiness alignment only)
* Finance / budgeting governance stakeholders


**External:**
* Systems Integrators
* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**
* % of City Technology programs compliant with Delivery \& Handover Governance reporting cadence
* Stage\-gate compliance rate (% passing with complete evidence)
* % of projects with maintained baseline (scope/schedule/cost)
* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)
* Reduction in incidents caused by poor delivery transition within first 30 days of go\-live


**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**
* Define acceptance criteria for transition from Project to Operations
* Ensure support documentation, runbooks, monitoring, SLAs and vendor contracts are in place
* Validate security hardening and compliance sign\-offs
* Coordinate CAB approvals and go\-live governance
* Confirm training and knowledge transfer completion


**Portfolio \& Financial Governance**
* Track total technology investment portfolio (CAPEX and transformation OPEX)
* Align with Finance for forecasting accuracy
* Monitor cost variance and earned value performance
* Maintain benefits realization tracking framework


**Stakeholder Management**
* Engage Directors across all City Technology tower
* Interface with Corporate PMO and Enterprise Architecture
* Present executive updates to Technology Steering Committee
* Coordinate with Procurement and Legal for contract governance alignment


**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles
* Experience in complex multi\-domain environments, ideally including:
+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management
+ dependency management
+ reporting and executive governance packs

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments
* PMP or equivalent certification required
* Agile/Scrum or SAFe certification preferred
* ITIL knowledge required
* Strong financial governance and executive reporting capability

data.jd_text:
👋 Thanks for taking the time to learn more about this role at 9H!
 



  





 Managing Director \- Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
 



  





 Location: Riyadh, KSA (in\-Kingdom) ·
 



 Reports to: Board · Experience: 10\+ years ·
 



 Mandate: P\&L, commercial and delivery ·
 



 Start: ASAP, before October
 



  





 The opportunity
 



 TAYB a tech\-led strategic partner spanning brand \& reach, technology \& solutions, and AI \& automation. 
 



 We are moving from a single executive commercial channel to a durable structure with one accountable owner in\-region. This is that role. The Managing Director takes ownership of the Gulf P\&L as our founding partner transitions to a non\-executive board seat — inheriting strong key accounts, and given the engine to win new ones.
 



  





 The role — run the A–Z of the venture
 



 A full general\-management mandate with a commercial heart. The MD owns the number, the clients, and the team that delivers for them.
 


* Own the Gulf P\&L: full accountability for revenue, margin and the cost base of the KSA venture.
* Protect and grow key accounts: take personal handover of existing strategic relationships, become the trusted senior point of contact, and drive retention and upsell.
* Drive the new\-logo pipeline: own origination and conversion personally, and build it as a repeatable engine rather than a series of one\-off wins.
* Build and run the commercial layer: manage a performance\-led network of senior Gulf rainmakers plus internal commercial colleagues — qualification standards, pipeline discipline, and the 90\-day performance gates.
* Orchestrate delivery: direct on\-ground account leads and the Egypt delivery team, with a structured KSA travel cadence, so delivery quality matches the relationship.
* Represent TAYB at the top of the room: C\-suite, family offices, ministerial and semi\-government settings, and navigate Etimad, procurement frameworks and approved\-vendor ecosystems.
* Be the board's eyes in the Kingdom: honest reporting on pipeline, cash and market, flagging the accelerate\-or\-hold calls early.



  





 Who you are — essential
 


* 10\+ years' experience in senior commercial or general\-management roles, with a clear track record of carrying and hitting a number.
* From a similar business — agency, digital, technology, consulting or professional services — with a real understanding of how this model makes money and how it delivers.
* End\-to\-end capability: comfortable running the whole venture — commercial, delivery oversight, team, and the P\&L behind it.
* Strong Gulf network: real, current senior relationships across KSA and the wider Gulf that can be activated from day one.
* Based in Riyadh, in\-Kingdom, and able to travel the Gulf as the business requires.



  





 Who you are — strongly preferred
 


* KSA market fluency: first\-hand experience of Vision 2030 programmes, government and semi\-government buying, and Etimad / vendor frameworks.
* Arabic and English: professional working proficiency in both; Arabic a strong advantage for senior relationship\-building.
* Builder's mindset: has stood up or scaled a market, function or office — not only managed a mature one.
* People leadership: experience leading distributed teams across borders and time zones.
* Cash\-aware: manages growth against the cash position, not in spite of it.



  





 How you work
 



 Commercially relentless · owner, not passenger · relationship\-led · hands\-on · straight with the board · calm under pace · across both detail and the big picture.
 



  





 What success looks like
 


* 100% of key accounts retained through the transition.
* A single accountable owner of the Gulf P\&L (the A–Z of the venture).
* A repeatable new\-logo engine, not one\-off wins.



  





 What we offer
 


* A market with proven demand: real revenue, signed logos, and a credible base to build from — not a standing start.
* Genuine ownership: the autonomy of a founding GM with the backing of an established group and board.
* A performance\-led commercial engine: a rainmaker network and delivery teams ready to run behind the MD.
* Competitive package: senior base plus performance\-linked upside, structured for a commercially focused leader.

**Job Description**
 The Senior Commercial Director for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait is responsible for shaping and executing a long‑term (3–5 year) commercial strategy with a strong focus on accelerating growth in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia—one of Hilton’s most strategically important markets, expected to exceed 100 hotels within five years.
   

  

 This role leads the development of the value proposition and investment cases required to unlock this growth, ensuring the right commercial foundations are established across Sales, Marketing, Distribution, and Revenue functions. The appointee will assess organizational design needs, budget requirements, talent capabilities, and performance enablers needed for sustained market leadership.
   

  

 The Senior Commercial Director is accountable for delivering top‑tier commercial performance across the three markets and driving market share growth. The role includes hiring, developing, and mentoring high‑potential talent, ensuring alignment with Hilton’s strategic priorities while fostering a culture that reflects Hilton’s values.
   

  

 A critical success factor is the ability to build strong, influential partnerships with senior commercial leaders, regional and brand teams, GMs, ownership groups, and cross‑functional stakeholders. The role requires exceptional communication, analytical rigor, and strategic thinking to solve complex business challenges and enable sustained success.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What will I be doing?**
**Business Acumen**
* Partner with the VP Commercial Services and Commercial Director MEA to develop long‑term regional strategy, business cases, and stakeholder alignment.
* Serve as the commercial business partner to the VP Operations for KSA, Bahrain, and Kuwait.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Commercial Director, enabling them to own near‑term tactical execution.
* Support new hotel openings from a commercial perspective, leveraging Hilton’s full commercial engine (RMCC, HWS, shared sales offices, Marketing, F\&B, HRCC).
* Translate organizational goals into clear performance standards for the Commercial Services team.


**Setting Strategy**
* Develop medium‑ and long‑term commercial strategies to drive sustained, above‑market revenue performance across all three markets.
* Clearly communicate strategic priorities, progress, and results to internal and external stakeholders.
* Gain senior‑level alignment and sponsorship for key initiatives required to deliver strategic outcomes.
* Lead strategic planning within the Commercial Services team to advance enterprise goals and ensure consistent communication.


**Executing for Results**
* Lead negotiations with third‑party partners and suppliers as required.
* Collaborate cross‑functionally with Revenue, Sales, F\&B, Marketing, eCommerce, and Finance teams, as well as commercial leadership across MEA and EMEA.
* Ensure all commercial initiatives are effectively planned, resourced, and executed.
* Drive integrated commercial action across functions to maximize RevPAR and market share.


**Leading Teams**
* Ensure Commercial Services teams provide strong support to on‑property commercial teams.
* Build and maintain a high‑performing talent pipeline, developing future leaders and succession plans.
* Create a culture of performance, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Building Relationships and Influencing**
* Develop strong relationships across senior leadership to enable alignment and collaboration.
* Strengthen partnerships with MEA and EMEA commercial teams to elevate commercial performance.
* Maintain effective coordination with global commercial functions, including Database Management, HRCC, Distribution, and Channel Management.
* Represent the commercial function at property visits, corporate meetings, owner meetings, and business reviews.


**Qualifications**
**What are we looking for?**
* Demonstrated experience operating at a regional level with responsibility for a portfolio of no fewer than 20 hotels, including oversight of commercial performance, stakeholder engagement, and strategic execution across multiple countries. Proven track record in high‑growth markets, ideally with exposure to environments experiencing 4x\+ growth rates, where rapid scaling, agility, and commercial innovation are essential.
* Strong relationship building skills
* Ability to effectively plan and proactively communicate/manage expectations with stakeholders that may include both internal and external partners (project sponsors/ senior leadership team)
* Experience in working in a matrix organization
* Experience in Revenue Management, Sales \& Marketing
* Presents clear and logical arguments and decision based on factual data.
* Quick and accurate when evaluating complex written and numerical information.
* Develops constructive relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Demonstrates leadership and effectively motivates teams, helps others when needed.
* Maintains effectiveness in situations of disappointment or high pressure.
* Adapts willingly to change.
* Identifies priorities effectively, balancing importance, urgency and resources.
* Manages own personal time efficiently within tight schedules.
* Strategic thinker while translating financial goals into operational plans
* Previous experience in Change management and organisational design.
* Storytelling and ability to create, business cases, presentations to gain stakeholder buy\-in.
* Dynamic, innovative, and creative in finding business solutions
* Works effectively and accurately in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to challenge while maintaining strong relationships
* A high level of emotional intelligence and interpersonal skills with the ability to provide and receive professional, constructive feedback that elevates individual performance and job satisfaction


**About The Team**
**How We’ll Help You Thrive**
**Benefits**
 At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:
   

  

 Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
   

  

 Paid parental leave – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents
   

  

 Crisis concierge – In times of loss, our Crisis Concierge offers a single, compassionate point of contact for both practical support and emotional care
   

  

 Mental health resources – Your wellbeing comes first. Through our Care for All hub, we provide resources to help our Team Members to care for themselves and their loved ones. In many countries, eligible Team Members receive free counseling and support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
   

  

* Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

 Responsibilities:
   

 1\. Develop, maintain and support implementation of regional agency\-management policies, playbooks, onboarding standards and governance processes for TikTok LIVE across the MENA/MENAT region.
   

 2\. Support local operating entities in identifying, assessing and managing MCNs, agencies and creator organisations in accordance with approved regional standards, without directly contracting on behalf of the RHQ entity.
   

 3\. Design and deliver regional training materials and enablement programmes for internal teams on agency\-management processes, platform policies, compliance requirements and operational best practices.
   

 4\. Analyse regional agency performance data and provide recommendations to local operating entities and regional leadership on agency quality, category development and creator ecosystem trends.

 6\. Contribute to regional business planning, operational governance and performance reporting for the LIVE creator agency ecosystem.

 \- Experience in regional strategy, business operations, governance, analytics, partner enablement or cross\-functional programme management within a technology, media, entertainment, social media or creator economy business.
   

  

 This role is based in the Company’s KSA Regional Headquarters and is responsible for providing regional strategy, management, governance, analytics, training and coordination support to Company group entities across the MENAT/MENA region. The role does not involve direct sales to customers, direct contracting with creators, agencies or users on behalf of the RHQ entity, or direct operation of local commercial activities.  ​

 TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

 Your role
   

  

* To understand and interpret AtkinsRéalis rights and responsibilities across its portfolio of projects in KSA.
* Overall responsibility for supporting Project Directors in the delivery of projects to the contractual arrangements and the required commercial outcome (including the contracted profit margin) all in accordance with the agreed financial objectives.

data.jd_text:
**شاغر وظيفي** 










 مطلوب كفاءة مميزة للانضمام إلى فريق عملنا لشغل وظيفة  ( مشرف فروع التأجير  )
 




  






 إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تنظيمية
 





 استثنائية، وقدرة عالية على إدارة الأولويات ودعم الإدارة العليا باحترافية، فنحن
 





 نتطلع للتعرف عليك وتلقي طلبك!
 




  





**📍 مكان العمل: جدة** 




 نبحث عن مشرف تأجير يتمتع بخبرة عملية في إدارة عمليات التأجير والإشراف على الفروع، لضمان تطبيق السياسات والإجراءات التشغيلية، وتحقيق مستهدفات الأداء، وتعزيز تجربة العملاء.
 



 نبحث عن مرشح يمتلك خبرة عملية في قطاع تأجير السيارات للإشراف على عمليات التأجير بالفروع والتطبيقات، وقيادة فرق العمل، ومتابعة العقود والتحصيل، وضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة والإجراءات التشغيلية وتحقيق أعلى مستويات الخدمة.
 



**المهام الرئيسية:** 



* الإشراف على عمليات التأجير بالفروع والتطبيقات ومتابعة سير العمل اليومي.
* إدارة ومتابعة العقود المفتوحة والمعلقة والمغلقة والتأكد من استكمال الإجراءات النظامية.
* متابعة التحصيل والعملاء المتأخرين والمتعثرين واتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة بالتنسيق مع الجهات المعنية.
* الإشراف على موظفي الفروع ومنسقي التطبيقات والسائقين ومتابعة أدائهم وانضباطهم.
* مراجعة يوميات الفروع والصندوق والتأكد من سلامة الإجراءات المالية.
* متابعة جاهزية الأسطول والتنسيق مع إدارات التشغيل والأسطول والصيانة.
* متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على سرعة معالجتها وتحسين تجربة العميل.
* التأكد من التزام الفروع بلوائح وأنظمة نشاط تأجير السيارات ومتطلبات الجهات التنظيمية.
* إعداد التقارير التشغيلية ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء ورفع التوصيات التطويرية.



**المؤهلات والمتطلبات:** 



* الجنسية سعودية
* خبرة لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال تأجير السيارات أو التشغيل.
* معرفة جيدة بأنظمة ولوائح نشاط تأجير السيارات.
* مهارات قيادية وإدارية وقدرة على إدارة فرق العمل.
* مهارات عالية في المتابعة والتحليل وإعداد التقارير.
* إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي والأنظمة التشغيلية ذات العلاقة.



**المزايا** 



* بيئة عمل احترافية ومحفزة.
* فرص للتطوير الوظيفي والنمو المهني.
* راتب ومزايا تنافسية حسب الخبرة والكفاءة.
