data.jd_text:
**Description**
**Job Purpose:**
 To manage the overall complete company financial and operational performance of the respective areas of responsibility as per the guidelines given by Chief Executive Officer. To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.
* Closely monitor the performance of all the department heads.
* Adhere to the safety regulations set by the company as well as the Client.
* Provide on monthly basis with a safety statistic report for the individual’s entire operation.
* Liaise with the Client on all matters related to Safety.
* Conduct safety meetings with all the department heads and establish a safety committee to closely monitor and update management on safety matters.
* To perform any other duties requested by the CEO out of the normal routine but within the scope of work.
* The individual is fully responsible and accountable for the HSE policies and procedures, which are in place.
* To conform to the Company’s guidelines related to the area as detailed in the Company’s Quality Assurance Program developed on the basis of ISO 9001:2000 Q.M. S


**All Fakeeh Care employees are responsible for continuous improvement, including:**
* Performing all duties and tasks in a manner that supports Fakeeh’s Person\-Centered care values.
* Actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, within the scope of the role.
* Adherence to safety protocols and proactively seeking to address any job\-related safety concerns.
* Maintaining strict confidentiality of all sensitive information accessed or encountered during work.
* Complying with cybersecurity policies and standards to protect Fakeeh’s systems and participating in awareness training and initiatives to prevent cyber threats.
* Adhering to and upholding Fakeeh Care’s code of conduct, policies and ethical standards.
* Completion of mandatory education as per the requirement, at least one month prior to expiration.


**Requirements**
* Minimum 10 years operational experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or management role.
* Experience in facility management and healthcare environments from a well reputed local or international companies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; an MBA from an accredited University.
* Excellent command of oral and written English and Arabic.

**Build the Future of Rail in the Middle East with Mace**
 As we expand our rail capability across the Middle East, Mace is seeking exceptional talent to help shape and deliver some of the region’s most ambitious transport programmes.
   

  

 With a globally recognised track record across high‑speed rail, conventional rail, metro, and complex station environments, we are now growing our presence in the region — and building a high‑calibre talent pool to support this next phase.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experienced Professionals Across**
* Project and Programme Management
* Cost and Commercial Management
* Project Controls and Planning


**You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Directs the coordination and delivery of programmes, aligning project execution with defined strategic objectives, vision, and outcomes.
* Establishes and maintains an effective programme delivery environment across people, organisational structure, processes, information, and technology.
* Drives performance improvement beyond baseline targets through optimisation of resources and continuous monitoring, evaluation, and refinement of systems and methodologies.
* Leads governance of safety, quality, cost, schedule, risk, sustainability, compliance, and stakeholder management to ensure consistent delivery excellence.
* Maintains comprehensive programme documentation, including plans, procedures, reports, registers, and lessons learned to support informed decision\-making.
* Builds and leads high\-performing, inclusive teams, fostering collaboration, engagement, and a culture of service excellence and continuous improvement.
* Manages key internal and external stakeholder relationships, strengthening communication, engagement, and long\-term network development.
* Ensures commercial viability and alignment with organisational objectives, while embedding innovation, digital transformation, and sustainability principles, including net zero carbon delivery.


**About You**
 You will bring proven experience in major rail or infrastructure programmes, coupled with the ability to operate in complex, fast‑paced delivery environments. Equally important is a collaborative mindset and a commitment to excellence — qualities that define how we partner with our clients and deliver lasting impact.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to be part of something evolving — to help establish, shape, and grow a rail capability in a region where investment in integrated transport is accelerating at pace.
   

  

 If you are motivated by delivering complex programmes, working with high‑performing teams, and contributing to the development of world‑class infrastructure, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.
   

  

 Join us in delivering the next generation of rail across the Middle East.

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you the strategic mastermind who can turn complex aviation regulations into a symphony of safety and performance?
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with teams across Flight Operations, Ground Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance to embed quality, compliance, and accountability into every aspect of the operation, ensuring the highest standards of safety and performance.
   

  

 Take the lead in establishing, implementing, and continuously enhancing quality management systems and compliance monitoring frameworks that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices.
   

  

 Drive operational excellence by overseeing audits, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective risk management, audit readiness, and the successful closure of findings across all operational areas.
   

  

 Ensure quality and compliance risks are proactively identified, assessed, and mitigated through robust monitoring, transparent reporting, and corrective action plans that safeguard operational integrity and regulatory adherence.
   

  

 Hold authority to interface with regulatory bodies on compliance\-related matters, including securing approvals, responding to regulatory inquiries, managing certifications such as Third Country Operator (TCO) authorization, and representing the organization during audits and inspections.
   

  

 Lead and develop high\-performing quality and compliance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and operational accountability while ensuring sustainable compliance leadership and decision\-making continuity.
   

  

 Drive a culture of ownership, governance, and regulatory discipline by holding self and others accountable for delivering commitments, maintaining compliance standards, and achieving operational objectives.
   

  

 Promote transparency through performance monitoring, timely escalation of risks and findings, and the effective execution of corrective actions to ensure sustainable compliance and operational excellence.
   

  

 Join us to shape world\-class quality assurance and compliance programs, strengthen regulatory excellence, and drive safe, efficient, and industry\-leading operations across the organization.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, y ou will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in airline quality assurance and compliance.
   

  

 You are expected to demonstrate an in\-depth knowledge of aviation regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices.
   

  

 We'd love to hear from you even more if you are able to lead a team, and are familiar with GACA (General Authority of Civil Aviation) regulations.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

Besides helping customers implement Nutanix products successfully, the Professional Services team, working with our partners, ensures customer success in fully implementing their virtualized and software\-defined data centers. The Nutanix Professional Services Consulting function includes assessment, design, implementation, integration, and automation services as well as project/program management.

* Drive end\-to\-end program execution, tracking complex dependencies, predecessors, and milestones across multiple sub\-projects and workstreams.
* Partner with architects and resourcing teams to strategically schedule and deploy internal and external consulting talent.
* Proactively anticipate budget or timeline challenges, and deliver accurate quarterly revenue forecasting within internal systems of record.
* Collaborate with global Project Managers to optimize PM methodologies, share best practices, and continuously improve team efficiency.
* Create and maintain comprehensive, audit\-ready program documentation and execution frameworks.

* Exceptional organizational skills including ability to plan, attention to detail, facilitation, time management, leadership and multi\- tasking skills
* Ability to work with clients and stakeholders to identify business objectives and align program deliverables to them· Ability to align the deliverables (outputs) to the program's outcome.

* Self starter with intense drive for improvement and delivering results

* PMP required, PgMP, or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI\-ACP) a plus


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. **Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

**Description**
 Would you like to be part of a team focused on driving innovation in the transportation industry while working to empower entrepreneurs and contribute to Amazon’s sustainability goals?
   

  

 Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Delivery Partner Managers assists and guides our Amazon DSPs (Logistics Supply chain Managers) business owners as they build and grow successful middle\-mile businesses during a transformational time.
   

  

 Account Manager (Logistics Supply chain Manager) manage the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Logistics Supply chain Manager, work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level, influence their business planning and strategy, and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are set up for success.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Logistics Account Manager, you will manage a team of 6\+ Managers to manage 80\+ DSP accounts in Amazon's quick commerce business (15min and 2H delivery) across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia including entrepreneurs with no background in the logistics industry, or seasoned logistics carrier (Depending on business program)
   

  

 Work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics.
   

  

 Collaborate with an integrated internal team of Program Managers and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements.
   

  

 Support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level.
   

  

 As Lead, Logistics Supply chain Manager will do this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
   

  

 They will collaborate frequently with a wide array of integrated internal stakeholders such as Partner Relations (PAR), Value Added Service (VAS), Legal, fleet and network health to name a few. The Logistics Supply chain Manager support owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. They facilitate and execute Monitoring and Enforcement Policies (MEP) and build two\-way feedback channels with OTR teams, DSPs and WW/EU Product and strategy.
   

  

 The Logistics Supply chain Manager will be required to work flexibly and will be required to travel between multiple sites to engage with business owners weekly to carry out their role effectively.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Safety: Partnering with OTR Safety and OTR Regional Managers to ensure business safety compliance.
   

  

 Performance: Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp\-up operations and prepare for peak period.
   

  

 Performance: Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch (this will be on the basis of a net new launch only)
   

  

 Performance: Coach and ensure effective upskilling and utilisation of AMZL tools.
   

  

 Performance: Deep dive to identify customer metric improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Performance: Champion the consistent application of Last Mile processes within Delivery Stations – challenge UTR processes that impact OTR.
   

  

 Performance: Coaching business owners to run compliant, safe and high performing companies (SLS metric deep dive)
   

  

 Experience: Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
   

  

 Experience: Developing the relationship between Amazon and our DSP partners (DSP sentiment improvements)
   

  

 Experience: Communication alignment to DSP business owners following close collaboration with OTR partners.
   

  

 Be the voice of the DSP within and represent them within the AMZL business.
   

  

 Experience: Improve driver standards to protect brand image.
   

  

 Capacity Management: Work with the DSP’s to deliver effective ramp plans and pipeline goals ensuring driver supply is achieved to meet peak volume demands.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* 5\+ years of team management experience
* 8\+ years of management, or 8\+ years of people management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA
* 7\+ years of account or relationship management, small business logistics, or retail/vendor/supplier management experience

Egis is an international player active in architecture, consulting, construction engineering and mobility services.  With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis has long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 The Director of Facilities Management provides strategic, technical, and operational leadership for the full lifecycle management of the organisation’s built and natural assets. This role oversees the planning, mobilisation, operation, and continuous improvement of all Facilities Management (FM) and Landscape Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) services across a complex, multi‑site programme, ensuring world‑class service delivery, promoting best\-practice asset management, and acts as a Senior advisor to the Executive Leadership, Government Agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.
   

  





 The Facilities Management Director is responsible to provide the overall Landscape Operations and Maintenance support to RCRC during the lifecycle of all programme components.
   

  

  

  





**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Governance**



* Develop and implement the organisation’s comprehensive FM and Landscape O\&M strategy aligned with long‑term corporate objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks, performance management systems, SLAs, and KPIs for all FM disciplines (hard, soft, infrastructure, and landscape).
* Lead strategic asset management planning, including lifecycle cost modelling, capital replacement strategies, and sustainability\-focused asset performance improvements.
* Represent the FM function at executive committees, senior leadership briefings, and cross‑government steering groups.



  

  





**2\. Lifecycle \& Operational Management**



* Provide expert guidance throughout the full asset lifecycle: design review, mobilisation, operation, maintenance, optimisation, and decommissioning.
* Ensure that all assets and facilities achieve optimal operational availability, resilience, and compliance.
* Direct the mobilisation of FM and O\&M contracts, establish operational readiness programmes, and oversee contractor onboarding and performance.
* Ensure operations integrate seamlessly with the broader urban, environmental, and community context.



  

  





**3\. Procurement, Contracts \& Commercial Oversight**



* Lead the development of procurement strategies, technical documentation, scopes of work, and high‑quality RFPs for all FM and O\&M services.
* Manage the full tendering process including bid evaluation, technical and commercial assessment, negotiation, and contract award.
* Maintain full budgetary and financial control, ensuring cost forecasting, contract variations, cash\-flow analysis, and risk/opportunity tracking are accurate and timely.
* Drive value engineering, cost optimisation, and commercial innovation across the FM portfolio.



  

  





**4\. Performance, Compliance \& Risk Management**



* Ensure all facilities, operations, and contractors comply with regulatory, statutory, environmental, and HSE requirements.
* Oversee the creation of risk registers, emergency preparedness plans, and business continuity strategies.
* Implement quality assurance frameworks to monitor performance and ensure consistent, high‑quality delivery across all service providers.
* Conduct regular reviews of O\&M delivery, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective measures.



  

  





**5\. Stakeholder \& Client Leadership**



* Serve as the senior point of contact for government entities, municipalities, regulatory bodies, clients, community groups, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead high‑level presentations, executive reporting, workshops, and strategic planning sessions.
* Build strong collaborative relationships with partners, service providers, and cross‑functional teams to ensure organisational alignment.



  

  





**6\. Team Leadership \& Talent Development**



* Lead, mentor, and develop a multi\-disciplinary team of FM, landscape, engineering, and O\&M professionals.
* Cultivate a high‑performance culture emphasising accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Identify capability gaps and drive training, succession planning, and professional development initiatives.
 
**Technical \& Professional Skills**
* Extensive experience (15\+ years) in Facilities \& Asset Management of large, complex, multi\-site environments.
* Deep knowledge of O\&M across hard services, soft services, infrastructure, and large\-scale landscape environments.


**Qualifications**

 Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, bachelor’s degree in urban design, architecture or landscape or Equivalent
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

 Years of Experience (min) 15

 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Directly manage and guide specialized technical leads, including the Incident managers, Support \& Operations team, Upgrade \& Deployment Lead, KPI Reporting \& Analytics Lead, Drive Test Lead, and Knowledge Transfer Lead.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Service Delivery Manager (SDM) provides oversight of the operational health of the customer system, from service delivery through lifecycle support. The SDM ensures and may manage internal \& external resources to deliver services and maintain their compliance with customer contractual commitments.
   

  

 The SDM establishes standard procedures designed to ensure consistently high service performance, monitors employees and evaluates customer feedback to develop quality improvement processes. The SDM is responsible for customer success as defined by success criteria during the transition phase
   

  

 A Service Delivery Manager is assigned to one or more of MSI’s customers depending on the size of the system and its complexity. A SDM is expected to have or develop a detailed knowledge of the customer’s system and their operational staff.
   

  

**Responsibility**
 The main role of the Service Delivery Manager is to facilitate customer success by adhering to global service delivery processes related to the customer. The Service Delivery Manager also acts as the main interface between MSI and the customer.
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing specialized Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) and deployment functions for the STC Nationwide Kodiak MCX network. Operating alongside the Customer Service Manager (CSM), the SDM leads dedicated technical teams to ensure seamless application upgrades, rigorous performance tracking, and effective knowledge transfer to support the mission\-critical environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Upgrades \& deployments: oversee the dedicated Upgrade and Deployment team (consisting of 4 personnel) responsible for executing software patching, rollbacks, updates, and deployment across all lab and production systems.
* Performance monitoring \&reporting: direct the KPI Reporting \& Analytics team to generate comprehensive system performance reports, Kodiak Analytic reports, and drive test reports to ensure service quality and SLA compliance.
* Testing \& verification: oversee change management verification, Wave mobile application acceptance testing, and drive testing operations (in coordination with 3rd party vendors).
* Knowledge transfer \& enablement: manage the Knowledge Transfer lead to facilitate comprehensive user engagement, onboarding, fleet mapping preparation, and continuous training development for the customer.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: work closely with the Customer Support Manager (CSM), Incident Managers, and supporting functions (like HR, Commercial, and Procurement) to align strategic goals and ensure continuous service improvement.


**Required Operating Environment Context**
 The role supports a 24x7x365 support model handling highly complex, mission\-critical push\-to\-talk (MCPTT) applications.
   

  

 The candidate will be subject to local Saudization requirements, which may require specific educational degrees related to the role to be granted a work permit.
   

  

 Deliverables
   

  

* Take part in the formulation of standard procedures regarding service delivery.
* Lead the transition and transformation of project operations to Managed Services.
* Ensure that procedures and plans formulated for the customer are in line with the organization’s goals.
* Ensure that procedures formulated are fully implemented to achieve service level objectives.
* Attend important meetings on behalf of the service delivery team or appoint representatives.
* Make recommendations for changes to technology or procedures for the customer.
* Prepare periodic reports and present such reports to the customer stakeholders.
* Analysis of system performance and facilitate improvement recommendations.


 Cost and Efficiency
   

  

 A common fiscal responsibility of the Service Delivery Manager is to ensure delivery processes are efficient and cost effective. To reduce costs and streamline the process without adversely impacting the client experience, they might eliminate paperwork, unnecessary service steps or non\-value\-added features. For technology service providers, an emphasis should be placed on the efficient delivery of hardware and software services.
   

  

* Suggest new strategies to maintain or improve on the quality of service delivery \& minimize cost.
* Carry out research regularly and attend seminars to learn improved service delivery procedures and processes.


 Customer Satisfaction
   

  

 A key role for the service delivery manager is to constantly assess customer feedback and make necessary improvements. Managers typically conduct evaluations with customers on the phone, in person, via e\-mail or through postal mail. When scores fall below the preset thresholds, the manager may conduct additional research and take steps to correct deficiencies. For example, some customers might feel like parts of the process are slow or delayed. By identifying and analyzing the issues, the service delivery manager can work on eliminating bottlenecks.
   

  

* Collect data and information on client satisfaction, inquiry, and complaint.
* Plan, manage and execute customer meetings for service delivery reporting and improvements.
* He/she will ensure that clients’ satisfaction is always guaranteed and will consistently collate data on customer satisfaction, inquiry and complaint.
* Responsible for maintaining a positive relationship with customers.
* identifying customer needs and ensuring that the service provider is able to meet these needs with an appropriate catalogue of services.
* The Service Delivery Manager has responsibility for being the Customer’s advocate within Motorola and being Motorola’s face to the Customer.
* Support the customer to best use the features and deliverables of Managed Service.
* Performs analysis of issues and problems.
* Lead efforts to escalate across internal functional groups to resolve service or client business impacting issues.
* Provides support relative to contractual commitments and SLA's.


 Management
   

  

* Educate the members of the service delivery team on new plans and implication on service delivery.
* Assess the individual and collective performance of the team members.
* Organize and head meetings with the service delivery team.
* Responsible for training of service delivery resources.
* Reporting.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

* Diploma or degree in Engineering (Electrical) or related discipline
* ITIL v4 certification
* High level of understanding of Communication systems and IP Networks
* 2\+ years experience with planning and transitioning a project to operations and maintenance phase
* 5\+ years experience managing a service delivery team, ideally focused on operations and maintenance
* High\-level experience in telecoms or public safety
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and presentation in English and Arabic)
* Excellent customer service skills with a focus on Total Customer Satisfaction
* Effective consultation and liaison skills
* Good planning and time management skills
* Ability to prioritise, multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Excellent theoretical and practical problem\-solving skills
* Well\-developed interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Ability to work unsupervised
* Technical literacy


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 25\-50%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 Domestic
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No
   

  

**Company**
 Motorola Solutions Arabia, Inc., Saudi Branch
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

**Who We Are**
 At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology\-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end\-to\-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line\-haul transportation, last\-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross\-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.
   

  

**Our Global Reach**
 JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross\-border movement. Today, we operate 130\+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
   

  

 Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people\-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast\-evolving industry.
   

  

**About The Team**
 You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high\-quality results in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Project Lifecycle Management: This includes project initiation, making project plans, detailing project work content, adjusting project plans according to the actual situation, and coordinating with project stakeholders to complete the work, ensuring high\-quality project delivery . 2\. On\-site Project Implementation Management, coordinating resources from all parties to ensure that the civil construction renovation, power and communication system, installation and commissioning of logistics automation equipment, and other tasks are carried out in an orderly manner, proceed as planned, and are delivered on time. 3\. Project Delivery and Integration: Collaborating with planning, operations, R\&D, equipment supplier, and other parties, organizing project training, on\-site setup, warehouse relocation, and starting operation to ensure a smooth project launch.
* Accumulation of Project Implementation Techniques and Standardization Construction: Based on the practice of Middle East project construction and operation, accumulate and compile Middle East project construction standards from the principles of compliance, efficiency, and economy, continuously iterate and improve to enhance the efficiency and quality of project construction.


 ﻿
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above, majors in Industrial Engineering, Logistics and supply chain management, Automation, and other related fields.
* Language Requirement: Fluent in English, capable of using it as a working language for meetings, reports, and project communication.
* Work Experience: More than 3 years of experience in project implementation, familiar with the overseas working environment and logistics policies, with experience in managing automated projects such as large\-scale warehousing centers, sorting centers, etc. Priority will be given to those with overseas project implementation experience.
* Basic Skills: Rigorous logical thinking and data sensitivity, good summarization and induction abilities, and data analysis capabilities. Proficient in at least one data analysis tool, such as EXCEL, SQL, Python, etc.
* Soft Skills: Possess strong project management and cross\-departmental coordination abilities, able to adapt to periodic business trips within the Middle East region. Have a structured thinking process, good at summarizing and extracting, and capable of distilling methodologies from projects.


*At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.*
**Ready to apply?**
 Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.

**Job Description**
 As Technical Project Director, you are responsible for overseeing and leading the successful delivery of large\-scale, complex spatial planning and master planning projects. You will manage all aspects of project execution, from project planning and budgeting to execution and client delivery, ensuring that projects are completed on time, to scope, and within budget.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and project partners to ensure high levels of satisfaction and project success.
* Act as the primary point of contact and escalation for clients on projects
* Ensure project processes and deliverables meet HSEQ and technical compliance standards and requirements
* Monitor and report on project progress, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Technically contribute to, review and approve project deliverables, ensuring alignment with client expectations and specifications.
* Identify and mitigate project risks, managing issues proactively and implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Provide regular project updates to senior management, stakeholders, and clients, managing expectations and ensuring transparency.
* Mentor and develop project management team members, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Spoken and written Arabic language skills
* Understanding of transport, infrastructure, environmental, and economic discipline areas given the cross\-disciplinary nature of spatial planning projects.
* Experience in undertaking quality assurance processes and major project reviews, to ensure outputs meet client expectations and WSP quality requirements
* Understanding and evidence of application of data\-driven analytical processes, tools and software
* Skilled in preparing technical and commercial proposals

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**Purpose Of The Role (Overview)**
* Provide support and advice to the HGS Construction Director in the administration of the Construction Contract(s) and Consultancy Agreements relating to the Prime Business Resort project
* Evaluate Contractor Claims and provide guidance to the HGS Construction Director as to the method of progression and the manner of responses to be provided
* Monitor the Cost Consultant in its evaluation of the cost element of Contractor Claims
* In conjunction with the HGS Construction Director, administer the project's Change Control Process involving the compilation and submission of Contractor Change Requests (CCR), Change Initiation Forms, Requests for Change, Engineer's Instructions and Variation Orders
* Monitor the Cost Consultant activities, ensuring Contractor Interim Payment Applications are promptly and accurately processed
* In conjunction with the HGS Planning Manager, monitor the Contractor's Procurement Activities for compliance with the Construction Schedule, with the overall aim of ensuring the availability of materials at the site, at the correct time, to support the construction activities


**Daily, Weekly, Monthly Duties**
* Monitor and update existing "Tracker\-Logs" recording the status of Sub\-Contracts, Warranties, Insurances, Purchase Orders, Engineer's Instructions, Claims, etc. Compile new documents as required
* Monitor E\-mail, Aconex and Letter communications to monitor progress of the Project Issues and their potential effect on construction activities. Provide comment and advice to the HGS Construction Director if the communications contain information pertaining to ongoing and or new contractual issues
* Compile draft Notices, Instructions, Variation Orders, Letters and Reports, as necessary, for review and submission by the HGS Construction Director
* Review content of the Contractor's Procurement Management Dashboard (PMD), liaising with the HGS Planning Manager and Construction Manager in ascertaining the suitability and accuracy of the information contained therein. Escalate any matters of concern to the HGS Project Construction Director
* Monitor and "chase" Contractor's responses to Notices, Instructions, Letters and other communications; raising concerns regarding quality and or content with the HGS Construction Director
* Attend Weekly Commercial \& Procurement Meetings; and contribute to the discussions therein. Review and comment of the Meeting Minutes (prepared by the Cost Consultant)
* Attend other meetings as required by the HGS Construction Director
* Assist in the preparation of HGS daily, weekly and monthly reports and presentations
* Liaise with HGS Project Construction Director, Construction Manager, Planning Manager and Document Controller, escalating issues of concern as necessary.
* Liaise with the Employer's Cost Consultant, Contractor's Commercial Manager, Contractor's Procurement Manager and the Employer Construction Supervision Consultant. Escalate arising matters of concern to the HGS Construction Director
* Assist in other ad\-hoc, site related, activities as requested by the HGS Construction Director, e.g., Emergency Drills, Head\-Counts, etc
* Undertake other Commercial, Contract and Procurement related tasks as necessary


**Other Attributes :**
 1 . Comfortable working in a site office, alongside an Employer Team including Employer's Consultants.
   

  

 2 . Willingness to step outside the designated role of Commercial Manager to undertake additional work activities in support of the wider HGS role on the Prime Business Resort project.
   

  

 3 . Physically fit, able to "walk the site" to access all areas of the construction works to view and gauge the progress and status of the construction works.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Experience and Qualifications**
* Ten (10\) years post\-qualification, post\-contract / construction delivery, Commercial Management experience
* B.Sc. / B.A. Degree (3\-4 year) in a construction related subject from a reputable, recognized, university
* Experience of projects of varying types and complexities; experience of Business Park / Low\-Rise Office developments of a similar size and nature to the Prime Business Resort project preferred
* Five (5\) years Contract Administration of Construction Projects experience using the FIDIC Red Book Form of Contract (FIDIC Red Book 1999 experience required)
* Five years' work experience in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia / GCC Countries in the capacity of a Commercial / Contracts Manager
* Five (5\) years employment with an International Consultancy Company
* Experience in administering FIDIC White Book 2017 Consultancy Services Agreements
* Experience of site (office) based working
* Accomplished user of Aconex, SharePoint and the Microsoft Office Suite of software
* Ability to engage with and assist the project's Cost Consultant, the Contractor's Commercial Manager and Procurement Manager; and the Construction Supervision Consultant, in a decisive, non\-adversarial manner
* Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors (RCIS) preferred

data.jd_text:
**About the Role**
 This internship position exists to support our consulting teams as we guide clients through complex corporate transitions. Our client is an established holding group currently reviewing its assets to achieve portfolio clarity, creating an immediate need for structured analytical support. In this role, you will help coordinate our team resources, track key debate points, and ensure our deliverables match the standards expected by our partners.
   

  

**About Arabian Private Holdings**
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large\-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred\-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. Our principal\-led structure means that we take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the partners who are actually accountable for the outcome.
   

 Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities. We focus on clarity over complexity. Whether we are helping holding companies rationalize their portfolios or supporting a founder through a scaling transition, our goal is to provide honest, independent advice. We choose to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.
   

  

**What You Will Do** 
* Organize project timelines, track delivery milestones, and manage schedules for our key advisory mandates.
* Conduct structured corporate research on governance and market trends to support active client projects.
* Synthesize complex operational data into clear, brief summaries for our senior analysts.
* Help our partners prepare structured presentations and reports, focusing on logical clarity and precise writing.
* Maintain the internal project logs, ensuring all client agreements, action items, and follow\-ups are documented accurately.
* Participate in internal team discussions to help form a view on specific client challenges.
* Coordinate communication between team members to keep project work moving smoothly.
  

  


**What We Are Looking For** 
* A strong academic record in business, economics, engineering, or a related field of study.
* Absolute clarity of thought and the ability to express complex ideas in simple, professional English.
* Exceptional written precision, with a high level of attention to detail and grammatical accuracy.
* A collaborative mindset and a high level of curiosity about corporate strategy, holding companies, and asset management.
* Strong organization habits, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines reliably.
* Comfort working with quantitative data, spreadsheets, and basic business tools.
  

  


**How We Work**
 We operate on a hybrid model, balancing remote focus with structured in\-person collaboration. This approach allows us to maintain strong team connections and mentor our junior team members effectively while giving everyone the flexibility to work independently. Our governance and mentoring philosophy is built on direct access. Because we run a principal\-led firm, you will work alongside senior decision\-makers on active mandates rather than being isolated within a massive corporate hierarchy.
   

  

**What the Role Offers** 
* A paid internship with competitive compensation aligned with the market and the significance of the role.
* Direct mentoring from experienced partners who are leaders in corporate strategy and governance.
* Hands\-on experience working on real advisory mandates for holding companies and family groups.
* A supportive hybrid environment that values your growth, logic, and professional development.
* The opportunity to build foundational professional skills in project management and strategic analysis.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!
   

  

 At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Terminal Systems Project Manager to join our team.
   

  

 The Terminal Systems Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the Terminal Systems scope within a major airport Master Systems Integration (MSI) programme.
   

  

 The position requires strong technical leadership, airport operational systems expertise, and programme coordination capabilities across large\-scale aviation environments.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Manages design reviews, technical compliance assessments, interface coordination activities, and systems integration planning across all assigned terminal systems packages.
* Oversees the implementation, integration, testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and handover of terminal operational systems including AODB, FIDS/FIDS\-DS, RMS, AOCC, FLIRT, SPS, ATCMS, DMS, and PAVA platforms.

data.jd_text:
JOB PURPOSE:
 



  





 The Project Technical Coordinator serves as a vital link between project management, engineering teams, and external stakeholders. This role ensures that technical documentation, design deliverables, and construction activities are aligned with project goals, timelines, and quality standards. The coordinator supports the project lifecycle from planning through execution by managing workflows, resolving technical discrepancies, and facilitating communication across disciplines.
 



  





 DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES:
 



  




* Review and interpret technical drawings, grading plans, and specifications.
* Coordinate with design consultants/design team, contractors, and internal teams to ensure technical alignment.
* Track and manage technical submittals that include but not limited to “Shop Drawings, Design Review Reports, RFIs, and all other engineering approvals.
* Ensure compliance with project standards, codes, and client requirements.
* Support Document Controllers in organizing and distributing technical documents.
* Prepare technical reports, meeting minutes, and progress summaries.
* Facilitate coordination meetings between engineering, procurement, and construction teams.
* Monitor and update project workflows to reflect real\-time progress.
* Escalate unresolved technical issues to the Project Director or Package Manager.
* Assist in quality assurance reviews of technical deliverables.
* Ensure that all technical activities adhere to safety, regulatory, and contractual standards.
* Assist in preparing project schedules, resource plans, and risk registers.
* Track technical milestones and flag delays or bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with procurement and logistics teams for timely delivery of technical deliverables



  





 EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:
 



  




* This position requires 10\+ years in mega projects prefer in PM/CM companies.
* Company Background: Strong experience within Tier\-1 Project Management / Construction Management (PM/CM or PMC) companies



  





 EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:
 



  




* Education: Bachelor Degree in Engineering “Civil/Architect”, Construction Management or related filed.
* PMP, BIM



  





 QUALIFICATIONS:
 



  




* Technical Proficiency: Strong ability to review and interpret technical drawings, grading plans, specifications, and shop drawings.
* Workflow Management: Expert in managing technical submittals, including RFIs, design reviews, and engineering approvals.
* Compliance \& QA: Solid knowledge of engineering codes, quality assurance (QA) reviews, and safety regulations.
* Project Control: Skilled in tracking milestones, updating workflows, and managing risk registers/schedules.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Exceptional ability to liaise between design consultants, contractors, procurement, and upper management.
* Communication: Excellent technical reporting, minutes\-of\-meeting preparation, and cross\-disciplinary communication skills.



  





 REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS (SOFTWARE \& HARD SKILLS)
 



  




* Engineering Tools: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD for reviewing/issuing shop drawings and details.
* Planning \& Scheduling: Practical knowledge of Primavera (P6\) for tracking project baselines, timelines, and milestones.
* BIM Methodology: Strong understanding or familiarity with BIM (Building Information Modeling) workflows and architecture management.
* Document Control: Masterful command over document control systems, submittal logs, transmittals, and RFI management.
* Contracts \& Estimating: Solid understanding of FIDIC contracts, BOQ structures, estimation, and procurement workflows



  





 SOFT SKILLS
 



  




* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills for cross\-functional reporting and high\-level stakeholder management.
* Problem\-Solving: Highly analytical mindset with a strong ability to solve technical errors, contractual claims, and site conflicts under tight deadlines.
* Leadership \& Initiative: A self\-motivated coordinator capable of leading sub\-contractors and assisting Construction/Project Managers seamlessly

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

Sanabil Studio is a venture builder that blends industry expertise, technology, and startup know\-how to turn bold ideas into real businesses. We take concepts from zero to launch, and when a venture proves its potential, we back it with seed funding and hands\-on support to help it scale.
   

  

 TradePay is one of those ventures building the trade finance infrastructure for FMCG in Saudi Arabia. Our mission is to replace informal supplier credit with structured, data\-driven working capital that helps small merchants grow, protects suppliers from credit risk, and strengthens the FMCG supply chain. We are building a new credit system for underbanked merchants where risk is priced from real transaction behavior, not balance sheets. Our model leverages supplier, distributor, and marketplace data to power embedded B2B BNPL experiences across FMCG ecosystems. This is not traditional lending this is supply\-chain\-native decisioning built from real commerce data.
   

  

 We are looking for a Head of Operations to build and lead TradePay's operational backbone from the ground up reporting directly to the CEO.
   

  

**THE ROLE What you'll own here** 
 .
   

  

* Design and build TradePay's end\-to\-end collections infrastructure and execution workflows
* Manage repayment reminder strategies across SMS, WhatsApp, calls, and automated payment systems
* Own outbound collections activities, promise\-to\-pay tracking, escalation workflows, and legal recovery coordination
* Manage third\-party collections partners and build collections dashboards and reporting
* Oversee merchant onboarding operations including KYB/KYC document collection, account activation, and merchant operational records
* Build and manage the merchant support function covering repayment inquiries, operational issues, complaints, and escalations
* Design and manage dispute workflows, coordinating with suppliers and merchants to resolve issues and maintain audit trails
* Oversee merchant repayment processing, payment reconciliation, settlement coordination, and payment exception resolution
* Manage operational relationships with FMCG suppliers, distributors, force automation providers, marketplaces, payment providers, collection agencies, and KYB/KYC providers
* Produce daily collections reports, DPD and aging reports, and operational KPI dashboards
* Build scalable operational processes, SOPs, and controls, and automate manual workflows in partnership with Product and Engineering


 How Success Will Be Measured Scalable collections infrastructure fully operational, automated reminder and collections engine implemented, merchant support function operating to defined SLAs, real\-time operational reporting and dashboards live, reconciliation and settlement processes fully controlled, dispute management framework operational, and operational readiness achieved for national scale.
   

  

 Where This Role Can Go Head of Operations → Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.
   

  

**THE PROFILE You're probably a fit if…**
 You have 8\+ years of experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, collections, customer operations, or financial services operations
   

  

**You Have Proven Experience Building Operational Functions From Scratch**
 You bring strong collections and customer servicing experience
   

  

 You have experience managing operational teams and third\-party vendors
   

  

 You have strong analytical and reporting capabilities
   

  

**You Have Startup Or High\-growth Company Experience**
 You have Saudi Arabia or GCC experience
   

  

**THE ENVIRONMENT What Working Here Actually Looks Like.**
 1\- Operational Engine Ownership You own the infrastructure that keeps TradePay running. Every merchant onboarding, every collections workflow, every settlement and reconciliation process runs through what you build.
   

  

 2\- Direct Impact on the Business Collections performance, merchant satisfaction, and operational scalability all trace back to your systems. What you build moves the business forward directly.
   

  

 3\- A Role That Grows With You This position has a clear path into Chief Operations Officer as TradePay scales its operational infrastructure across the region.
   

  

 What You Get From Us
   

  

**Competitive pay** 
 : A package that reflects your experience and the market, not a lowball with "equity upside" as the excuse. Meaningful equity: Real upside aligned with long\-term value creation. Real data, at scale: Access to real\-world FMCG transaction data across suppliers, distributors, and marketplaces the foundation of a category\-defining fintech.
   

  

**Premium gear:** 
 , day one: Everything you need to hit the ground running, set up and ready before your first morning. Mentorship that matters: Direct collaboration with the Founder and leadership team from people who've actually built and scaled ventures.
   

  

**An accelerated curve** 
 : You'll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.
   

  

 Hiring Process Introductory recruiter conversation → Founder interview → Operations case study and practical exercise → Reference checks → Offer

 CTRD Company for Business Services (CTRD Arabia) is a company registered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (CR:1009114532\). 
 



  





**Contract Type** 





 ​​Fixed Term Contract​ 
 



 ​​Full Time ​ 
 



 12 months 
 



**Location** 





 Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. 
 



**Hours of Work** 





 40 hours/week (some evening and weekend working may be required) 
 



  





**Company Overview** 





 CTRD Arabia provides trusted professional and business services, shaping smarter organisations through high level management consultancy. We place a great deal of value in strong personal relationships, becoming trusted advisers to our clients and partners working with them to identify and resolve their challenges. 
 



 We deliver business services, professional services, transformation and development services, consultancy services, and language services, focused on practical outcomes and long\-term value. 
 



 People are at the heart of what we do, both within our organisation and when working with others externally. Our success is built on getting our relationships right, delivering on what we commit to, holding ourselves accountable, and maintaining humility in everything we do. Our priorities are people, project and profit, in that order. 
 



  





**Role Overview** 






 Reporting to Head of Commercial \& Strategy, the Commercial Contracts \& Governance Manager serves as CTRD Arabia’s specialist authority on Saudi commercial contracting pathways, regulatory compliance
 

 ,
 

 and contractual governance.
 
  
 



  






 The role translates GX’s commercial strategy and pricing frameworks into robust, enforceable contractual structures that protect organisational advantage and ensure compliance with Saudi law and procurement processes. The role ensures that opportunities progress through legally sound and commercially advantageous contracting routes from proposal through to contract execution.
 
  
 




 Working closely with the Head of Commercial \& Strategy, the Country Director and GX delivery teams, the role ensures that contractual obligations, commercial terms and performance frameworks are clearly defined, negotiated and documented. The role also identifies wider KSA tender and procurement opportunities, for consideration by Head Commercial \& Strategy. 
 
  
 



  






 The role ensures disciplined contract governance across the GX portfolio, maintaining auditable documentation, supporting structured change control, and ensuring that commercial agreements remain aligned with regulatory requirements and GX’s commercial objectives.
 
  
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 





  
 



 1\. Saudi Contracting \& Regulatory Navigation 
 


* Serve as GX’s subject\-matter expert on Saudi commercial contracting frameworks, processes and regulatory requirements, with a deep understanding of Defence.
* Identify
 
 and navigate optimal contracting pathways to support GX programmes and proposals.
* Expertly navigate KSA Government Tenders \& Procurement Law, including through developed professional network.
* Ensure all GX projects operate within Saudi commercial law, policy frameworks and regulatory standards.
* Provide expert advice to leadership on contracting routes, regulatory constraints and risk exposure.








**2\. Contract Structuring \& Negotiation** 
  
 


* Lead the drafting and negotiation of technical contractual terms, ensuring agreements protect GX’s commercial position while remaining compliant and competitive.
* Translate operational delivery requirements into clear, enforceable and measurable contractual obligations.
* Structure payment schedules, milestones and deliverables to align contractual performance with financial resilience.
* Support the Head of Commercial \& Strategy in structuring complex or high\-value opportunities.








**3\. Proposal Commercialisation \& Contract Conversion** 
  
 


* Support the transition of business development opportunities into executable contracts.
* Deep understanding of the KSA tender and procurement mechanism to be able to assist in identifying and building commercial options for a leadership pursuit decision
 
 .
* Ensure that proposal commitments are accurately translated into legally robust contractual frameworks.
* Work closely with delivery teams to ensure contractual requirements reflect operational realities.
* Provide commercial contracting support during proposal development where required.








**4\. Contract Governance \& Commercial Assurance** 
  
 


* In support of Head Commercial \& Strategy, maintain disciplined contractual governance across the GX portfolio.
* Ensure contracts are documented, traceable, auditable and compliant with Group standards.
* Establish and maintain clear contract management and documentation practices.
* Support risk identification and mitigation through robust contractual structuring, in close coordination with Group Operations.








**5\. Change Control \& Commercial Protection** 
  
 


* Establish structured change control processes to ensure scope changes are properly governed.
* Support variation management and contractual adjustments where delivery requirements evolve.
* Protect GX commercial position by ensuring scope, deliverables and obligations remain clearly defined.
* Support dispute avoidance through proactive contractual management.








**6\. Collaboration with Commercial \& Finance Functions** 
  
 


* Work in close partnership with the Head of Commercial \& Strategy to ensure contractual structures support GX pricing frameworks, margin expectations and commercial strategy.
* Support annual commercial and financial review processes.
* Coordinate with the GX Senior Finance Manager to ensure contractual payment structures align with financial governance, invoicing processes and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure contractual terms reflect GX financial controls and statutory compliance requirements.



  





**Requirements** 





  





**Essential** 
  
 




 Strong experience in commercial contracting, including drafting and negotiation of complex agreements. 
 





 Deep knowledge of Saudi commercial law, contracting
 

 pathways, and procurement frameworks. 
 





 Experience in the navigation and application of Government Tenders \& Procurement Law. 
 





 Demonstrated ability to structure commercially robust and legally
 

 compliant agreements. 
 





 Strong negotiation skills and ability to manage complex stakeholder discussions. 
 





 High attention to detail and ability to maintain disciplined contractual governance. 
 





 Familiarity with GCC commercial and regulatory environments. 
 




  





**Desirable** 

  
 




 Professional qualifications in commercial management, procurement, contract management or law (e.g. CIPS, LLB, contract management certification or equivalent professional experience). 
 



 Experience working within defence, security, government or regulated sectors. 
 



 Experience supporting large programme or portfolio environments. 
 



 English and Arabic language capability or experience operating in multicultural environments.
