* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited university
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage.


**Industry Specific Experience**
* Prior experience must include significant project experience and successful project management.
* Vast relevant experience in a supervisory and/or project management role including technical expertise.
* Mandatory experience in FEED and Detail Design for large Offshore Brownfield Projects.


**HSE Capability**
* Maintain HSE focus with the team to ensure OHSE requirements.
* Demonstrate behaviour and business practices commensurate with a culture of world’s best health, safety and environmental performance.
* Demonstrate a visible and active commitment to:

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**Primary Objective**
 The Project Engineering Manager is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering framework for project execution, ensuring the effective delivery of multi\-disciplinary engineering and design activities across our onshore projects in Energy and hydrocarbon sectors.
   

  

**Specific Accountabilities**
**Engineering Leadership \& Execution**
* Establish and implement the project engineering execution framework, including procedures, deliverables, workflows, and interface management.
* Lead and coordinate multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across Feasibility/ Concept, FEED and Detailed Design phases.
* Direct the preparation and quality of engineering deliverables, ensuring alignment with scope, standards, and schedule requirements.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and compliant design output, meeting client specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Review and approve engineering execution strategies, project organization structures, and discipline responsibilities.
* Prepare and implement the Engineering management Plan on projects and ensure discipline schedules/budgets include safety and sustainability activities for the asset lifecycle.
* Manage technical Value Improvement Practices (VIPs) \- technology selection, value engineering, energy optimization, RAM, etc.


**Cross\-Discipline Coordination \& Interface Management**
* Provide overall integration across engineering disciplines, ensuring effective sequencing and interface management.
* Establish and maintain engineering coordination procedures with internal teams, licensors, contractors, and stakeholders.
* Oversee and manage interfaces between engineering, procurement, construction, and third\-party contractors.
* Ensure structured communication and resolution of technical queries and inter\-disciplinary conflicts.


**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance**
* Ensure engineering activities comply with Worley standards, international codes, and customer specifications
* Must ensure maintaining engineering quality assurance processes, including document control, review cycles, and approval timelines.
* Lead the review and approval of key engineering documents, ensuring compliance with HSSEQ, operability, maintainability, and technical integrity requirements.
* Must ensure and participate in design reviews, safety studies, and technical assurance activities.
* Ensure required Technical Peer Reviews (TPRs) are planned, scheduled, and budgeted; proactively engage Location Director of Engineering when needed.


**Project Management \& Delivery**
* Overall key technical interface with customer management teams.
* Support the safe, on\-time, and within\-budget delivery of engineering scope across all project phases.
* Monitor engineering progress against schedule, budget, and deliverable milestones, identifying risks and implementing mitigation plans.
* Provide technical and commercial input to optimize design solutions and manage project risks.
* Ensure alignment between engineering outputs and project controls (cost, schedule, procurement needs).
* Maintain engineering registers for assumptions, holds, technical queries, deviations, key document changes, and SEAL decisions.


**HSSEQ \& Compliance**
* Champion Health, Safety, Security, Environment, and Quality culture within engineering activities.
* Ensure designs incorporate safe, sustainable, and environmentally compliant solutions.
* Ensure compliance with local and international regulatory frameworks and standards.


**Team Leadership \& Capability**
* Lead, mentor, and develop multi\-location engineering teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and competency.
* Ensure teams are appropriately staffed and aligned with project requirements.
* Foster collaboration across disciplines, offices, and stakeholders.
* Capture and implement lessons learned and continuous improvement initiatives.


**Qualifications, Accreditation, Training**
**Education**
* Full\-Time Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline of Engineering from an accredited University
* Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) status or undertaking the same will be an advantage
* MME (Ministry of Municipality and Environment) engineering accreditation is a mandatory requirement. Candidates not holding this accreditation must be willing to achieve this within the probationary period.


**Job Specific Knowledge , Experience \& Competencies**
* Significant experience in oil \& gas, petrochemical, or energy sector projects
* Must have proven experience as Project Engineering Manager / Engineering Manager on Pre\-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering projects during the last five years.
* Strong exposure to multi\-disciplinary engineering and global delivery teams


**Technical \& Functional Competencies**
* Strong understanding of engineering governance, execution planning, and design assurance
* Extensive knowledge of cross\-discipline integration, interfaces, and sequencing
* Experience in engineering deliverables, specifications, and design review processesSolid understanding of project lifecycle phases (Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, EPC)
* Familiarity with industry standards and customer specifications
* Experience in risk management, change management, and technical decision\-making


**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership capability with ability to manage diverse, multi\-location teams
* Effective communicator with the ability to influence technical and commercial decisions
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with ability to manage complexity and conflicting priorities
* High level of planning, organization, and execution discipline
* Ability to operate in fast\-paced, multi\-project environments


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**About HBKU**
 Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) is a member of Qatar Foundation for Education, Science, and Community Development (QF). The university was founded in 2010 to continue fulfilling QF’s vision of unlocking human potential. HBKU is a homegrown research\-intensive University offering undergraduate and graduate degrees that acts as a catalyst for positive transformation in Qatar and the region while having a global impact.
   

  

 Doha is the home of Education City (https://www.qf.org.qa/education/higher\-education), a dedicated campus devoted to research and education. In addition to HBKU, Education City hosts other academic institutions, including Weill Cornell Medicine\-Qatar, Carnegie Mellon University in Qatar, VCUarts Qatar, Northwestern University in Qatar, and Georgetown University in Qatar. Education City has significantly contributed to the development of post\-secondary education and cultural growth in Qatar.
   

  

**About Entity**
 Hamad Bin Khalifa University (HBKU) established the College of Public Policy in 2019\. The College has three degrees (Master of Public Policy, Master of Social Policy and Program Evaluation, Master of Global Health Policy) and Executive Programs (in collaboration with Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies in Geneva). The College works to empower the next generation of ethically grounded public leaders in Qatar and beyond. Students are given an inclusive and diverse learning environment that promotes a culture of excellence, integrity, respect, and fairness. All faculty members are active in research with broad agenda addressing national and global challenges and policy priorities.
   

  

 he Master of Global Health Policy (MGHP) program prepares graduates to address complex health challenges through policy analysis, interdisciplinary evidence, stakeholder engagement, ethical leadership, and public\-service\-oriented decision\-making. The program combines a strong foundation in global health systems, health economics, advocacy, crises and emergency settings, and research methods, while offering both a Capstone track and a Master’s Thesis track to support diverse professional and academic aspirations. Positioned at the intersection of public policy and global health, the MGHP program is designed to equip students with the knowledge, analytical tools, and practical skills needed to contribute to health policy development, implementation, and evaluation in Qatar, the region, and globally.
   

  

**Position:** 
 Full Professor
   

  

 To conduct teaching, research and service to contribute to HBKU becoming a world\-class research university and collaborate with faculty members and students to create a vibrant university community that will positively impact and contribute to the development of Qatar and the region by advancing knowledge in their field and developing human capacity through their teaching
   

  

**Job Description (In Bullet Points Only)**
* Provide academic, strategic, and administrative leadership for the Master of Global Health Policy (MGHP) program in advancing evidence\-based, policy\-relevant, and globally engaged education and research, aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030 and relevant international accreditation standards.
* Lead the continued development, review, and enhancement of the MGHP curriculum, including oversight of program quality assurance, accreditation\-related processes, and continuous improvement.
* Strengthen and expand partnerships with government entities, international organizations, health institutions, and other relevant stakeholders to support teaching, research, and policy engagement.
* Teach graduate\-level courses aligned with the MGHP Program Learning Outcomes (PLOs), including areas such as global health policy analysis, health systems, health economics, policy processes, culturally responsive communication, and ethical public\-service\-oriented leadership.
* Supervise graduate student capstone projects, master’s theses, and independent research in areas relevant to global health policy.
* Maintain an internationally recognized research profile in global health policy, health systems, health governance, health economics, or related fields.
* Lead and secure externally funded research projects, including national and international grants.
* Publish in high\-impact journals and contribute to regional and global debates in global health policy and public policy.
* Promote applied, policy\-relevant research that informs decision\-making and contributes to addressing health challenges in Qatar, the region, and globally.
* Mentor junior faculty and contribute to faculty development, research capacity building, and academic leadership within the College.
* Disseminate research findings through publications, policy reports, conferences, public engagement, and scholarly presentations to enhance the visibility and reputation of HBKU and the College.
* Perform other reasonable duties as assigned by the Dean or the University.


**Minimum Knowledge, Skills \& Experience (In Bullet Points Only)**
* PhD in Global Health Policy, Public Policy, Public Health, Health Economics, or a closely related field.
* Academic qualifications, scholarly standing, and professional experience commensurate with appointment at the rank of Full Professor.
* Distinguished record of high\-impact publications, externally funded research, graduate teaching excellence, and the ability to bridge research, teaching, and policy practice.
* Recognized expertise in global health systems, health policy, health governance, health economics, and/or applied policy analysis.
* 12\+ years of relevant full\-time university teaching, research, and academic leadership experience, with evidence of sustained professional maturity, productivity, and impact.
* Demonstrated excellence in teaching, student supervision, curriculum development, and program leadership at the graduate level.
* Evidence of active participation in the scholarly and academic affairs of a university and/or relevant professional associations.
* Sustained portfolio of scholarly achievement, including funded research grants, peer\-reviewed publications, and other scholarly contributions, comparable to peers at leading research universities.
* Evidence of a strong regional and international reputation within the discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with diverse groups, cultures, and communities.
* Proven ability to develop networks, collaborations, and partnerships within HBKU and with national and international partner institutions in teaching, research, and policy engagement.
* Strong track record of engaging and collaborating with policy stakeholders, government entities, international organizations, and health\-sector institutions at national, regional, and international levels.

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**FINANCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* This position is responsible for cost containment through the proper use, handling and maintenance of records, reports, supplies and equipment.
* Identifies potential expense reductions through cost control.
* Analyzes operational problems and establishes controls.
* Reviews timesheets and forwards them to the Executive Chef for approval.
* May prepare a variety of reports and letters utilizing personal computer system and equipment.
* Ensures that items are requisitioned in correct quantities, within acceptable timeframes and in accordance with established control procedures.
* Conducts workstation spot checks to ensure items are correctly stored to minimize deterioration and waste.



  





**MOTIVATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Monitors and manages the various assigned workstation functions.
* Monitors the assignment of duties and responsibilities to their staff.
* Observes and evaluates staff and work procedures to ensure quality standards and service are met.
* Makes recommendations regarding personnel actions such as new hire requests and discharges, to ensure adequate and continuous staffing.
* Inspects workstations, work areas, equipment, etc. to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 




  




* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

**Locations**

 Who We Are
   

  

**Location: Doha \| Riyadh**
 The Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures\-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

**About BCG Platinion**
 BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time\-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading\-edge tech platforms, at scale.
   

  

**Practice Area**
 BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York\-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh\-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.
   

  

 We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management \& financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Principal IT/Digital in the Energy Practice, you will work closely with our client's leadership teams to understand their key challenges, define IT strategies, win buy\-in for your recommendations and lead fellow BCG case team members to transform client potential into performance with high\-impact assignments. You will deploy customized IT strategies, digital platforms and architecture in order to leverage the digital potential of our customers in order to deliver long lasting value. You will evaluate and coach our clients' technology teams, manage quality and risk while maintaining client expectations and escalations. Besides the functional guidance of the project team you will also be operationally responsible for the execution and management of the solution. Together with our clients you will develop convincing IT strategies, concepts and solutions that have a lasting impact on the organization, operating model, digital, and/or data landscape.
   

  

 You will manage diverse teams of consulting talent. Your role will be to help those teams flourish by provoking thought, team mentoring, knowledge sharing, giving frequent feedback and creating opportunities for team members to learn and grow. You will also personally develop and grow by being exposed to new and complex challenges daily.
   

  

 Clients will also seek your advice as a thought leader on business issues that extend beyond the immediate scope of you project work. Finally as a Principal you will contribute to the Practice Area development and help to strengthen the BCG Platinion brand as a AI and digital leader.
   

  

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**
* Driving results in complex environments
* Solving business and technology problems
* Building strong client relationships
* Leading and developing teams
* Communicating complex topics clearly
* Collaborating across teams


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 8–12\+ years in IT consulting or digital transformation
* Experience in Energy sector (e.g., Oil \& Gas, Petrochemicals)
* Track record in IT transformation delivery
* Expertise in IT/ Digital architecture, cloud, data \& AI topics
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management
* Excellent academic degree
* Excellent English communication skills, Arabic is a plus.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You will work in a collaborative environment with continuous development opportunities, growing toward Director\-level roles while deepening expertise in Energy and IT/ digital transformation.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

 This role oversees network operations, infrastructure modernization, automation
data.jd_text:
The Head of Network Infrastructure Operations is responsible for defining and executing the organization's network infrastructure strategy while ensuring operational excellence across all network services.
 



  





 This role oversees network operations, infrastructure modernization, automation initiatives, security compliance, vendor management, and the delivery of highly available, scalable, and secure network environments aligned with business objectives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Operational Excellence \& NOC Management** 




  




* Lead and oversee the 24/7 Network Operations Center (NOC) to ensure proactive monitoring and rapid incident response.
* Establish, measure, and continuously improve network Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
* Manage engineering teams operating in high\-pressure, mission\-critical environments with strict uptime requirements.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and event organizers to translate operational requirements into technical network solutions.
* Lead the response to major incidents and ensure detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and corrective action plans are completed.



  





**Strategic Infrastructure Roadmap** 




  




* Develop and execute the long\-term network infrastructure strategy.
* Design and implement scalable enterprise network architectures across LAN, WAN, Data Center, and Cloud environments.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies such as SD\-WAN, WiFi 6E, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Lead infrastructure transformation initiatives, including the retirement of legacy platforms and migration to modern network technologies.



  





**Network Automation \& Innovation** 




  




* Drive automation initiatives to reduce manual operational activities and improve efficiency.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines and automated change management processes for network operations.
* Standardize infrastructure deployment and configuration management using tools such as Ansible, Terraform, and Python.
* Promote innovation and continuous improvement across network engineering and operations teams.



  





**Risk Management \& Security Compliance** 




  




* Partner with Information Security teams to implement Zero Trust networking principles and enterprise firewall policies.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory frameworks including ISO 27001 and SOC 2\.
* Develop and maintain disaster recovery (DR) strategies and business continuity plans.
* Conduct regular testing and validation of recovery procedures and operational resilience capabilities.



  





**Financial \& Vendor Management** 




  




* Own and manage annual network infrastructure CAPEX and OPEX budgets.
* Lead negotiations with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), hardware vendors, and managed service providers.
* Manage vendor performance and conduct regular business reviews with strategic technology partners.
* Ensure investments deliver measurable business value and operational efficiency.



  





**Experience** 




  




* 12–15 years of experience in Network Engineering, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership position.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale, multi\-vendor enterprise network environments including Cisco, Arista, HPE, and related technologies.
* Deep expertise in global backbone and enterprise networking technologies, including BGP, MPLS, SD\-WAN, and VXLAN.
* Strong experience with hybrid cloud connectivity solutions, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS Direct Connect, and Azure ExpressRoute.
* Proven hands\-on experience with data center networking technologies, including Cisco ACI, Cisco Nexus Switching, Cisco UCS, and VMware NSX.



  





**Competencies** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Expert\-level knowledge of centralized network controllers and software\-defined fabrics such as Cisco ACI, VMware NSX, or equivalent technologies.
* Deep expertise in enterprise and service provider routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EVPN.
* Strong understanding of encapsulation and transport technologies such as VXLAN and MPLS.
* Proven ability to design and manage virtual overlays, logical network segmentation, and micro\-segmentation security policies.
* Strong knowledge of network automation and orchestration using Python, Ansible, Terraform, and related technologies.
* Advanced expertise in Layer 4–Layer 7 technologies including load balancing, traffic engineering, and Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB).
* Expertise in integrating firewalls, IDS/IPS solutions, and Zero Trust security frameworks within enterprise network architectures.
* Advanced knowledge of deep packet inspection, flow telemetry, network observability, and proactive performance monitoring.
* Ability to optimize latency, throughput, availability, and overall network performance.



  





**Preferred Certifications** 




  




* Valid CCIE Certification (Mandatory).
* CCNP
* ITIL Foundation
* PMP
* Azure Certified Advanced Networking

To establish, lead and direct the architecture and implementation of Naufar’s Information Technology (IT) strategy, in order to effectively and efficiently develop and deliver fit\-for\-use IT infrastructure, integrated business solutions and IT support services to support Naufar’s strategy and objectives
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




**Corporate Strategy** 



* As a member of the senior management, lead the development of the strategies and plans for the Information Technology department and support in the development of the Operations division strategy to ensure that Naufar executes its mission effectively, achieves organizational objectives and realizes its vision.
* Lead the translation of Naufar’s overarching strategy into business plans for the Information Technology Department and ensure effective performance monitoring and management, in order to achieve department’s strategic objectives.



**Leadership** 



* Ensure the achievement of the departmental strategic objectives by setting priorities and objectives for direct reports, managing performance, developing a highly qualified talent pool and motivating them, and providing strategic direction, in order to maximize performance, improve productivity and reach operational excellence.
* Work closely with the Assistant COO to raise employee awareness and commitment to Naufar’s vision, mission, values and corporate strategy, in order to increase workforce engagement.



**Organization Structure** 



* Define efficient and effective organization structure for the department in coordination with the Organization Development and Human Resources to ensure optimum resource utilization, fast decision\-making and better communication among staff.



**Budget Planning** 



* Provide direction on department’s budget preparation in line with the department’s annual business plan.
* Ensure effective and continuous monitoring of financial performance of the department against its budget so that the organization is aware of anticipated costs and/or revenues, is able to identify areas of unsatisfactory performance, and can capitalize on potential improvement opportunities.



**Enterprise Architecture** 



* Manage effective conceptualization and implementation of IT architecture, in order to ensure consistency and optimization of IT operations.
* Direct and guide the continuous improvement of IT architecture, systems and processes, in line with the latest global technologies and IT standards.
* Ensure compliance of IT systems with relevant international standards and local laws and regulations, especially with respect to information security and data privacy.



**Demand and Delivery Management** 



* Direct and guide the comprehensive translation of business needs into IT projects and ensure timely, quality and efficient execution, in order to ensure effective IT support to other departments. Ensure adherence to time, cost and quality, in order to ensure efficient and effective delivery of services.
* Monitor quality and quantity of IT capacity to ascertain meeting current and future demands.



**System Development** 



* Provide overall direction to the system development team to direct and lead the effective analysis of user requirements, development/enhancement of IT systems as per business priority in order to ensure effective IT services management in accordance to business requirements.



**IT Operations and Support** 



* Direct and oversee IT operations so that they meet and exceed the service levels agreed with users and conforms to relevant technical and security standards within budgeted cost.
* Provide overall direction to infrastructure management team in order to ensure effective establishment and maintenance of a scalable and agile IT infrastructure that meets emerging and changing business requirements.
* Provide strategic direction on infrastructure related upgrades, both from system and network perspectives, to facilitate optimum service delivery.
* Ensure implementation of IT security policies and systems to safeguard and protect all IT operations ensuring the reliability and integrity of data.



**IT Performance Management** 



* Ensure effective development and implementation of quality assurance and control processes and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to facilitate provision of high quality IT services in accord with defined quality standards and SLAs.
* Ensure effective execution of IT audits, and collaboration of all relevant parties to achieve defined quality standards.
* Direct the development and management of IT services sourcing strategy and vendor management policies \& guidelines, in order to ensure meeting IT requirements in accordance with statutory and Naufar’s policies with optimum benefits to the organization.



**IT Projects and Programs** 



* Based on the IT strategy and annual plan, evaluate the viability of IT projects and develop a prioritized project list based on commercial feasibility and Naufar’s business requirements.
* Develop the IT project methodology and framework including development of detailed project scope and user requirements, required resources, outsourcing strategy, cost schedule, risk management plan, testing plan etc., to ensure project gets execution within the quality, time and approved costs.



  





**Professional/Academic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT engineering or equivalent from a reputable university.



**Experience:** 



* 12 years of relevant IT experience in healthcare industry, with at least 5 years of experience in a managerial role.
* Strong knowledge on IT Governance and best practices such as ITIL, COBIT or ISO 20000\.
* Knowledge of the healthcare sector in Qatar.

**Description**
 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design. From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel. If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry. Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the divisional project portfolio through robust governance, data\-informed planning, and change enablement, working hand in hand with the Product Development \& Design (PDD) PMO team. You will ensure that all PDD initiatives are governed effectively, executed in accordance with best\-in\-class methodologies, and strategically synchronized with Qatar Airways governance forums such as the Group\-level Enterprise Program Management Office (EPMO). The role champions the PDD agenda in line with the GCEO vision and the direction set by the SVP Product Development \& Design, while fostering innovation and continuous improvement in how projects are planned, governed, and delivered.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

**Strategic Governance \& Synchronization**
* Establish and maintain a divisional project governance framework that ensures consistency, transparency, and adherence to the QR 2\.0 vision and the QR Group strategic priorities.
* Ensure synchronization of PDD project efforts with enterprise\-wide programs, including EPMO\-led initiatives, while maintaining focus on divisional priorities and outcomes.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary and Purpose** 



* Ensure that the Fleet is managed safely, efficiently, in a professional manner to standards and costs that are in line with the industry best practices.
* Oversee and monitor the overall operational management being provided by third parties.



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Management** 



* Establish and continuously monitor operational standards of ships to ensure delivery of continuous, efficient and safe service to the customer
* Provide marine operational expertise and advice with regards to operational matters. Assist with the assessment of operational risks and mitigations
* Provide guidance and conduct port and terminal due diligence to ensure safe and efficient operations
* Monitors / Ensure high standard day to day marine operational activities of LNG, LPG, FSRU and any chartered in vessels
* Identify sub\-standard operational performance and evaluate alternative methods, systems and contractors to use in place of the obsolete systems



  





**Cargo Management and compliance** 



* Ensure that the vessels are operated in a manner which is safe, reliable and economical meeting the highest industry standards. This shall ensure efficiency in cargo management
* Drive compliance with international, Flag State, legal requirements and all company policies related to shipping operations, safety of navigation and Marine personnel at all times. Oversee/ensure complete compliance with port / terminals requirements, oil / gas majors and ship vetting systems
* Ensure that the trading certification of vessels are valid and avoid failure due to non\-compliance
* Monitor performance of the vessels against charter parties to ensure commercial interests of owners are protected. Prepare defense for performance and off hire claims
* Monitor LNG bespoke developed emergency STS transfer with the third\-party service provider in conjunction with the charterers to be able to deploy promptly if required
* Visit ships as required and instructed by the Operations Manager. Develop reports on the upkeep, operational standards, and effective management of vessels
* Monitors and ensure ship\-shore loading efficiency, passage performance, ship performance, and cargo management are done efficiently
* Ensure terminal compatibility and assurance process completed safely and timely. Ensure compliance with port / terminals requirements, ship vetting systems (oil / gas majors) at all times



  





**Vetting of Vessels** 



* Ensure that vessels in the fleet are vetted successfully by arranging timely SIRE inspections, giving prompt responses to any observations raised, initiate remedial actions and identify and mitigate gaps in policies and procedures
* Manage the entry of details from the VPQ into the SIRE system as well as maintain the relevant vessels particulars data not limited to TMSA and Q88 records



  





**Audits and Ship Inspections** 



* Conduct ship inspections on a regular basis to ensure effective ship management during calls to Ras Laffan or sailing visit. In these visits, he/she shall carry out internal audits not limited to navigational, galley and cargo audits
* Conduct safety / security / environmental and other SHEQ internal audits as applicable
* Supervise the close\-out of audits and inspections of ships in coordination with the SHEQ Division



  





**Safety Management System** 



* Maintain the Safety Management System (SMS) of the organization and consistently focus on improving the quality, efficiency of procedures and accuracy
* Brief new senior officers before they join the vessels with regards to the Safety Management System, company policies, vessel operations and specific charterers’ requirements
* Supervise and carry out security duties as per ISPS code if requested by management



  





**Monitor Communication:** 



* Confirm owned vessels managed by third party is operated efficiently in line with Master Service agreement, Owners instructions, charterer’s instruction and TCP



  





**Voyage Planning** 



* Supervise the voyage planning and performance process for the vessels managed by NSQL to ensure compliance with the requirements of the charterer. Help the organization to avoid performance related claims and provide support in challenging the claims in case they are raised



  





**Terminal Approval** 



* Participate actively. ship shore interface and compatibly studies Liaise with all related parties such as agents, charterers and terminals and provide all relevant information for the Master to assess the suitability of the berth
* Carry out in\-house mooring analysis Studies



  





**Incident investigations and Risk Assessment** 



* Lead investigations into incidents that occurred and ensure that incidents are successfully closed out in a timely manner in coordination with the SHEQ Division
* Conduct safety risk assessment and environmental impact assessment for vessel operations in line with Maritime standard / best industry practice



  





**Emergency Response Plan:** 



* Perform duties and functions as per the Emergency Response Plan and as directed by the Incident Commander



  





  





**Qualifications, Experience and Job** 




  





**Skills Qualifications** 



* Degree in Nautical Science or any other related field
* Master Mariner Certificate of competence and all associated courses with this competence certification.



  





**Experience:** 



* A minimum of 12 years’ experience including 3 years’ as Master on LNG/LPG. At least 4 years’ in a head office management position of a large gas/oil shipping company.
* Prior shore base experience in similar role for at least 2 years or Marine Operational Supt experience for at least 8 year managing LNG/LPG vessels.
* Experience of working with personnel from different cultures (ship owners and ship crews)



  





**Job Specific Skills:** 



* Fully conversant with international and national statutory requirements of the Maritime industry (SOLAS, ISM, MARPOL, ISPS, SOPEP, ISOs)
* Training and knowledge of emergency response procedures, ship vetting, ship inspection is essential.
* Auditing skills\- Lead ISO, ISM, ISPS auditor
* Computer literate\- Microsoft suite of products

**🚀 Welcome to Your Next Adventure!**

 This is a standalone, high\-impact role focused on execution, optimization, and profitability. You will work directly with the COO to translate strategy into disciplined operational outcomes. Food is a high\-frequency, high\-pressure business — it demands precision, speed, and strong judgment under constant movement.
   

  

 You will be responsible for the operational engine of the Food vertical: vendor performance, delivery efficiency, cost structures, contribution margins, and overall vertical performance health. Every operational lever that impacts reliability, scalability, and profitability will sit under your direct ownership.
   

  

 This is not a coordination role. It is a performance role.
   

  

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**
* Operational Strategy \& Execution
* Partner closely with the COO to define and execute the Food operations roadmap.
* Convert strategic priorities into measurable KPIs and execution plans.
* Ensure sustainable order growth while protecting contribution margins and operational stability.
* Drive operational readiness for expansions, new initiatives, and structural improvements across the vertical.
* Food Vertical Performance \& Unit Economics
* Own the core performance metrics of the Food vertical including fulfillment rate, SLA adherence, cancellation rate, delivery time, cost per order, rider productivity, and customer satisfaction.
* Continuously optimize supply\-demand balance in dense operating environments.
* Refine incentive structures for riders and restaurant partners with a clear understanding of their economic impact.
* Work closely with Finance to model profitability scenarios and implement cost control initiatives.
* You should deeply understand how prep time affects dispatch logic, how batching impacts utilization, and how operational mechanics influence margin.
* Process Optimization \& Scalability
* Identify inefficiencies across the Food operational lifecycle and eliminate them through structured, data\-driven problem solving. Standardize SOPs and improve operational consistency.
* Collaborate with Product and Tech to automate manual workflows and enhance dispatch, batching, and visibility tools.
* Lead root cause analysis for service failures and implement corrective action frameworks that prevent recurrence.
* Restaurant Operations \& Partner Success
* Monitor and improve restaurant operational metrics including prep time accuracy, acceptance rates, SLA compliance, and order quality.
* Work closely with Commercial to ensure operational feasibility during onboarding and scaling.
* Reduce friction between restaurants and logistics by introducing structured performance frameworks and clear accountability mechanisms.
* Analytics \& Performance Discipline
* Lead weekly and monthly performance reviews backed by data and actionable insights.
* Build and refine dashboards, reporting structures, and performance scorecards that directly influence operational decisions.
* Leverage demand forecasting, cohort analysis, and behavioural data to identify growth and efficiency levers. When metrics shift, you understand why — and you act decisively.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The overall role for the position is to assist the SVP/ VP Innovation to drive cultural change around one dedicated strategic innovation themes. The incumbent will manage and monitor all innovation initiatives within his/ her scope in order to ensure that they are implemented and completed within the defined time, budget and requirements with the support of the originally allocated resources. The incumbent will also be responsible for developing, driving and rolling out appropriate tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level. He/ she is also responsible for actively maintaining and updating the established ecosystem.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships across all business and support units as well as countries across QNB Group
* Assist SVP/ VP in identifying, exploring and validating one or several Strategic themes: AI/ ML, API/ Open banking, Platforms and marketplaces, Robotics and automation
* Own post\-mortems on completed innovation initiatives to ensure that they delivered the forecasted value creation to the Group
* Assist other departments in identifying, analyzing and monitoring external innovation trends
* Manage the roll out of appropriate innovation tracking metrics for regular reporting to core stakeholders at a project, initiative and program level
* Supervise the update of established performance metrics
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Assistant Vice President Innovation role.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Support the SVP/ VP Innovation to successfully run the innovation agenda
* Foster and empower employees to create a bottom\-up innovation culture in which participants share ideas to improve existing products/ services
* Act as a partner to the concerned business and support divisions and lead process improvement projects together with representatives from one or more business and support divisions
* Manage activities centered around instilling the innovation culture at QNB, such as innovation days, hackathons, innovation lab, etc.
* Supervise in the preparation of regular updates to the Executive Management on global innovative trends, status of current QNB innovation initiatives and impact of completed innovation projects
* Act as a coach and support for SMEs in the evaluation stage \- Act as a content owner for the Innovation Learning and Development resources accessible to the QNB employee base
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Obtain mandate, inputs and overall direction from EVP/ SVP/ VP Innovation on specific initiatives
* Supervise the development and preparation of all policies/ processes and procedures as well as standards
* Coordinate the innovation execution by managing the portfolio of group\-wide innovation initiatives and conducting the post\-mortem on completed initiatives
* Be involved and engaged in individual projects on a day\-to\-day basis to provide assistance to the project teams
* Demonstrate advanced project management skills and implement industry best practices and standards of project portfolio management
* Demonstrate deep understanding of Lean and Process Management to ensure alignment with the work undertaken across the wider Innovation Department
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify related areas for professional self\-development
* Possess strong project management fundamentals as well as project portfolio management methodology/ techniques and tools
* Maintain basic knowledge about banking processes, regulations, and generally accepted operating practices.
* Research industry topics and react by recommending changes to products, services, and systems
* Carry out other similar duties that can be defined within the broad functional job and functional responsibilities outlined above
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.


**Education \& Experience Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree from Top tier university degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 10 years work experience in a change management and senior advisory function within the financial services arena
* Proven track record within the field of innovation preferably from global financial services institution
* Track record as a change leader, motivator, driver for cultural change throughout a large and complex organization
* Substantial management experience and proven track record in driving senior management agenda
* Demonstrated career development, progress, and experience in establishing new functions
* High level knowledge of all major banking related business and support functions


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Highest Education Certificate

data.jd_text:
**About Bureau Veritas**
 Bureau Veritas is a world leader in testing, inspection and certification (TIC) services, operating across 140\+ countries. Our MCA Sustainability Services team helps organisations across the Middle East, Caspian \& Africa measure, verify and improve their environmental and social performance. The CER (Certification) product line is BV's fastest\-growing sustainability stream in the region, covering GHG verification, carbon accounting, ESG assurance, sustainability advisory, social audits and supply chain due diligence.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Sustainability Specialist is a country\-based technical and commercial delivery role focused exclusively on Bureau Veritas’ Certification (CER) sustainability service line. Two positions are open: one in Egypt (Cairo) and one in Qatar (Doha), each embedded within their respective market.
   

  

 Reporting to the local head of CER product line and functionally to the MCA Director of Sustainability, the Specialist will be the primary CER sustainability presence in\-country: delivering client advisory mandates, leading proposal development, building the local CER pipeline and supporting BV’s brand in sustainability circles. This position is client\-facing and carries direct delivery responsibility across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance and related CER services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Advisory**
* Lead and deliver sustainability advisory mandates in\-country across core CER focus areas:


* 
+ Carbon accounting, GHG baseline assessments and Scope 1/2/3 inventories (ISO 14064 / GHG Protocol)
+ Organisational and product carbon footprint calculations and decarbonisation roadmaps
+ ESG strategy development, materiality assessments and CDP/SBTi alignment
+ Sustainability report assurance under ISAE 3000 / ISSA 5000
+ CBAM exposure assessments and supply chain ESG due diligence
+ IFRS S2 readiness assessments and climate\-related financial disclosure support
+ EcoVadis score improvement programmes and ESG rating advisory
+ Conduct GHG verification audits and CER certification assessments in accordance with BV methodology and applicable international standards
+ Prepare high\-quality technical deliverables: verification reports, advisory frameworks, gap analyses, decarbonisation plans and client presentations
+ Coordinate with the MCA regional team and Egypt Technical Hub for peer review, QA/QC and technical sign\-off on complex mandates
+ Stay current with regulatory developments relevant to in\-country clients: local ESG disclosure requirements, CBAM updates, ISSB/IFRS S2 implementation timelines

**Business Development \& Proposals**+ Lead or co\-lead the preparation of CER sustainability proposals, RFP responses and commercial offers for clients in Egypt / Qatar
+ Identify and qualify new CER business opportunities in\-country, building a local pipeline across carbon advisory, ESG reporting, assurance, social audits and supply chain services
+ Support regional BD campaigns including CBAM advisory, sustainability assurance, IFRS S2 readiness and GHG verification drives
+ Prepare and deliver tailored client presentations, pitches and capability documents for local market audiences
+ Participate in bid/no\-bid decisions with the regional Director and maintain accurate, real\-time pipeline records in Salesforce
+ Develop in\-country relationships with potential referral sources: law firms, financial advisors, sustainability consultancies and industry associations

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**+ Serve as the primary BV point of contact for CER sustainability clients in\-country — managing the full relationship from proposal through delivery, reporting and invoicing
+ Liaise with local regulatory bodies, stock exchanges, accreditation authorities and relevant government entities on CER matters
+ Represent Bureau Veritas at local sustainability events, ESG forums, carbon market conferences and industry roundtables
+ Manage repeat business opportunities, client satisfaction and contract renewals within the CER portfolio

**Operational \& Reporting**+ Maintain accurate Salesforce records for all in\-country CER opportunities: pipeline values, stages, submission dates and win/loss outcomes
+ Prepare monthly country performance reports and pipeline inputs for MCA Director and area leadership
+ Ensure all CER mandates comply with BV quality standards, methodology requirements and relevant accreditation obligations
+ Contribute country\-specific content to the MCA proposal library: case studies, client references, CVs and service descriptions
+ Participate in monthly MCA thematic training sessions and contribute to the quarterly regional sustainability newsletter

**Requirements**
**Essential**+ 4–6 years of experience in sustainability consulting, ESG advisory, GHG verification or CER\-related services in Egypt, Qatar or the broader MENA region
+ Solid technical command of core CER sustainability disciplines:


* 
+ GHG accounting and verification: ISO 14064, GHG Protocol, Scope 1/2/3 inventories
+ Carbon footprint methodologies and net\-zero/decarbonisation advisory
+ ESG reporting frameworks: GRI, ISSB/IFRS S2, ESRS, CDP, TCFD
+ Sustainability assurance standards: ISAE 3000, ISSA 5000
+ CBAM and cross\-border carbon due diligence
+ Supply chain ESG mapping and third\-party risk (C97\)
+ Excellent written English — ability to produce clear, professional technical reports, advisory deliverables and commercial proposals independently
+ Client\-facing experience: ability to manage relationships, lead discovery meetings and present findings to senior stakeholders
+ Bachelor’s degree in sustainability, environmental science, engineering, business or a related field

**Preferred**+ Professional certification: GHG Verifier, ISO 14064 Lead Auditor, GRI Certified Practitioner, CDP\-accredited advisor, or equivalent
+ Knowledge of local market regulatory context:


- 

* Egypt: FRA sustainability disclosure requirements, Egyptian Exchange ESG guidelines, national GHG registry developments
* Qatar: QSE ESG reporting requirements, National Vision 2030 sustainability pillars, QFC regulatory environment
* Arabic language proficiency — strongly preferred for both roles given client and regulatory engagement
* Experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM tools for pipeline management
* Familiarity with EcoVadis, MSCI ESG, S\&P Global, or other ESG ratings platforms
* Knowledge of social auditing principles (SMETA, SA8000\) as an additional CER service area


**What We Offer**
* Country\-embedded, client\-facing role with real delivery responsibility and direct market impact
* High visibility to MCA Sustainability Director and regional leadership from day one
* Exposure to sustainability mandates and clients across 35\+ countries within the MCA region
* Competitive salary benchmarked to local market (Egypt — Cairo / Qatar — Doha)
* Access to BV’s global CER methodology, tools, accreditations and technical expertise network
* Clear career pathway into senior specialist, area lead or technical expert roles within BV MCA Sustainability
* Professional development through BV’s internal training programmes and external sustainability certification support

**Description**
 At Qatar Airways, we craft cutting\- edge inflight products, enhance passenger comfort, and drive innovation in aviation design.
   

  

 From concept to launch, our Product Development and Design (PDD) Team collaborates with industry leaders to create products that set new standards in travel.
   

  

 If you are passionate about innovation and design, this is your chance to make a lasting impact in the aviation industry.
   

  

 Join our Product Development and Design Team that transforms ideas into reality and shape the future of airline experiences!
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Product Integration Specialist, you will support the planning, coordination, and controlled execution of digital product, platform, system, and third\-party integration activities across the IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience portfolio. Working under the direct guidance of the Product Integration Manager, you will help ensure that product features, interfaces, and dependent solutions are integrated in line with approved business requirements, technical specifications, delivery timelines, and quality standards.
   

  

 This is a delivery\-focused, coordination\-heavy role. You will be the person who keeps integration activity organised, documented, and on track — maintaining the artefacts, monitoring the dependencies, supporting testing cycles, and ensuring nothing falls through the gaps between teams. You will work closely with product, engineering, architecture, and vendor teams, acting as a reliable point of coordination across complex, multi\-stakeholder workstreams.
   

  

 You will report directly to the Product Integration Manager, who sits within the broader IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience function led by the Head of IFEC and Connected Cabin Experience. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically minded delivery specialist to build deep expertise in connected cabin platforms and grow within a team that is shaping the future of inflight digital experience.
   

  

 As part of your role, your responsibilities will be inclusive of, but not limited to the following:
   

  

 Integration Coordination and Support
   

  

* Support the coordination of end\-to\-end integration activities for assigned initiatives, ensuring requirements, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables are documented and tracked in line with the integration plan
* Assist the Product Integration Manager in translating business, product, and functional requirements into structured integration plans, interface activities, and implementation work packages
* Liaise with product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, cyber security, operations, and vendor teams as directed, supporting alignment on solution design, interface readiness, and deployment planning
* Coordinate with internal technical teams and third\-party suppliers to help validate interface specifications, technical dependencies, configuration readiness, and integration deliverables


 Delivery Tracking and Risk Support
   

  

* Monitor integration milestones and flag delivery risks, defects, and blockers to the Product Integration Manager in a timely and structured manner
* Maintain risk and issue logs, tracking mitigation actions and resolution progress across active integration workstreams
* Support the escalation process by preparing clear, factual summaries of delivery concerns for review by the Product Integration Manager


 Documentation and Artefact Management
   

  

* Prepare, maintain, and update integration artefacts including requirements traceability matrices, interface registers, dependency logs, test plans, defect logs, deployment checklists, and operational readiness documentation
* Ensure all artefacts are accurate, version\-controlled, and accessible to relevant stakeholders throughout the integration lifecycle
* Support the production of structured status reports, meeting documentation, and governance inputs as directed by the Product Integration Manager
* Testing and Release Support
* Support system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, and release readiness activities by coordinating inputs, tracking outcomes, and following up on remediation actions
* Help ensure that implementation activities are carried out in line with change governance, release controls, and service continuity requirements as defined by the Product Integration Manager and broader governance frameworks
* Assist with cutover, go\-live, hypercare, and transition\-to\-support activities to help ensure integrated solutions are deployed and stabilised smoothly


 Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Capture post\-implementation observations, lessons learned, and service performance insights, and share these with the Product Integration Manager to support continuous improvement in integration delivery
* Contribute to team knowledge by maintaining up\-to\-date records, sharing delivery insights, and identifying opportunities to improve integration coordination processes


**Be part of an extraordinary story**
 Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community.
   

  

 Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 To be successful in this role, you should have:
   

  

 High School or Vocational Qualification with a minimum of 7 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in project coordination, systems integration support, or digital product delivery.
   

  

**Essential**
* Proven experience in a project delivery, systems integration, or digital product coordination role, with a track record of supporting structured delivery programmes in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment
* Good understanding of digital product delivery and systems integration principles, including awareness of dependencies across applications, platforms, services, and third\-party solutions
* Ability to develop and maintain structured delivery artefacts including requirements traceability matrices, interface inventories, issue logs, deployment records, and operational readiness documentation
* Hands\-on experience supporting testing and release activities including system integration testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, and cutover support
* Strong coordination and communication skills with the ability to work effectively across business, product, engineering, operations, and vendor teams
* Ability to monitor delivery progress, maintain risk and issue logs, and communicate concerns clearly and promptly to senior team members
* Working familiarity with change control, release governance, and service transition processes within a structured delivery environment
* Clear and organized written communication skills with the ability to produce accurate status reports, meeting notes, and governance documentation


**Preferred**
* Experience working in a connected digital platform, consumer technology, media, or enterprise systems environment
* Familiarity with IFEC systems, connected cabin platforms, or aviation digital product environments is advantageous but not required
* Working knowledge of APIs, middleware, data flows, and service integration concepts
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies within product or transformation programmes
* Experience coordinating with external vendors and third\-party suppliers in a delivery context
* Exposure to UI/UX product development environments and an interest in digital passenger or consumer experience


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 If you’re ready to join a progressive team and have a challenging and rewarding career, then apply now by uploading your CV and completing our quick application form.

data.jd_text:
The ICT Change Management Specialist is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end delivery of cybersecurity certification programs and assurance services. The role oversees certification assessments, critical sector audits, and the development of standardized methodologies and frameworks. It ensures the effectiveness, consistency, and continuous improvement of certification operations while translating strategic objectives into executable programs. The role also leads stakeholder engagement, team management, and the delivery of national\-level cybersecurity certification initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of all certification services and programs
* Oversee certification review assessment for all certification programs
* Responsible for critical sector audits as the Certification Lead
* Establish, monitor and enhance standardized audit methodologies, practices, and certification standards.
* Continuously assess and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Certification program.
* Translate the strategic direction from the department head into actionable projects and programs.
* Plan, build and operate cybersecurity certification standards and related assurance mechanisms
* Plan, prioritize, and oversee delivery of projects and initiatives within the Certification Services portfolio
* Provide solutions for challenges encountered in the operation and promotion of assurance services.
* Follow\-up with the top management on resources and requirements for the benefits of the department.
* Manage, monitor and support the planning, preparation and delivery of certification related public events (workshops, trainings, conferences, etc.)
* Interact with stakeholders, providing expert feedback on challenges and insights to the operation team.
* Coordinate with other departments activities in relation to assurance.
* Manage stakeholder interaction for collaboration with internal and external projects
* Manage, mentor and lead the certification team and improve service delivery (operational guidance, professional development, and capability enhancement)


**Requirements**
**Education \& Experience:**
* Master’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or related field, or minimum 15 years of relevant experience.
* At least 6 years of experience in cybersecurity assessment, IT auditing, or certification\-related roles.
* Strong background in cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance.


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer.
* COBIT, CRISC, CGEIT, or other governance and risk management certifications.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and information security standards (ISO 27001, NIA, COBIT, Common Criteria, etc.).
* Understanding of accreditation and certification frameworks (ISO 17021, 17024, 17065, 17025, 27006\).
* Experience in developing standards, technical directives, SOPs, and audit documentation.
* Strong background in risk management and compliance assessment.
* Proven project management experience delivering initiatives on time, within scope, and budget.
* Experience in regulatory compliance and national cybersecurity standard development.


**Core Skills**
* Strong technical report writing and documentation skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including briefing senior executives.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in complex environments.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities effectively.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to quality and accuracy.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Ability to work independently and drive initiatives proactively.


**Language:** 
 English (required)
   

  

**Availability:** 
 As soon as possible
   

  

 The contract duration is 12 months, with the possibility of extension based on departmental requirements.
