**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 14th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.
   

  

 The school is focused on supporting students towards enhanced Physical Education language acquisition, excellent academic outcomes and outstanding learning experiences through STEAM, Performing Arts, extra\-curricular activities, residential trips, and international awards for wider achievement.
   

  

 The school prides itself on fostering student wellbeing, personalisation of learning and a strong sense of multiculturalism and global citizenship. We also have strong through\-school links and ensure consistent progression from Primary to Secondary to offer all our students a rewarding learning journey. The Primary school buildings have recently undergone further refurbishment following the opening of a brand\-new Secondary building in August 2019\. Our students also now benefit from a new 25m outdoor pool.
   

  

 To learn more about NAISAK, please visit
   

  

 https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/nais\-al\-khor
   

  

**About Nord Anglia Education**
 Each Nord Anglia Education school is unique in character and designed to meet the needs of its community. We are united by our philosophy, to be ambitious for our students, our people, and our family of schools. We believe that being part of our family of schools gives them a special advantage. Working together, we can achieve more than we can individually. Our schools have access to a wide range of resources and support to enhance their success. We also create unique opportunities to benefit our students and people, such as the Global Campus, Nord Anglia University, and our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London.
   

  

 When you join a Nord Anglia Education school, you join a global community of more than 16,000 people working together to support our students' success. We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 Our collaborations with The Juilliard School, MIT, UNICEF, and King's College London, offer our teachers unrivalled access to leading experts in their fields. We also offer selected candidates from our staff worldwide an opportunity to earn their Executive Master's in International Education in an exclusive collaboration with King's College London.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in one of the world's most vibrant countries.
   

  

 As a Nord Anglia Education teacher, you enjoy the following benefits:
   

  

  

* A fast\-paced, global experience so that you can progress on a global scale
* An enabling environment founded on creativity, challenge and collaboration

* Design, implement, and maintain scheduling protocols under the guidance of the Head of Screening Programs.
* Monitor daily scheduling activities to ensure smooth, accurate, and efficient operations.

* Ensure appointments are scheduled in accordance with organizational, site, and system protocols.



  





**Team Leadership** 




  




* Supervise, coach, and support scheduling staff to achieve performance and service standards.

* Ensure data integrity and compliance with documentation standards.



  





**Compliance \& Quality Assurance** 




  




* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, procedures, and healthcare regulations.

* Demonstrate a proactive approach to patient safety and report concerns promptly.

**Qualifications**

**Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Strong supervisory and team leadership skills.

* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 This section’s primary responsibility is to make sure that all Bonds/Securities/IRS Options, transactions have correctly been entered in the system – verified with Reuter/Email confirmations –The payment instructions are correctly entered as per SSI and Reuter confirmation – and the payment has been made in time – and the inward interbank Vostro payment orders from Vostro banks have been accurately processed from Financial Institutions Vostro accounts. Interest Accruals, amortization of Premium/Discount accurately done. Monitor the transactions from Risk point of view to make sure there are no processing lapses. Supervise the workflow and make sure all transactions done by Front Office have been accurately processed.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* 45 Billion QAR Volume of business per annum
* Cover Money settlement of Market; Foreign Exchange Capital Market
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Vice President Capital Market and Investment Operations
* Assist SVP, Treasury Operations in the annual budgeting and business plan process and the subsequent monitoring thereof.
* Control all financial reporting to other departments for all Treasury Products.
* In addition to supervising Management of huge investment portfolio of the bank. Monitor about QAR120MIO monthly average income on the portfolio. Ensure accurate recording of Derivative products profit and loss account
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal and External)
* To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Undertake supervisory review, manage all transaction flows \& ensure that dealing room transactions have entered the system in an accurate \& timely \-manner.
* Ensure Development of a team that understands the process \& workflow and can deliver results accurately.
* Ensure all treasury capital market transactions are processed and Authorized
* Ensure all the interbank vostro payment orders are processed and authorized.
* Ensure that all vostro bank accounts have been updated in EPH payment system.
* Supervise Nostro, Vostro \& Treasury Customer transfers.
* Supervise Reconciliation routines for deal ticket and associated media.
* Ensure that end day reports are daily produced.
* Maintain a shift schedule to cover the Treasury timings.
* Help in responding/ Solving any customers or other Banks issues promptly and refer any unavoidable delays directly to higher authorities.
* Adhere to Bank policy handling all Capital and FI Transactions.
* Make sure all transactions have been properly approve and booked in the system.
* Custody accounts periodically monitored and compared with the book to ensure Bank’s exposure is in line with bank policy.
* Interest receipt/payments are accurately and professionally monitored and accounting entries being correctly recorded.
* Market Price is timely updated in the system for Fair Value exposure of the bank as per Central Bank Policy
* Excellent knowledge of all Custodian Systems such as Euro\-clear; Cedel and others
* Respond to Financial Control queries with regards to variances and P/L and Accruals \& Financial Institution queries related to vostro accounts.
* Handle External and Internal Auditors to their satisfaction.
* Physical verification of the deals with Custodian and Bank’s GL.
* Ensure Periodical Reporting to the management and Central Bank as per policy.
* Supervise Staff: Ensure coordination amongst Section staff and coordination with other sections as Section Head
* Support International Branches \& subsidiaries
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and your teams overall performance on a regular basis.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
* Bachelors University graduate preferably with a Major in Marketing, Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or Information Technology (related field of study), Masters preferred
* At least 12 years of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank.
* Well developed negotiation skills.
* Ability to work under pressure
* High level of accuracy
* Adequate knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet software.
* Self\-motivated.
* Deputize SVP Treasury Operations


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Passport
* Educational Certificates

With
data.jd_text:
We are a Qatar\-based diversified investment holding group operating across five core business verticals: Infrastructure \& Contracting Ventures, Property Development, Hospitality \& Healthcare, Financial Services, and a Services Group encompassing Manpower, Facilities Management, and Catering. With an active and growing footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, and beyond — including operations in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, the Maldives, Albania, Algeria, Egypt, and Venezuela — the Group manages a complex, multi\-currency portfolio of businesses and investments requiring sophisticated treasury leadership.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Head of Treasury will be responsible for leading the Group’s capital structure, liquidity, funding strategy, and financial risk management framework. This is a critical executive role acting as the primary interface with international banking partners, credit institutions, and institutional stakeholders, ensuring robust financial governance, funding efficiency, and strategic capital allocation across the Group.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Debt \& Capital Structure** 



* Lead debt restructuring, refinancing, and capital optimization initiatives
* Develop and execute group\-wide funding and leverage strategies
* Manage corporate borrowing facilities and covenant compliance
* Present treasury strategy to CEO, Board, and Audit \& Risk Committee



**Syndicated Loans \& Banking** 



* Structure and negotiate syndicated and bilateral credit facilities with international banks
* Manage global banking relationships and lender communications
* Oversee loan documentation and legal coordination



**Liquidity \& Cash Management** 



* Oversee global liquidity, cash flow forecasting, and working capital optimization
* Implement cash pooling and intercompany funding structures
* Ensure adequate liquidity buffers across all entities



**Risk Management** 



* Design FX, interest rate, and commodity hedging strategies
* Manage derivatives, ISDA agreements, and hedge accounting compliance (IFRS 9\)



**Governance \& Strategy** 



* Develop treasury policies, controls, and governance frameworks
* Deliver treasury reporting to Board and external stakeholders
* Support M\&A, capital raising, and strategic finance initiatives
* Lead and develop the treasury team



  





**Requirements** 




  





**Essential** 



* 18\+ years of treasury experience, including 8\+ years in senior leadership roles
* Proven experience in debt restructuring and syndicated financing
* Strong expertise in liquidity management, FX risk, and capital markets
* Experience within large corporates, conglomerates, or investment holding groups
* Strong understanding of financial instruments and credit documentation (LMA preferred)
* Professional qualification (ACT, CFA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent)



**Desirable** 



* SAP TRM or treasury management systems experience
* Exposure to GCC, MENA, Africa, or frontier markets
* Experience with capital controls or complex jurisdictions
* ESG financing (green bonds / sustainability\-linked loans)
* High\-yield or leveraged finance exposure



**Leadership Competencies** 



* Strategic Thinking
* Executive Presence
* Negotiation Strength
* Risk Awareness
* People Leadership
* Strong Governance Mindset

data.jd_text:
Mandarin Oriental, Doha is looking for a Director of Commercial Strategy to join our team.
   

  

 Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.
   

  

 Mandarin Oriental is the award\-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought\-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting\-edge of luxury experiences.
   

  

 Mandarin Oriental, Doha is an intimate and stylish urban retreat, blending Qatari\-influenced heritage with modern design. Located in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, within walking distance to Souq Waqif, Museum of Islamic Art and a short distance to the business district, West Bay.
   

  

**About The Job**
 Based at Mandarin Oriental, Doha within the Commercial Strategy Department in Doha, the Director of Commercial Strategy is responsible for setting the hotel’s strategic business direction by balancing financial objectives, managing sales segments and guiding the commercial strategies of the hotel. Works with General Manager, Director of Marketing Communications and Director of Revenue to develop and implement the hotels commercial strategy to maximize hotel revenues, market share performance and profits. Director of Marketing and Director of Revenue will report directly to the Director of Commercial Strategy. Responsible for maximizing revenue and profit associated with rooms, function space and total revenue as required. Position is accountable for all transient, group and catering segments and deployment, pricing, channel distribution and positioning. Identifies future revenue opportunities and effectively communicates strategies to the sales and marketing colleagues. Oversees the Revenue department and all the processes associated with them such as demand, revenue, forecasting, inventory management, channel management and proactive opportunity analysis. Oversees both the Revenue Department and the Marketing Department, including all processes associated with demand, revenue, forecasting, inventory management, channel management, proactive opportunity analysis, and marketing communications. The Director of Commercial Strategy reports to the General Manager.
   

  

**As Director of Commercial Strategy, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

***About HEC Paris, Doha***




  





**﻿** 




 Founded in 1881 by the Paris Chamber of Commerce, HEC Paris is a leading European business school with the ambition to make a positive impact on both business and society. Its mission is driven by a unique “Think, Teach, Act” approach, aimed at fostering a more inclusive, sustainable, and prosperous world. With 167 research professors from around the globe, HEC Paris produces and shares cutting\-edge knowledge with over 5,000 students from more than 130 countries. Its campus serves as a true laboratory of innovation and dialogue, fully engaged with the world’s diversity and global challenges.
 



 In 2010, HEC Paris joined Qatar Foundation to bring world\-class management education programs and research to Doha and the region. Through its portfolio of programs and its local research activities, HEC Paris, Doha contributes to corporate competitiveness in the global economy, fully aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030 and supporting the transformation of Qatar into a sustainable, competitive, and knowledge\-based economy. In addition to offering degree programs, the school partners with corporate clients in Qatar and the region to design and deliver customized executive programs addressing current business and organizational challenges.
 



 HEC Paris is an exceptional workplace, located in state\-of\-the\-art premises in downtown Msheireb, at the heart of Doha. Joining HEC Paris, Doha is a unique opportunity to be part of a close\-knit community of talented individuals united around five core values: Curiosity, Excellence, Diversity, Responsibility, and Entrepreneurial Spirit.
 



 https://www.qatar.exed.hec.edu/
 



  





***Job Description***




  





  





 The Associate Director of Strategic Partnerships is responsible for generating and growing corporate revenue by leading the acquisition, development, and retention of strategic B2B clients for Executive Education programs in Qatar and the GCC region. The role owns a portfolio of key accounts, drives complex sales cycles, and builds long\-term corporate partnerships while ensuring commercial performance, pipeline health, and profitability targets are consistently achieved.
 



**Business Development \& Revenue Growth** 



* Drive corporate sales performance by developing and executing sales strategies aligned with institutional growth objectives
* Build and manage a strong pipeline of new and existing corporate clients using CRM tools, ensuring accurate forecasting and reporting

* Prepare and validate all commercial proposals and contracts in coordination with relevant stakeholders
* Conduct client meetings, presentations, and negotiations with senior decision\-makers
* Draft business proposals and ensuing contracts and validate all out\-going client commercial proposals, conduct client visits and presentations, working with all relevant internal stakeholders – Faculty, Legal, Operations, etc. – throughout the client lifecycle;
* Oversee account management plans for key clients, ensuring renewals, upselling, and cross\-selling opportunities are systematically pursued
* Work closely with the Chief Growth and Impact Officer on pricing strategies and profitability models to ensure sustainable margins
* Monitor revenue, pipeline health, and program profitability



**Program Design \& Experience** 



* Partner with Faculty / Subject Matter Experts to translate client needs into impactful learning solutions with clear objectives and learning outcomes

* Ensure seamless handovers from Sales to Operations, maintaining alignment between client expectations and program delivery
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, proposal quality, and client experience
* Act as a liaison with Executive Education peers on HEC Paris Main Campus to align standards, innovation, and best practices



**Relationship Management** 



* Build and maintain long\-term, trusted relationships with senior leaders and HR/L\&D stakeholders across client organizations

**Team Leadership** 



* Lead and manage direct reports, driving performance and accountability through clear objectives and KPIs, progress monitoring, regular check\-ins, and timely corrective actions when needed.

***Qualifications***




  





  





**Education and experience** 



* Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or a related discipline
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in B2B sales, business development, partnerships, or consulting within a services, education, or professional development environment
* Experience in Executive Education, Talent Development, Learning \& Development, or Leadership Development is highly preferred
* Experience in designing, pricing, and selling customized corporate learning solutions, including blended and digital formats
* Experience in GCC markets is a strong advantage.



**Skills and competencies** 



* Excellent written and spoken English. Arabic and French are advantageous.
* Strong consultative selling and negotiation capabilities with the ability to close high\-value, multi\-stakeholder deals
* Excellent presentation, communication, and proposal development skills
* Solid financial acumen with experience in pricing strategies, profitability modeling, and margin management
* Strong account management and relationship development capabilities
* Ability to analyze pipeline performance, forecasting data, and sales metrics to drive decisions
* Proficiency in CRM systems and Microsoft Office tools



**Ways of working** 



* Highly results\-driven with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Client\-centric, collaborative, and relationship\-oriented approach
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment
* Able to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and perform under pressure
* Flexible to travel and willing to adapt working hours to business needs

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Project Manager (Substation) is responsible for leading the PMC oversight and delivery of the Airport Substation and Medium Voltage Network Modernization Project, ensuring successful execution of all engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning activities. The role is responsible for managing project performance, stakeholder coordination, technical governance, and compliance with regulatory, operational, and safety requirements while maintaining uninterrupted airport operations. The position serves as the primary interface between the client, contractors, regulatory authorities, and project stakeholders to ensure the safe, timely, and cost\-effective delivery of critical power infrastructure.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Project Leadership \& Management
   

  

* Lead PMC activities for EPC/LSTK contractor execution of a new 34\.5/13\.8kV airport substation and MV network modernization project.
* Manage project scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and stakeholder coordination.
* Review and approve project execution plans, design execution plans, procurement plans, and construction methodologies.
* Monitor project milestones, progress reporting, risk management, and contract compliance.
* Interface with Airport Operations, Engineering, IT, Cybersecurity, HSSE, SEC, Matarat, and external stakeholders.
* Chair weekly and monthly project review meetings.
* Informs themselves of the relevant Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures in place within Hill International, and ensures continued compliance with these requirements while employed by Hill.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the Project Director or line manager.


 Engineering Management
   

  

* Manage and review all detailed engineering submissions at 60%, 90%, and IFC stages.
* Review FEED verification reports and ensure compliance with project objectives.
* Ensure compliance with SEC standards, Saudi Building Code, IEC, IEEE, NFPA, and airport operational requirements.
* Lead multidisciplinary engineering reviews involving:
+ Electrical
+ Civil \& Structural
+ Mechanical \& HVAC
+ Fire Protection
+ Communications
+ SCADA/ADMS
+ Cybersecurity systems

* Review technical queries (TQs), design deviations, value engineering proposals, and constructability studies.


 Electrical Systems Oversight
   

  

* Provide technical leadership for:
* Substations
* 34\.5kV Metal\-Clad Switchgear
* 13\.8kV Metal\-Clad Switchgear
* Busbar Systems
* Protection \& Control Systems
* Auxiliary AC/DC Systems
* Battery Banks and Chargers
* Station Service Transformers
* Transformers
* 30/40MVA 34\.5/13\.8kV Power Transformers
* 20/26\.6MVA 34\.5/13\.8kV Power Transformers
* Oil\-Filled Distribution Transformers
* Dry\-Type Distribution Transformers
* Distribution Network
* 34\.5kV Distribution Loops
* 13\.8kV Distribution Loops
* Automated Smart RMUs
* Underground Duct Banks
* Utility Tunnel Cable Routing
* Cable Terminations and Jointing
* LV Systems
* Main Distribution Boards
* Automatic Transfer Schemes
* Emergency Power Systems
* UPS Integration


 Power System Studies \& Protection
   

  

* Review and approve:
+ ETAP Studies
+ Load Flow Analysis
+ Short Circuit Analysis
+ Arc Flash Studies
+ Harmonic Analysis
+ Relay Coordination Studies
+ Motor Starting Studies
+ Grounding Studies

* Validate protection philosophies and relay settings.
* Ensure system reliability and N\-1 redundancy requirements are achieved.
* Review SCADA integration and operational control strategies.


 Construction \& Site Supervision
   

  

* Oversee site construction activities including:
+ Substation buildings
+ Transformers
+ RMUs
+ MV/LV cable installation
+ Utility tunnel works
+ HDD crossings
+ Duct banks
+ Earthing systems
+ Fire protection systems

* Ensure airport operations are maintained without disruption during construction.
* Manage outage planning, switching programs, and energization activities.
* Verify compliance with approved IFC drawings and method statements.


 Testing, Commissioning \& Energization
   

  

* Witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT).
* Witness Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
* Review commissioning procedures and energization plans.
* Lead integrated testing of:
+ Transformers
+ Switchgear
+ Protection Relays
+ RMUs
+ SCADA Systems
+ Communication Networks

* Ensure successful cutover and transition to operational systems.
* Coordinate with the SEC and Airport Operations for energization approvals.


 Risk \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Maintain the project risk register.
* Lead monthly risk workshops.
* Manage constructability reviews and interface management plans.
* Coordinate with:
* SEC
* National Grid
* Airport Operations
* IT \& Cybersecurity
* Airside Operations
* Utility Authorities
* Consultants and Contractors


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering. Master's Degree in Power Systems Engineering preferred.
* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in Electrical Power Infrastructure Projects.
* Minimum 10 years in Project Management or PMC roles. 5 years in the Airport major projects
* Must have Professional certifications: Saudi Council of Engineers Registration. PMP Certification preferred. PE/Chartered Engineer preferred.
* Experienced in:
+ 69kV/34\.5kV/13\.8kV substations
+ Airport electrical infrastructure
+ SEC utility projects
+ Transmission and distribution systems
+ SCADA and automation systems

* Proven experience delivering EPC/LSTK substation projects above 34\.5kV.
* Technical Skills:
+ Software
+ ETAP
+ AutoCAD
+ BIM/Revit
+ Primavera P6
+ MS Project
+ Power BI

* Standards Knowledge:
+ SEC Standards (TMSS, SDCS, SDMS), IEC 60076, IEC 62271, IEEE 80, EEE 1584
+ NFPA 70
+ NFPA 72
+ SBC
+ ICAO Annex 14


**About Us**
 Hill International, with more than 4,300\+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News\-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .
   

  

 Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.
   

  

 Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com .
   

  

**Hill International is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled**

 **Program Director Mixed\-Use Development** 
 to join our dynamic team in KSA. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of a major mixed\-use development in the Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia, combining infrastructure, public realm, hospitality, residential, commercial, community, and supporting utility assets.

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Establish program requirements for all areas of the project and monitor draft and final deliverables for adherence to these criteria.
* Oversee the establishment of the Project Execution Plan, Health and Safety Plan, Quality Assurance / Quality Control Plan, stakeholder engagement plan, and other necessary project documents.
* Act as the Company representative with the client, consultants, contractors, regulatory agencies, and selected subcontractors during program execution.
* Provide leadership across multiple workstreams, including design management, procurement, construction management, project controls, commercial management, HSE, quality, stakeholder management, and handover.
* Negotiate changes to the scope of work with the client and key subcontractors / consultants.
* Collaborate with Business Development to market and secure additional work with the client.
* Participate in negotiations with regulatory agencies and in public meetings in support of the client.
* Follow up on instructions and commitments associated with the project.
* Develop and distribute a project summary to all members of the project team for reference.
* Provide direction and management for every phase of significant projects or programs to assure on\-schedule completion within or below budget and in accordance with contractual obligations.
* Mobilize company resources to create project teams capable of completing effective, high\-quality work.
* Discuss qualifications required for key project positions with profit center and department managers.
* Collaborate with office facilities staff to address project space requirements.

data.jd_text:
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within their section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**Qualifications and Skills**



* A minimum of 8 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef de Partie (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries, and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

data.jd_text:
An Insights Manager at CARMA shall lead the end\-to\-end setup, management, and delivery of insight products for one of our most pivotal clients. They shall be responsible for ensuring the quality, clarity, and strategic value of all deliverables, acting as the bridge between the client and our internal teams.
   

  

 The role shall have a dual reporting line to both the Key Account Director as well as Insights Consultant MENA and shall be based on\-site, at the client’s location in Dammam, KSA. This setting supports close collaboration, ongoing knowledge exchange, and the development of strong client relationships.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone genuinely passionate about insights—particularly media insights—who thrives on translating data into meaning, identifying patterns, and helping clients make more informed decisions. The successful candidate will have broad experience delivering media insights across sectors, with the ability to independently produce comprehensive analysis reports that drive actionable outcomes. Active engagement with the wider industry, including familiarity with frameworks like AMEC, is highly valued. While formal qualifications are welcomed, a strong sense of curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning are essential.
   

  

 Insights Managers are expected to manage the expectations of senior stakeholders internally as well as externally and to build strong partnerships with the client, coach and manage secondees based at the client location, and contribute to innovation—especially in integrating AI tools to enhance insight generation and efficiency.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and manage ad\-hoc insight reporting for our Tier 01 client, with on\-site support for their evolving needs.
* Independently develop end\-to\-end analysis reports from the ground up, delivering actionable insights for senior stakeholders and effectively presenting the findings.
* Provide strategic input during key events, crises, and other high\-impact moments
* Manage and oversee the on\-site secondee team to ensure seamless client support and alignment with project goals
* Deliver a comprehensive and scalable measurement programme aligned with client objectives
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with the client
* Leverage AI tools to boost insight generation and improve reporting processes
* Support proposal development, onboarding, and account growth initiatives


**What You’ll Bring**
* Experience delivering media insights across industries
* A passion for storytelling through data and evidence
* Strong skills in report writing and analysis, client communication, and project management.
* Familiarity with AMEC frameworks (qualification welcomed but not required)
* A collaborative, curious mindset with a drive to keep learning


**Why join us?**
 Our team is passionate about insights, supportive of each other, and committed to excellence. You’ll be part of a collaborative and growing global team that is shaping the future of communications measurement.
   

  

 Kindly send your CV to careers@carma.com.

We are building a next‑generation private equity platform in Bahrain and are looking for a senior AI leader to embed advanced analytics and GenAI across the full investment lifecycle. This is a hands‑on, high‑visibility role working directly with the investment team and portfolio leadership to turn AI into tangible value creation.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  




* Shape and own the AI strategy across deal sourcing, screening, diligence, IC, portfolio monitoring and exits.

**What you bring** 




  




* 10–15 years in AI, data or digital transformation, ideally with experience in PE‑backed businesses, top‑tier consulting or financial services.

**Why this platform** 




  




* Join a Manama‑headquartered financial group with a growing alternatives and private equity footprint across the GCC and global markets.
* Work at the intersection of AI and private equity in one of the GCC’s most established financial centres, with direct exposure to senior leadership and portfolio C‑suites.

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview** 




**AX Coin (a member of AXG) is the first and only licensed stablecoin issuer under the regulation of the Central Bank of Bahrain.** 
 We are seeking an Associate Director of Reserve who will help with all banking, financial institution, and payment rail relationships. The Associate Director of Reserve is responsible for designing and operating the banking, settlement, liquidity, and payment infrastructure that underpins AX Coin’s stablecoin issuance and payments ecosystem. This is a highly execution\-focused role requiring deep understanding of transaction banking, settlement, and regulated payment flows.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.Banking and FI Relationship** 




 Manage strategic relationships with custodian banks and partner financial institutions to ensure the security and efficient operation of reserve custody accounts.
 



**2\.Reserve Composition and Compliance Management** 




 Strictly comply with Chapter 6 of the Central Bank of Bahrain CBB SIO Module to ensure full compliance of reserve assets with respect to ratings, maturities, and currencies. Establish and maintain a 1:1 integrity verification mechanism for reserve assets, and monitor daily to ensure the market value of reserve assets never falls below the total face value of stablecoins in circulation.
 



**3\.Liquidity Management and Stress Testing** 




 Manage asset maturity structures to ensure high liquidity for real\-time minting and redemption demands. Design and execute stress tests under extreme market conditions such as a redemption crunch to ensure the reserve pools resilience.
 



**4\.Yield and Risk Balance** 




 Operate a yield\-bearing stablecoin model within legal and compliance frameworks.
 



**5\.Audit, Reporting and Segregation** 




 Work with accounting firms to complete monthly or quarterly Proof of Reserves audits. Ensure strict physical segregation of reserve assets from corporate operating funds via segregated accounts. Submit reserve asset composition reports to the Central Bank of Bahrain at the required frequency.
 



**6\.Payment Rail and Settlement Architecture** 




 Lead the design, integration, and maintenance of fiat on\-ramp and off\-ramp channels. Establish and manage the connection between settlement accounts and payment partners.
 



**7\.Liquidity Flow Design and Oversight** 




 Define and govern the fiat clearing and settlement mechanisms within the stablecoin minting and redemption processes to ensure efficient and transparent fund movement.
 



**8\.Reconciliation and Operational Coordination** 




 Establish a three\-party reconciliation mechanism among fund flows, asset flows, and on\-chain data to ensure consistency between circulating supply, reserves, and in\-transit funds. Act as the primary point of contact for banking and payment partners to resolve abnormal operational interruptions.
 



**9\.Regional Expansion Support** 




 Support and expand the companys banking and payment capabilities across EMEA Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



**10\.Stakeholder and Partner Management** 




 Work closely with compliance, product, and operations teams to ensure all payment processes and reserve management activities adhere to AML, sanctions screening, and Central Bank of Bahrain regulatory requirements.
 



  





  





**Key Requirements** 




  





**1\.Experience** 



* Industry Experience: 5\+ years of relevant experience in one or more of the following areas: payments, transaction banking, treasury management, financial infrastructure; asset management, asset\-liability management ALM, fixed income investment, asset custody; experience supporting regulated financial products or platforms such as stablecoins or electronic money institutions.
* Regional Experience: Experience working with financial institutions, fintechs, or regulatory bodies in Bahrain or the Middle East is preferred.



  





**2\.Professional Skills and Knowledge** 




**Regulatory Knowledge:** 



* Deep understanding of the Central Bank of Bahrain CBBs stablecoin regulatory framework, particularly the SIO Module requirements for eligible reserve assets.
* Familiarity with AML and sanctions screening requirements in the payments space.



**Payments and Settlement:** 



* Strong understanding of payment systems, settlement mechanisms, and liquidity management.
* Hands\-on experience onboarding and maintaining bank partnerships and payment rails.



**Investment and Risk Control:** 



* Familiarity with short\-term fixed income investments and asset\-liability duration matching.
* Capability in liquidity risk modeling and stress testing.



**Reconciliation and Operations:** 



* Ability to design and implement complex multi\-party reconciliation processes on\-chain vs. bank vs. reserves.



**Tools and Certifications:** 



* CFA, FRM, CAIA, or CAMS certification is preferred.



  





**3\.Soft Skills and Attributes** 



* Strong execution discipline, ability to work under pressure, communication and negotiation skills, and compliance sensitivity.



  





**4\.Must have legal authorization to work in Bahrain.**

data.jd_text:
Front End is a Saudi\-born, globally respected technology and industrial innovation company leading the future of energy, industry, and beyond. Recognized as Innovator of the Year at the Oil \& Gas Middle East 2025 Awards and trusted by tier\-one clients, we deliver a precision\-engineered ecosystem of advanced solutions across energy, industrial facilities, geoscience, offshore, space, and mining — fully aligned with Saudi Vision 2030\.
   

  

 Our Artificial Intelligence practice delivers mission\-critical, domain\-specific AI — not generic models. We integrate predictive analytics, operational optimization, anomaly detection, and autonomous decision systems directly into industrial, energy, and subsurface operations, combining real\-time data fusion, machine learning, and advanced modeling to drive faster, smarter, and more resilient decisions in high\-stakes environments.
   

  

**Role Description**
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Al Khobar for a Business Development Director – Artificial Intelligence. The Director will own the growth strategy, pipeline, and revenue for Front End's AI practice within the energy, oil \& gas, and industrial sectors — translating our domain\-specific AI capabilities into commercial solutions for upstream, midstream, downstream, and industrial clients across the Kingdom and wider region.
   

  

 This is a domain\-led commercial role, not a generalist technology sales position. The successful candidate must be able to sit credibly across the table from a reservoir engineer, a refinery operations manager, or a drilling superintendent, understand their technical and operational pain points, and articulate precisely how AI\-driven predictive analytics, process optimization, and anomaly detection create measurable value in their environment. Candidates whose experience is purely in AI, SaaS, or software sales — without genuine oil \& gas, subsurface, or industrial domain depth — will not be a fit for this role.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define and execute the business development strategy for Front End's AI offerings across the energy, oil \& gas, and industrial process automation markets
* Build and convert a qualified pipeline with upstream, midstream, downstream, and industrial/manufacturing clients, including national oil companies, operators, and tier\-one industrial accounts
* Translate domain problems — reservoir and subsurface workflows, drilling and completions efficiency, refinery and process optimization, asset integrity, predictive maintenance — into scoped AI solutions and commercial proposals
* Partner with technical and delivery teams to shape solution architecture, proofs of concept, and use cases grounded in real operational data and outcomes
* Lead complex, consultative, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles involving engineering, operations, procurement, and C\-suite decision\-makers
* Develop and manage strategic partnerships and channel relationships that extend Front End's AI reach in the energy and industrial space
* Own commercial negotiations, contracting, and revenue targets for the AI practice, working closely with finance and legal
* Represent Front End as a credible domain authority at industry forums, client engagements, and technical discussions


**Required Qualifications**
* Minimum 10\+ years in business development, commercial, or technical\-commercial roles, with a substantial and verifiable portion in energy, oil \& gas, or subsurface — this is a hard requirement
* Demonstrable technical fluency in at least one core domain: upstream operations and subsurface workflows (seismic, reservoir characterization, drilling, completions), downstream and refinery/process operations, or industrial process automation for manufacturing (DCS/SCADA/PLC, process control, asset performance)
* Proven ability to map AI and data capabilities — predictive analytics, machine learning, anomaly detection, optimization — onto specific oil \& gas and industrial use cases and quantify their business impact
* Track record of closing complex, high\-value B2B deals within the energy or industrial sector in Saudi Arabia or the GCC
* Strong command of the technical vocabulary, operating constraints, regulatory context, and decision\-making structures of energy and industrial clients
* Excellent stakeholder management across technical, operational, and executive audiences
* Bachelor's degree in Petroleum, Chemical, Mechanical, or related Engineering, Geoscience, or a comparable technical discipline


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Existing senior\-level network within Saudi/GCC national oil companies, operators, or major industrial players
* Experience selling or delivering digital transformation, Industry 4\.0, or AI/analytics solutions specifically within energy or industrial environments
* Postgraduate qualification (MBA or technical Master's) combining technical and commercial depth
* Familiarity with Front End's solution areas: AI operations and optimization, predictive maintenance, drilling automation, and industrial anomaly detection

data.jd_text:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 We are seeking a Clinical Study Manager to lead the operational execution of our secondary data use Real World Evidence (RWE) activities and international clinical studies. In this role, you will coordinate end\-to\-end study operations across global sites, ensuring that our clinical programs deliver high\-quality data safely, efficiently, and ethically. You will work within a highly collaborative, matrixed team environment where your leadership directly helps us bring medical innovations to patients faster.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Lead Study Teams: Build and guide cross\-functional, borderless study teams, establishing clear accountabilities, deliverables, and a psychologically safe environment where everyone can thrive
* Manage End\-to\-End Trial Operations: Maintain comprehensive study plans, risk mitigation strategies, site selection procedures, and vendor oversight protocols from activation through to clinical closure
* Oversee Financials \& Agreements: Manage study budgets, track metrics, review work orders, and negotiate study agreements to ensure highly cost\-effective operations with minimal variances
* Drive Global Regulatory Compliance: Ensure absolute adherence to international clinical trial guidelines (such as Good Pharmacovigilance Practices and Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practices), relevant local regulations, and inspection readiness
* Direct Vendor \& Site Deliverables: Maintain strict oversight of external vendors, tracking performance metrics, resolving systematic operational issues, and organizing necessary training
* Develop Strategic Recruitment Plans: Analyze trial feasibility data across multiple countries to make data\-driven recommendations on site distribution, patient numbers, and retention strategies


**Who You Are**
 You are a proactive, strategic operational leader with a passion for clinical excellence and cross\-functional collaboration. You bring a growth mindset, excel at solving complex operational problems under tight deadlines, and possess deep listening and empathy skills that inspire your teams.
   

  

**To be successful in this role, you bring:**
* Proven Clinical Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading successful study teams through all operational stages of clinical studies or secondary data use projects
* Regulatory Expertise: A clear understanding and practical experience applying global clinical quality requirements, regulations, and pharmacovigilance standards
* Strategic Planning \& Risk Management: Strong organizational awareness with a proactive planning mindset, including the ability to embed operational contingencies
* Financial \& Vendor Acumen: Experience successfully managing trial budgets, processing vendor agreements, and handling external system integrations
* Exceptional Communication: Well\-developed written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to present clear directions, influence cross\-functionally, and resolve conflicts


 Together, we’ll advance along the whole patient journey with the aspiration to prevent, stop and cure diseases. Join us in building a healthier future!
   

  

**Compensation \& Benefits**
 This position also offers an attractive benefits package.
   

  

 Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.
   

  

 This job is posted in multiple locations. If you're applying for the role in an alternative location where pay transparency regulations apply, the Talent Acquisition Partner will share the local pay information with you ahead of any business interview.
   

  

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Job Title: Solution Engineering Manager – Siemens Grid Software
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kuwait City, Kuwait
   

  

**About the role:**
 This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence and regional energy transformation. As Solution Engineering Manager, you will be the driving force behind the technical delivery of Siemens Grid Software portfolio — overseeing multidisciplinary teams and managing a portfolio of high\-impact infrastructure projects that directly support national agendas, including Kuwait Vision and broader grid modernization programs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end technical execution of Grid Software projects in Kuwait, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, budget, and quality standards
* Define project objectives, technical scope, resource allocation, and delivery strategies in collaboration with key stakeholders
* Drive engineering best practices through the reuse of standard components, templates, and proven delivery frameworks
* Ensure full compliance with Siemens architectural standards, technical governance, cybersecurity requirements, and EHS policies
* Represent Siemens in senior\-level engagements with government entities, utilities, EPC contractors, and strategic partners
* Support pre\-sales activities, strategic customer engagements, and long\-term account retention initiatives
* Contribute to regional go\-to\-market strategy and business development planning in alignment with sales and regional management
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders at all levels
* Lead and coordinate internal engineering resources, project managers, lifecycle teams, and third\-party vendors across geographically distributed teams
* Coach and develop Technical Project Leads, Engineers, and delivery teams — fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture
* Monitor project performance through robust reporting, scheduling, and quality management mechanism
* Identify, manage, and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and escalation topics throughout the project lifecycle
* Oversee budget accountability and P\&L contribution for the territory's engineering portfolio
* Lead operational improvement initiatives and support business transformation programs within the territory
* Manage scope, schedule, and cost changes using structured governance and changing control processes
* Collaborate with global component teams to ensure alignment with Siemens' architectural and delivery standards


**Your Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, IT, or a related technical discipline
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in project execution and engineering leadership, with a focus on medium to large\-scale infrastructure or Grid Software projects
* Proven track record leading multicultural, multidisciplinary engineering and project management teams in international environments

Siemens is dedicated to quality, equality, and valuing diversity, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities within which we work. Siemens is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate unlawfully on any grounds. We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for leading the Country Audit team, and managing the provision of internal audit and related advisory services for the Branch’s activities. In this regard, the incumbent will develop the annual internal audit plan for the Branch for review by Group Internal Audit Division and subsequently ensure the timely implementation/ execution of the plan in line with applicable best practices, including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA).
   

  

 The responsibility includes also the follow\-up of issues raised by Group Internal Audit Division and preparation of status reports, review of Policies and Procedures and conduct investigations/special assignments as and when requested. The role will also extend to the secondary responsibilities assigned to the incumbent in terms of specific audit activities/ functions/ departments and special projects, as assigned by his superiors, in addition to his primary responsibility. The position requires sufficient expertise and knowledge to focus/ monitor a wide range of risks in their countries business.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Ensure effectiveness of adopted policies/ procedures adherence to regulatory and statutory requirements, and safeguarding of the Branch’s assets.
* Add value to the functions/ activities performed by the Branch by identifying instances/ risks that could result in financial losses or regulatory non\-compliance, monetary penalties/ reputation damage through the audit and risk review process.
* Identify potential cost saving opportunities by highlighting process inefficiencies through the above processes.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for the internal audit function and its roles.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated by the GIAD to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure adequate coverage of the Branch’s activities in the annual audit plan to provide assurance to the relevant executive management on the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal controls in place within the respective department/ function and add value to improve the functioning of the various activities performed by the referenced department/ function, as and where applicable.
* Act as primary Internal Audit subject matter expert in country, in order to ensure adherence to the full range of regulatory requirements (both local and Qatar regulators) including QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures Financial Crime Risk, ESG, Fraud Risk Management, Regulatory reporting and Information Security etc.
* Provide timely feedback/ information to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on queries, reports and other correspondence received by Branch Management either directly from the external auditors or the applicable regulators in the respective jurisdictions, to enable the latter to respond to the same in a timely and efficient manner, that pertain to the incumbent’s area of responsibility.
* Execute and/or support in completion of any requirement, tasks or requests from local regulator or GIAD’s office specifically related to Internal Audit, including reviews of regulatory returns, and periodic certifications.
* Liaise with the relevant officials from Country Regulators as and when required and provide clarifications/ responses to queries/ reports/ other correspondence received.
* Liaise with the external auditors of the branch to ensure that they complement the efforts of the Internal Audit and avoid duplication of effort. This will involve meetings with the external auditors to discuss the planned audit work, the exchange of working papers, audit reports and management letters, and to ensure common understanding of audit techniques, methods and terminology.
* Manage the relationships with the Branch’s executive management and obtain their inputs/ concerns on the various functions/ activities pertaining to the Branch including significant developments therein, which could have an impact on the annual audit plan for the Branch.
* Support Internal Audit teams of other QNB international entities, as and where requested by GIAD.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Conduct a risk assessment for branch individual functions/ processes/ products and related procedures on at least annual basis as an input to annual audit planning exercise.
* Prepare an annual audit for submission to the VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/comments and approval, based on the risk assessment conducted for the Branch and in line with its overall strategy.
* Ensure timely implementation and execution of the approved annual audit plan. Also responsible for submitting periodic status reports on the progress to VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and explaining the reasons for the delay in completion of individual assignments, if applicable.
* Ensure the continued adherence to internal auditing best practices including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA) recommendations/guidelines. Ensure that the audit planning, fieldwork and reporting stages are conducted in consonance with the procedures/ guidelines contained in the internal audit manual. Also, make recommendations to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on any improvements to the approved internal audit manual, in line with best practices.
* Escalate promptly (on interim basis if required) any major issues/ significant concerns emerging from the areas/ functions audited, to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/ action to enable timely rectification/ resolution of the highlighted issues.
* Utilize appropriate audit management application software procured by GIAD
* Ensure effective audit follow\-up process in order to monitor and report on status of issues raised in reports issued by Internal Audit, External auditors and regulators.
* Submit performance appraisals to the VP \-International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on timely basis in accordance with the laid down policy in this regard.
* Provide timely and accurate information to the external auditors, regulators and the Compliance function as and when required.
* Continuous Improvement:
* Set examples by leading improvement initiatives through cross\-functional teams ensuring successes.
* Identify and encourage people to adopt practices better than the industry standard.
* Continuously encourage and recognise the importance of thinking out\-of\-the\-box within the team.
* Encourage, solicit and reward innovative ideas even in day\-to\-day issues.
* Learning \& Knowledge:
* Identify related areas for professional development based on discussions with the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and ensure they are part of their development plan.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank and attain/maintain the required levels of competence.
* Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Hold meetings with staff and assess their performance and the team’s overall performance on a regular basis.
* Identify development opportunities and activities for staff and facilitate/coach them to improve their effectives and prepare them to assume greater responsibilities.
* Take decisive action to ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members.
* Legal, Regulatory and Risk Framework Responsibilities:
* Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, the QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (Anti Money Laundering \& Counter Terrorist Financing, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy).
* Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify, measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy.
* Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role.
* Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence.
* Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other:
* Carry out all other ad hoc tasks, duties and/or activities that GIAD may request from time to time.
* Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information.
* Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators.
* Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position.


**Education And Experience Requirements**

Position Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide expert advice and conduct detailed planning support of Special Activities (Title 10/Title 50\), operational planning, coordination and oversight.
* Provide strategic and operational level planning support pertaining to DoD\-wide strategy future issues and strategic foresight, policy, doctrine, decisions, trends, concepts and studies.

* Provide senior staff advice and recommendations regarding the establishment, management and execution \- level analysis for risk management in support of National Defense strategic priorities including, but not limited to:
+ National Mission Force Operations
+ Theater Special Operations Forces
+ Sensitive and Clandestine Operations
+ Personnel Recovery Operations
+ Focal Point Operations

* Analyze strategies, policies, doctrine, plans, capability gaps and emerging trends to support decision\-making related to current Special and Sensitive Activity operations.
* Analyze specific legal authorities required to execute sensitive operations in support of existing orders and make recommended authority and Rule of Engagement Changes within legal operational restrictions.
* Coordinate and integrate plans with supporting/supported interagency partners.
* Review and analyze selected publications to determine congruence with or divergence from existing policy and doctrine.
* Provide expertise and analytical support within the SAP, STO and ACCM channels as they pertain to the Special Activities Branch in support of Counter Terrorism and Great Power Competition.

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree, Master's degree preferred, or demonstrated capacity to operate at GCC level planning and operations execution.
* Five (5\) years of strategic and operations planning at the Brigade and Division level, specific to SOF and interagency operations under Title 50\.

* Expertise in coordination and planning of Special Activity Operations, to include capabilities, Tactics Techniques and Procedures (TTP), authorities, oversight and C4I requirements for all SOF and Title 50 operations.
* Demonstrate knowledge of the Title 50 support process for a CCMD AOR. Must be able to staff Title 50 support requests with little to no oversight.

* Experience in Focal Point Operations Center (FPOC) and Operations Control Center (OCC) operations, providing support to sensitive operations to enable CCMD Command decision making.
* Experience with record message traffic handling, including the Automatic Message Handling System (AMHS) interface.
* Experience and depth in CCMD operations and the operating environment.
* Active TS/SCI clearance and the ability to be granted access to SAP programs.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Excellent computer skills, Video Teleconference capability (VTC) equipment and SharePoint usage.
* Superior Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook and PowerPoint.
* Superior oral and written communication skills, including expert ability to communicate effectively with people of all levels, deliver effective oral presentations, prepare assessments, and represent the CCMD in interagency meetings.
* Superior interpersonal, organizational and management skills and an expert ability to conceptualize and lead complex analytical projects.

* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
